# >>> site-common: generated from scripts/gov/src/site-common.ps1 by scripts/build_task_scripts.py (do not edit)
function Get-SiteAddress([string]$ConfigDir) {
  # One entry (PFM 15 Nov 26): the address RADE holds (RADE_SITE, from its "Site address" box) is used with no question;
  # outside RADE the one saved in Config\90161Z-site.txt is used. Only when neither exists does a question open (once).
  # To change the site, use "Change the site address" in RADE. Kept only on this computer (the repo is public).
  $ok = '^https://[^/\s]+/sites/[^/\s]+'
  $v = ([string]$env:RADE_SITE).Trim()
  if ($v -match $ok) { return $v }
  $f = Join-Path $ConfigDir '90161Z-site.txt'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf) { $v = ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -TotalCount 1)).Trim(); if ($v -match $ok) { return $v } }
  # RADE runs a step with no window, so a question there would wait unseen: stop with the fix instead.
  if ($env:RADE_CONTRACT) { throw 'SITE ADDRESS not set. Complete the "Site address" box in RADE, then run this step again.' }
  $v = ([string](Read-Host 'Site address (it starts with https://; it is kept only on this computer), then press Enter')).Trim()
  if ($v -notmatch $ok) { throw 'SITE ADDRESS not given or not a site address (https://<host>/sites/<name>). Run again.' }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ConfigDir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ConfigDir -Force) }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value $v -Encoding UTF8
  return $v
}

function Hide-Site([string]$Text, [string]$Site) {
  <#
  .SYNOPSIS
  Masks e-mail addresses, the site, its host, path, name and tenant, other URLs, cloud and .mil hosts and GUIDs in a
  result text. Not masked: display names, office symbols, phone numbers, user ids, computer names.
  .PARAMETER Text
  The text to clean (a result line or an error message).
  .PARAMETER Site
  The site address (https://<host>/sites/<name>), or an empty text for the generic rules only.
  .OUTPUTS
  System.String. The text with each match replaced by a placeholder such as <EMAIL>, <SITE> or <GUID>.
  #>
  # The address only (name, @ or %40, host; encoded characters and an apostrophe inside the name count as part of it),
  # first: the host rules below would
  # keep its name part.
  $Text = $Text -replace '(?:[\w.+=-]|%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|(?<=\w)[''\u2019](?=\w))+(?:@|%40)[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*(?:%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2})*', '<EMAIL>'
  if ($Site) {
    $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($Site.TrimEnd('/')), '<SITE>'
    try {
      $u = [uri]$Site; $p = $u.AbsolutePath.TrimEnd('/'); $leaf = ($p -split '/')[-1]   # $p is /sites/<name>: also in URL-encoded form
      $set = @(, @($u.Host, '<SITE-HOST>', ''))   # literal text, placeholder, word boundary (tenant and site name only, 3+ letters)
      if ($p.Length -gt 1) { $set += @($p, '<SITE-PATH>', ''), @([uri]::EscapeDataString($p), '<SITE-PATH>', ''), @($leaf, '<SITE-NAME>', '\b') }
      $set += , @(($u.Host -split '\.')[0], '<TENANT>', '\b')
      foreach ($s in $set) { if ($s[2] -eq '' -or $s[0].Length -ge 3) { $Text = $Text -replace ($s[2] + [regex]::Escape($s[0]) + $s[2]), $s[1] } }
    } catch { $null = $_ }
  }
  # Pattern and mask pairs. The GUID has no \b: guid%27<id> must be masked too.
  $g = @('https?://\S+', '<URL>', '\b[\w.-]+\.(sharepoint|onmicrosoft|microsoftonline|windows)\.(com|us|net|mil)\b', '<TENANT-HOST>',
    '\b[\w.-]+\.mil\b', '<HOST>', '[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}', '<GUID>')
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $g.Count; $i += 2) { $Text = $Text -replace $g[$i], $g[$i + 1] }
  return $Text
}

$shared['task-common-2b522804'] = @'
# >>> task-common: generated from scripts/gov/src/task-common.ps1 by scripts/build_task_scripts.py (do not edit)
function ConvertTo-Masked([string]$Text, [string[]]$Secret) {
  foreach ($x in $Secret) { $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($x), '<DODID>' }
  return $Text
}

function Get-TaskId([string]$Id) {
  # Returns @{ Id; Leaf (profile folder name); Secret (longest first, so a longer name is masked before a shorter one inside it) }.
  $leaf = ''
  if ($env:USERPROFILE) { $leaf = Split-Path -Leaf $env:USERPROFILE }
  $value = ([string]$Id).Trim()
  # No DODID question (PFM 13 Nov 26): the Windows profile folder name is used when -Id is not given.
  if (-not $value) { $value = $leaf }
  if ($value -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{4,}$') { throw 'DODID not valid: use the folder name under C:\Users (4 or more letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore).' }
  $secret = @(@($value, $leaf, $env:USERNAME) |
    Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Length -ge 4 } | Sort-Object -Unique | Sort-Object Length -Descending)
  return @{ Id = $value; Leaf = $leaf; Secret = $secret }
}

function Get-TaskDir([string]$Id, [string]$Task, [string]$Label, [switch]$Create) {
  # The task folder C:\Users\<DODID>\<OneDrive>\RADE\90-161.Z\<Task>: <OneDrive> is the folder name of $env:OneDriveCommercial,
  # else 'OneDrive - United States Air Force' (fleet v2). Until RADE moves the old ...\90-161.Z, that one is used. -Create makes it.
  $odName = if ($env:OneDriveCommercial) { Split-Path -Leaf $env:OneDriveCommercial } else { 'OneDrive - United States Air Force' }; $od = Join-Path (Join-Path 'C:\Users' $Id) $odName
  $app = 'RADE\90-161.Z'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $od $app) -PathType Container) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $od '90-161.Z') -PathType Container)) { $app = '90-161.Z' }
  $tail = $odName + '\' + $app + '\' + $Task
  $dir = Join-Path (Join-Path 'C:\Users' $Id) $tail
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) {
    if ($Create) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }
    else { throw ('FOLDER not found: C:\Users\<DODID>\' + $tail + '. Create it, save the ' + $Label + ' files into it, then run again.') }
  }
  return $dir
}

function Assert-TaskFile([string]$Dir, [string[]]$Name, [string]$Message) {
  # Throws $Message + the missing names when a file in $Name is not in $Dir.
  $missing = @($Name | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Dir $_) -PathType Leaf) })
  if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { throw ($Message + ($missing -join ', ')) }
}

function Unblock-TaskScript([string]$Dir) {
  # Files pasted into Notepad and saved locally need no unblock; a failed unblock is not an error here.
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Dir -Filter *.ps1 | ForEach-Object { Unblock-File -LiteralPath $_.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

function Invoke-TaskStep([hashtable]$Step, [string]$ScriptDir, [string[]]$Secret, $Lines, [string]$Log) {
  # Runs $Step.File from $ScriptDir in a child powershell.exe with $Step.Args, masks and records its output and exit
  # code in $Lines, and saves $Lines to $Log after the step.
  Write-Host ('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' running (Word steps can take a few minutes; do not close this window)...')
  $Lines.Add('STEP ' + $Step.Name)
  $stepArgs = $Step.Args
  $global:LASTEXITCODE = $null
  # PS 5.1: with Stop, a stderr line from the step (2>&1) would end the runner. Record it instead.
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  $out = & powershell.exe -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $ScriptDir $Step.File) @stepArgs 2>&1
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  foreach ($o in @($out | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })) {
    $masked = ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$o) $Secret
    $Lines.Add($masked)
    Write-Host $masked
  }
  $Lines.Add('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' exit=' + $code)
  Write-Host ('STEP ' + $Step.Name + ' exit=' + $code)
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $Log -Value $Lines -Encoding UTF8
}

# R12 (R39): the Sofia Sans font files next to this script (the round puts them in the T22 folder with it), as the
# RADE UI file wants them: file name -> base64. Takes the folder; returns an empty table when there are none.
function Get-FontTtf([string]$Folder) {
  $out = @{}
  try { foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Folder -Filter '*SofiaSans*.ttf' -File -ErrorAction Stop)) {
      $out[$f.Name] = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f.FullName)) } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return $out
}
$OpenedHours = 3   # a result file older than this is from an earlier round (review R30): -Opened does not trust it
# The -Opened line for the result file in $Dir: PASS when it was written in the last $OpenedHours hours, its last
# "CARDS opened" line counts more than 0 cards and no line starts with STOPPED:, else FAIL (also when it is missing).
function Get-OpenedLine([string]$Dir) {
  $f = Join-Path $Dir ('90161Z-T22-window-' + $Rev + '.txt')
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { return 'FAIL the window did not open' }
  if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $f).LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$OpenedHours)) { return 'FAIL the window did not open (no result from this round)' }
  $text = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)
  $m = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -match '^CARDS opened: .*\((\d+) of (\d+)\)$' }) | Select-Object -Last 1
  $stopped = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -match '^STOPPED:' }).Count
  if ($m -and -not $stopped -and $m -match '\((\d+) of (\d+)\)$' -and [int]$Matches[1] -gt 0) { return ('PASS the window opened (' + $Matches[1] + ' of ' + $Matches[2] + ' cards)') }
  return 'FAIL the window did not open'
}
if ($Opened) {   # no window, no file: one line about the last run, exit 1 on FAIL
  try { $od = $(if ($TestDir) { $TestDir } else { Get-TaskDir (Get-TaskId $Id).Id $task 'Task 22' }); $ol = Get-OpenedLine $od } catch { $ol = 'FAIL the window did not open' }
  Write-Host $ol; exit $(if ($ol.StartsWith('PASS')) { 0 } else { 1 })
}

$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$lines.Add('TASK T22 PFM window preview ' + $Rev + $(if ($Again) { ' (again: the reopen check)' } else { '' }) + ', ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))
$code = 0
$cf = 0; $cardsOpened = @{}; $presses = 0; $defects = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

$who = $null
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  $missing = @($Parts | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-PartPath $_) -PathType Leaf) })
  if ($missing.Count) { throw ('a part of this task is not in its folder: ' + (@($missing | ForEach-Object { Split-Path -Leaf (Get-PartPath $_) }) -join ', ')) }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 22 r15, Maintenance (round R39; the PFM, 20 Nov 26): the test install of 90-161.Z 0.1, and the read-back
  of what RADE's Maintenance tools Diagnose and Back up made. Windows PowerShell 5.1 (also 7); no module.
.DESCRIPTION
  RADE shows its Maintenance screen (Diagnose, Back up) only for an app that a RADE deploy installed (RADE engine-v30,
  engine/ps/window/06-open.ps1). R39 therefore deploys 90-161.Z version 0.1.0 first.
  -Part Install: the one step of that deploy. It writes 90161Z-T22-install-r15.txt and passes; RADE keeps the install
  record (RADE\Config\installed). It installs nothing else and changes nothing on the site.
  -Part Read: reads, on this computer only, (1) the install record of 90-161.Z (version and last run state), (2) the
  newest Diagnose report (RADE\90-161.Z\Diagnose\diagnose-*.txt): its PASS, FINDING and NOTE counts and each FINDING
  line, masked, and (3) the newest Back up folder (RADE\90-161.Z\Backups\<time>): for each list, its JSON and CSV file
  and its row count. Never a row value: the backup files hold site data and stay in OneDrive (Project rule "Data
  boundary"); only counts and list titles go into the result.
  -Part Backup (round R41, the Restore test; the PFM, 21 Nov 26): reads only (3), the newest Back up folder, so the round
  knows that the Back up before the Restore test saved every list (12 from R41: the 12th is "PFM Recommendations (DAF Form
  847)", a title with parentheses that RADE engine-v31 can back up). It also needs a backup made after the T26 part
  Rows made the fake rows (RowsAt in T26\90161Z-T26-endorse-state-r2.txt): an older backup, or no Rows time, is a FAIL.
  Result lines: RESULT INSTALL, RESULT DIAGNOSE and RESULT BACKUP, each PASS or FAIL. Exit 1 when one is FAIL.
  A report or backup older than $FreshHours hours is from an earlier day and counts as missing.
  Run: by RADE (powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T22-maint-r15.ps1 -Part Install, Read or Backup -NoPause), or by hand in T22.
  Parameters: -Id (the DODID; the profile folder name when not given), -Part, -NoPause, -TestDir (the T22 folder of a
  test; its parent is the app folder and the parent of that the RADE folder).
  Network: none.
  Writes: Install: 90161Z-T22-install-r15.txt; Read: 90161Z-T22-maint-r15.txt; Backup: 90161Z-T22-backup-r15.txt, all in
          the T22 folder (or -TestDir).
  Credentials: none.
#>
param([string]$Id, [ValidateSet('Install', 'Read', 'Backup')][string]$Part = 'Read', [switch]$NoPause, [string]$TestDir)
$task = 'T22'

# @@SHARED task-common-2b522804@@ (RADE writes the shared block "task-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The install record of 90-161.Z in RADE\Config\installed (schema rade-installed/2: key, installed, lastRun).
.PARAMETER Rade
  The RADE folder.
.OUTPUTS
  The record (a PSCustomObject) whose key is "90-161.Z/90-161.Z" (the app folder and the app name; RADE adds "@<hash>"
  only for an app with a site marker, which 90-161.Z has not), or $null.
#>
function Get-InstallRecord([string]$Rade) {
  $d = Join-Path (Join-Path $Rade 'Config') 'installed'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { return $null }
  foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter '*.json' -File)) {
    try { $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }   # a record of another app that is being written
    if ([string]$j.key -eq '90-161.Z/90-161.Z') { return $j } }
  return $null
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The result lines of the newest Diagnose report: counts, each FINDING line (masked), and RESULT DIAGNOSE.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z).
.OUTPUTS
  The lines (strings).
#>
function Get-DiagnoseResult([string]$App) {
  $d = Join-Path $App 'Diagnose'
  $f = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter 'diagnose-*.txt' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $f -or $f.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$FreshHours)) { return @('DIAGNOSE no report from this round in the Diagnose folder', 'RESULT DIAGNOSE FAIL') }
  $text = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName)
  $n = @{}; foreach ($k in 'PASS', 'FINDING', 'NOTE') { $n[$k] = @($text | Where-Object { $_ -like ($k + ': *') }).Count }
  $out = @('DIAGNOSE report made ' + $f.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + ': pass=' + $n.PASS + ' findings=' + $n.FINDING + ' notes=' + $n.NOTE)
  $site = [string]$env:RADE_SITE   # the site RADE holds (no question here); empty outside RADE: the generic masks still apply
  foreach ($l in @($text | Where-Object { $_ -like 'FINDING: *' } | Select-Object -First 20)) { $out += ('DIAGNOSE ' + (Hide-Site ([string]$l) $site)) }
  return $out + @('RESULT DIAGNOSE PASS')   # the report exists: what it found is for the PFM to judge (the answers)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The result lines of the newest Back up folder: for each list, its files and row count, and RESULT BACKUP.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z).
.PARAMETER Since
  Only for -Part Backup: the newest folder must be made after this time (the T26 Rows time); $null = no such rule.
.OUTPUTS
  The lines (strings). PASS when the newest folder is from this round (and made after Since), has at least one list, and every JSON file has its
  CSV copy and can be read. The row values are never read into the result.
#>
function Get-BackupResult([string]$App, $Since = $null) {
  $root = Join-Path $App 'Backups'
  $all = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending)
  $new = $all | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $new -or $new.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-$FreshHours)) { return @('BACKUP no backup folder from this round (folders: ' + $all.Count + ')', 'RESULT BACKUP FAIL') }
  if ($null -ne $Since -and $new.CreationTime -le $Since) { return @('BACKUP the newest backup folder is older than the fake rows of the Restore test (run Back up again)', 'RESULT BACKUP FAIL') }
  $all2 = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $new.FullName -Filter '*.json' -File | Sort-Object Name)
  $json = @($all2 | Where-Object { -not $_.Name.StartsWith('~') })   # '~<n>.json': a file RADE could not give its list name
  $tilde = $all2.Count - $json.Count
  $out = @('BACKUP folders=' + $all.Count + '; the newest holds ' + $json.Count + ' lists'); $bad = $tilde
  if ($tilde) { $out += ('BACKUP ' + $tilde + ' list files without their list name (RADE did not finish naming them)') }
  foreach ($j in $json) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($j.Name); $csv = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $new.FullName ($name + '.csv')) -PathType Leaf
    $rows = 'unreadable'   # RADE writes one JSON array of rows (engine-v30, 13-maintenance.ps1)
    try { $rows = [string](Get-JsonRowCount $j.FullName) } catch { $bad++ }
    if (-not $csv) { $bad++ }
    $out += ('BACKUP list "' + $name + '": rows=' + $rows + ' csv=' + $(if ($csv) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })) }
  if ($json.Count -lt $BackupLists) { $out += ('BACKUP ' + $json.Count + ' of ' + $BackupLists + ' lists saved') }
  return $out + @('RESULT BACKUP ' + $(if ($json.Count -ge $BackupLists -and -not $bad) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }))
}

# The time the T26 part Rows made the fake rows of the Restore test (RowsAt in the T26 state file), or $null. Takes the app folder.
function Get-RowsTime([string]$App) {
  $f = Join-Path (Join-Path $App 'T26') '90161Z-T26-endorse-state-r2.txt'
  $l = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { ([string]$_).StartsWith('RowsAt=') }) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $l) { return $null }
  try { return [datetime]::ParseExact(([string]$l).Substring(7), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) } catch { return $null }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The number of rows in one backup JSON file (one array of rows; RADE engine-v30). Reads no value into the result.
.DESCRIPTION
  Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertFrom-Json stops on a long text (its JSON length limit); then the .NET reader with no
  length limit counts it.
.PARAMETER Path
  The JSON file.
.OUTPUTS
  The row count.
#>
function Get-JsonRowCount([string]$Path) {
  $raw = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
  try { $v = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; return @($v).Count } catch {   # a variable: 5.1 writes the array as one object
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Web.Extensions
    $s = New-Object System.Web.Script.Serialization.JavaScriptSerializer; $s.MaxJsonLength = [int]::MaxValue
    return @($s.DeserializeObject($raw)).Count }
}

# Turns the "|" lines of the Your Work grid into row tables (Publication keeps "number|title" for the two-part cell).
function ConvertTo-HomeRow([string[]]$Lines) {
  foreach ($l in $Lines) {
    if ($l.Trim()) {
      $f = $l.Split('|')
      @{ Publication = ($f[0] + '|' + $f[1]); Action = $f[2]; Step = $f[3]; With = $f[4]; Since = $f[5]; Age = $f[6]; Due = $f[7]
        Status = $f[8]; Kind = $f[9]; Go = $f[10] }
    }
  }
}
# Turns the "|" lines of the All Actions grid into row tables; Me is true for a row that needs you.
function ConvertTo-QueueRow([string[]]$Lines) {
  foreach ($l in $Lines) {
    if ($l.Trim()) {
      $f = $l.Split('|')
      @{ Publication = ($f[0] + '|' + $f[1]); Action = $f[2]; Step = $f[3]; Weekdays = $f[4]; With = $f[5]; Status = $f[6]
        Kind = $f[7]; Go = $f[8]; Me = ($f[9] -eq '1') }
    }
  }
}

# The Action Status card at the right of a step card. Takes one table: Title, Sub, Note (a gray box; may be empty),
# Rows (label, value, chip kind) and Buttons. Stretch: its bottom lines up with the main card's bottom (R30 V4).
function Get-SideStatus($S) {
  $b = @(@{ T = 'head'; Text = $S.Title; Small = $true }, @{ T = 'p'; Text = $S.Sub; Style = 'note' })
  if ($S.Note) { $b += @{ T = 'p'; Text = $S.Note; Style = 'box' } }
  if ($S.Rows) { $b += @{ T = 'rows'; Rows = $S.Rows } }
  if ($S.Buttons) { $b += @{ T = 'buttons'; Items = $S.Buttons } }
  return @{ Cap = 'Action Status'; Pad = 22; Stretch = $true; Blocks = $b }
}

# R13 (R40): the name of card $Key as its head shows it: its title, else the last part of its crumb ('' for no card).
function Get-CardName([string]$Key) {
  $c = $Cards[$Key]; if (-not $c) { return '' }
  if ($c.Title) { return [string]$c.Title }
  return [string]@(([string]$c.Crumb) -split [regex]::Escape(' ' + $gt + ' '))[-1]
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R13 (R40; R39 finding 1): the text of the -Again check, which names the card saved at the last close.
.DESCRIPTION
The window opens on the card saved at the last close ($wn.OpenLast in the window part), so the check names that card
by its title: "Pass if this window opened on Settings, the screen you closed it on." With no saved card, or one the
window does not open (unknown or modal), the window opens on Your Work and the check says that no screen was saved.
.PARAMETER Key
The card key read from the saved-card file, or '' when there is none.
.OUTPUTS
System.String. The check text.
#>
function Get-AgainText([string]$Key) {
  $name = $(if ($Key -and $Cards[$Key] -and -not $Cards[$Key].Modal) { Get-CardName $Key } else { '' })
  if ($name) { return ('Pass if this window opened on ' + $name + ', the screen you closed it on.') }
  return 'No screen was saved when this window last closed. Select Fail.'
}
if ($Again) { $Checks[0].Text = Get-AgainText '' }   # until the main script has read the saved card (-PlanOnly reads none)
# The rail items, top to bottom (Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5 open them in this order).
$RailItems = @(@{ Key = 'work'; Text = 'Your Work'; Go = 'home'; Badge = '3' }, @{ Key = 'queue'; Text = 'All Actions'; Go = 'queue' },
  @{ Key = 'pub'; Text = 'Publications'; Go = 'pub' }, @{ Key = 'reviews'; Text = 'Reviews Due'; Go = 'reviews' }, @{ Key = 'settings'; Text = 'Settings'; Go = 'settings' })
# Plain-text form of a line for -PlanOnly: the dot and the arrow become | and > (the output stays ASCII).
function ConvertTo-PlanText([string]$Text) {
  return ($Text.Replace($mid, '|').Replace($gt, '>'))
}
# The text form of one button for -PlanOnly: its text, "(blue)" for the main button, where it goes, what it needs.
function Get-ButtonPlan($Button) {
  return ('    BUTTON ' + $Button.Text + $(if ($Button.Kind -eq 'primary') { ' (blue)' } else { '' }) + ' -> ' +
    $(if ($Button.Go) { $Button.Go } else { '@note' }) + $(if ($Button.Need) { ' [needs ' + $Button.Need + ']' } else { '' }))
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Gives the -PlanOnly lines of one block of a card.
.DESCRIPTION
One or more lines per block type, the same words the window shows: chips, headline, text, steps, checks and boxes with
their links, rows, list items with their buttons, grid rows that open a card, boxes, choices, error, progress, buttons.
.PARAMETER Block
The block table (T = its type).
.OUTPUTS
The lines, not yet made plain (ConvertTo-PlanText runs on each).
#>
function Get-BlockPlan($Block) {
  $b = $Block
  switch ($b.T) {
    'chips' { '    CHIPS ' + (@($b.Items | ForEach-Object { $_[1] }) -join ', ') + $(if ($b.Cap) { ' | ' + $b.Cap } else { '' }) }
    'head' { '    HEAD ' + $b.Text }
    'p' { '    P ' + $b.Text }
    'steps' { '    STEPS ' + $b.N + ' of 12 (12 dots) | ' + $StepNames[$b.N - 1] }
    'check' { '    CHECK ' + $b.Text; if (Test-CheckLink $b) { '    LINK ' + $b.Link.Text + $(if ($b.Link.Go) { ' -> ' + $b.Link.Go } else { ' -> @note' }) } }
    'ck' { '    BOX ' + $b.Text; if (Test-CheckLink $b) { '    LINK ' + $b.Link.Text + ' -> @note' } }
    'rows' { foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { '    ROW ' + $r[0] + ': ' + $r[1] } }
    'list' { foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { '    ITEM ' + $r.Title + ' | ' + $r.Sub; if ($r.Btn) { Get-ButtonPlan @{ Text = $r.Btn.Text; Kind = $r.Btn.Kind; Go = $r.Btn.Go } } } }
    'grid' {
      '    GRID ' + $b.Name + ': ' + @($b.Cols).Count + ' columns, ' + @($b.Rows).Count + ' rows'
      foreach ($r in @($b.Rows)) { if ($r.Go) { '    CHOICE ' + $(if ($r.Publication) { $r.Publication } else { $r.Office }) + ' -> ' + $r.Go } } }
    'filter' { '    FILTER search and show list' }
    'input' { '    INPUT ' + $b.Label + ' (' + $b.Id + ')' }
    'radio' { '    CHOICES ' + $b.Label + ': ' + (@($b.Items) -join ' / ') }
    'err' { '    ERROR ' + $b.Text }
    'progress' { '    PROGRESS ' + $b.Text }
    'buttons' { foreach ($x in @($b.Items)) { Get-ButtonPlan $x } }
  }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Gives the cards, their sections and blocks, and the rail as plain text lines (-PlanOnly; tests/run.sh reads them).
.DESCRIPTION
A CARD line per card (key, rail item, title or crumb), then SUB and CRUMB, a SECTION line per section and the block lines
of Get-BlockPlan, and at the end one RAIL line per rail item. Reads $Cards and $RailItems; changes nothing.
.OUTPUTS
An array of ASCII lines.
#>
function Get-CardPlan {
  $out = @()
  foreach ($k in $Cards.Keys) {
    $c = $Cards[$k]
    $head = $(if ($c.Title) { $c.Title } else { $c.Crumb })
    $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('CARD ' + $k + ' | ' + $c.Rail + ' | ' + $head))
    if ($c.Sub) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  SUB ' + $c.Sub)) }
    if ($c.Crumb -and $c.Title) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  CRUMB ' + $c.Crumb)) }
    foreach ($col in @($c.Cols)) {
      foreach ($s in @($col)) {
        $wide = $(if ($s.WideOnly) { ' [wide only]' } else { '' })   # R15: the click-through check skips these sections
        $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ('  SECTION ' + $(if ($s.Cap) { $s.Cap } else { '-' }) + $wide))
        foreach ($b in @($s.Blocks)) { foreach ($l in @(Get-BlockPlan $b)) { $out += (ConvertTo-PlanText ([string]$l)) } }
      }
    }
  }
  foreach ($r in $RailItems) { $out += ('RAIL ' + $r.Text + ' -> ' + $r.Go) }
  return $out
}
# The checks as -PlanOnly lines: CHECK <n> <key>: <text> (tests/run.sh reads them).
function Get-CheckPlan {
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Checks.Count; $i++) { 'CHECK ' + ($i + 1) + ' ' + $Checks[$i].Key + ': ' + $Checks[$i].Text }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R14 (R41 plan row 3): how a person opens card $To from card $From with one selection that only opens a screen.
.DESCRIPTION
In this order: a rail item that opens $To (the rail shows on every card); a button of $From that goes to $To with
no need (R15, R41 finding 4: also a button with a FAKE note, such as "Start Endorsement" on Confirm: it is the real way to
the endorsement screen; a button that needs a reason or a box needs a second action); the crumb link of $From. Sections shown only in a wide window are left out, so the
opener is there at every window size. No opener: $null (the click-through then shows its own link "Open this screen").
.PARAMETER From
The card key the person is on ('' at the start: only the rail counts).
.PARAMETER To
The card key to open.
.OUTPUTS
@{ Via = 'rail', 'button' or 'link'; Text = what to select; Beside = the list row the button sits in, or '' }, or $null.
#>
function Get-WalkOpener([string]$From, [string]$To) {
  foreach ($r in $RailItems) { if ($r.Go -eq $To) { return @{ Via = 'rail'; Text = [string]$r.Text; Beside = '' } } }
  $c = $Cards[$From]; if (-not $c) { return $null }
  foreach ($col in @($c.Cols)) { foreach ($sec in @($col)) {
      if ($sec.WideOnly) { continue }
      foreach ($b in @($sec.Blocks)) {
        $btns = @(); if ($b.T -eq 'buttons') { $btns = @($b.Items | ForEach-Object { @{ B = $_; Beside = '' } }) }
        if ($b.T -eq 'list') { $btns = @($b.Rows | Where-Object { $_.Btn } | ForEach-Object { @{ B = $_.Btn; Beside = [string]$_.Title } }) }
        foreach ($x in $btns) { if ($x.B.Go -eq $To -and -not $x.B.Need) { return @{ Via = 'button'; Text = [string]$x.B.Text; Beside = $x.Beside } } } } } }
  if ($c.CrumbGo -eq $To) { return @{ Via = 'link'; Text = [string]@(([string]$c.Crumb) -split [regex]::Escape(' ' + $gt + ' '))[0]; Beside = '' } }
  return $null
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
R14 (R41 plan row 3; PFM 20 Nov 26): the click-through, one step per card, every card once.
.DESCRIPTION
The order (the cards in the order the window builds them, $Cards): from the card the person is on, the next step is the
first card not yet walked that one rail item, button or crumb link opens (Get-WalkOpener); when no card has one, the
first card not yet walked, opened with the link "Open this screen" of the check bar. Each step is one action and one
Pass or Fail, in the words of the 4 checks. Pure data: no window.
.OUTPUTS
An array of @{ Key; Via (rail, button, link or open); Opener (what to select); Text (the bar text); From (R15: the card it starts on) }.
#>
function Get-WalkPlan {
  $left = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach ($k in $Cards.Keys) { $left.Add([string]$k) }
  $out = @(); $cur = ''; $n = $left.Count
  while ($left.Count) {
    $key = ''; $op = $null
    foreach ($k in $left) { $o = Get-WalkOpener $cur $k; if ($o) { $key = $k; $op = $o; break } }
    if (-not $key) { $key = $left[0]; $op = @{ Via = 'open'; Text = 'Open this screen'; Beside = '' } }
    [void]$left.Remove($key)
    $what = $(if ($op.Via -eq 'rail') { $op.Text + ' in the list on the left' } elseif ($op.Via -eq 'link') { 'the link "' + $op.Text + '" at the top' }
      elseif ($op.Beside) { '"' + $op.Text + '" beside "' + $op.Beside + '"' } elseif ($op.Via -eq 'open') { '"Open this screen" in this bar' } else { '"' + $op.Text + '"' })
    $text = 'Screen ' + ($out.Count + 1) + ' of ' + $n + ': select ' + $what + '. Pass if ' + (Get-CardName $key) + ' opens and looks right.'
    $out += @{ Key = $key; Via = $op.Via; Opener = $op.Text; Text = $text; From = $cur }; $cur = $key }
  return $out
}
# The click-through as -PlanOnly lines: WALK <n> <card> <via>: <text> (tests/run.sh reads them).
function Get-WalkPlanText { for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Walk.Count; $i++) { ConvertTo-PlanText ('WALK ' + ($i + 1) + ' ' + $Walk[$i].Key + ' ' + $Walk[$i].Via + ': ' + $Walk[$i].Text) } }
# R14: the click-through of this run; none with -Again (the second run of the round has its one reopen check only).
$Walk = $(if ($Again) { @() } else { @(Get-WalkPlan) })
'@ }

'// R7 (R32 W2): the mouse wheel scrolls what is under the pointer, whatever control has the focus.',
'public class Wheel : IMessageFilter {',
'public const int WM_MOUSEWHEEL = 0x020A;',
'public Form Owner = null;',
'public Control Stop = null;',
'// The message filter: a wheel message for a control of Owner goes to Route; true = handled here. The pointer comes',
'// in screen pixels; it is turned into the client pixels of Owner once, and the rest is the managed control tree.',
'public bool PreFilterMessage(ref Message m) {',
'if (m.Msg != WM_MOUSEWHEEL || Owner == null || Owner.IsDisposed || !Owner.IsHandleCreated) { return false; }',
'Control from = Control.FromChildHandle(m.HWnd);',
'if (from == null || from.FindForm() != Owner) { return false; }',
'long lp = m.LParam.ToInt64();',
'Point pt = new Point((short)(lp & 0xFFFF), (short)((lp >> 16) & 0xFFFF));',
'int delta = (short)((m.WParam.ToInt64() >> 16) & 0xFFFF);',
'return Route(Owner, Stop, Owner.PointToClient(pt), delta) != null;',
'}',
'// A wheel message as Windows sends it: the pointer in screen pixels, delta 120 per notch (positive = away from you).',
'public static Message Make(IntPtr hwnd, Point screen, int delta) {',
'uint wp = ((uint)(delta & 0xFFFF)) << 16;',
'uint lp = (((uint)(screen.Y & 0xFFFF)) << 16) | ((uint)(screen.X & 0xFFFF));',
'return Message.Create(hwnd, WM_MOUSEWHEEL, new IntPtr(unchecked((int)wp)), new IntPtr(unchecked((int)lp)));',
'}',
'// The client origin of c in the client pixels of root: the sum of the Locations up the parents (a child Location is',
'// in its parent client pixels, scroll included; the containers here have no border).',
'public static Point ClientOf(Control c, Control root) {',
'int x = 0, y = 0;',
'for (Control k = c; k != null && k != root; k = k.Parent) { x += k.Left; y += k.Top; }',
'return new Point(x, y);',
'}',
'// The deepest visible control of root under a point in root client pixels, from the control tree (front child first,',
'// as Windows hit-tests): a point outside a control client area (its scroll bar) stops at that control.',
'public static Control Under(Control root, Point client) {',
'Control c = root;',
'Point p = client;',
'while (true) {',
'if (!c.ClientRectangle.Contains(p)) { return c; }',
'Control hit = null;',
'foreach (Control k in c.Controls) { if (k.Visible && k.Bounds.Contains(p)) { hit = k; break; } }',
'if (hit == null) { return c; }',
'p = new Point(p.X - hit.Left, p.Y - hit.Top);',
'c = hit;',
'}',
'}',
'// Routes one wheel turn at a point in root client pixels: the control it scrolls (it is scrolled), or null when the',
'// pointer is not on the window, is on a list or a text box with its own scroll bar, or nothing under it can scroll.',
'public static Control Route(Control root, Control stop, Point client, int delta) {',
'if (delta == 0 || !root.ClientRectangle.Contains(client)) { return null; }',
'Control under = Under(root, client);',
'if (under is ComboBox) { return null; }',
'TextBoxBase tb = under as TextBoxBase;',
'if (tb != null && tb.Multiline && tb.TabStop) { return null; }',
'Control t = Target(under, stop, delta);',
'if (t != null) { Apply(t, delta); }',
'return t;',
'}',
'// The first control from under up to stop that can still scroll that way: a grid with rows out of view, or a',
'// panel that scrolls (AutoScroll with its vertical bar showing).',
'public static Control Target(Control under, Control stop, int delta) {',
'for (Control c = under; c != null; c = c.Parent) {',
'DataGridView g = c as DataGridView;',
'if (g != null && GridCan(g, delta)) { return g; }',
'ScrollableControl s = c as ScrollableControl;',
'if (s != null && s.AutoScroll && s.VerticalScroll.Visible && PanelCan(s, delta)) { return s; }',
'if (c == stop) { break; }',
'}',
'return null;',
'}',
'// True when grid g can scroll up (delta > 0) or down.',
'public static bool GridCan(DataGridView g, int delta) {',
'if (g.RowCount == 0 || g.FirstDisplayedScrollingRowIndex < 0) { return false; }',
'if (delta > 0) { return g.FirstDisplayedScrollingRowIndex > 0; }',
'return g.FirstDisplayedScrollingRowIndex + g.DisplayedRowCount(false) < g.RowCount;',
'}',
'// True when panel s can scroll up (delta > 0) or down.',
'public static bool PanelCan(ScrollableControl s, int delta) {',
'int y = -s.AutoScrollPosition.Y;',
'if (delta > 0) { return y > 0; }',
'return y < s.DisplayRectangle.Height - s.ClientSize.Height;',
'}',
'// Scrolls t: a grid by the Windows wheel lines per notch (rows), a panel by delta pixels, as a panel does by itself.',
'public static void Apply(Control t, int delta) {',
'DataGridView g = t as DataGridView;',
'if (g != null) {',
'int lines = SystemInformation.MouseWheelScrollLines;',
'if (lines <= 0) { lines = Math.Max(1, g.DisplayedRowCount(false)); }',
'int rows = (int)Math.Round(-delta / 120.0 * lines);',
'if (rows == 0) { rows = delta > 0 ? -1 : 1; }',
'g.FirstDisplayedScrollingRowIndex = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(g.RowCount - 1, g.FirstDisplayedScrollingRowIndex + rows));',
'return;',
'}',
'ScrollableControl s = (ScrollableControl)t;',
's.AutoScrollPosition = new Point(-s.AutoScrollPosition.X, -s.AutoScrollPosition.Y - delta);',
'}',
'}',
'// R8 (R35 W7, R34 finding 7): the logo in 2 colors for Windows high contrast, and the counts that prove it. Each',
'// reads the pixels of the bitmap it is given (no copy, so no cover is rounded).',
'public static class Logo {',
'// A copy of src in 2 colors: each pixel keeps its cover (alpha); a dark pixel takes dark, a light one light.',
'// Light: a weighted brightness of 128 or more (of 255): the white rings and page and the yellow arc; dark: the blue disc and Z.',
'public static Bitmap TwoTone(Bitmap src, Color dark, Color light) {',
'Bitmap o = new Bitmap(src.Width, src.Height, System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);',
'for (int y = 0; y < src.Height; y++) {',
'for (int x = 0; x < src.Width; x++) {',
'Color c = src.GetPixel(x, y);',
'if (c.A == 0) { continue; }',
'Color t = (c.R * 299 + c.G * 587 + c.B * 114) >= 128000 ? light : dark;',
'o.SetPixel(x, y, Color.FromArgb(c.A, t.R, t.G, t.B));',
'}',
'}',
'return o;',
'}',
'// The number of pixels of b with any cover whose color (cover left out) is neither p nor q.',
'public static int Other(Bitmap b, Color p, Color q) {',
'int n = 0;',
'for (int y = 0; y < b.Height; y++) {',
'for (int x = 0; x < b.Width; x++) {',
'Color c = b.GetPixel(x, y);',
'if (c.A == 0) { continue; }',
'if (!Same(c, p) && !Same(c, q)) { n++; }',
'}',
'}',
'return n;',
'}',
'// The number of pixels whose color or cover differs between a and b; -1 when their sizes differ.',
'public static int Diff(Bitmap a, Bitmap b) {',
'if (a.Width != b.Width || a.Height != b.Height) { return -1; }',
'int n = 0;',
'for (int j = 0; j < a.Height; j++) {',
'for (int i = 0; i < a.Width; i++) {',
'Color c = a.GetPixel(i, j);',
'Color d = b.GetPixel(i, j);',
'if (c.A != d.A || (c.A != 0 && !Same(c, d))) { n++; }',
'}',
'}',
'return n;',
'}',
'static bool Same(Color a, Color b) { return a.R == b.R && a.G == b.G && a.B == b.B; }',
'}',
'}'
) -join "`r`n")

'public static class Native {',
'[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool HideCaret(IntPtr hWnd);',
'}',
'}'
) -join "`r`n")

if (-not ('Rade.Native' -as [type])) { try { Add-Type -TypeDefinition $NativeCs } catch { $null = $_ } }
'@ }

<#

# ---- Scale and colors
# One scale source (R24: the screen dpi said 96 while Windows Forms scaled every control 1.5 x): $ui.Dpi is the dpi the
# form scales to (its auto-scale dimensions; the form's sizes are given at 96). Every size RADE sets or draws after the
# form has scaled goes through $ui.Sc. The screen dpi is only reported (the SCALE line).
try { $gx = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromHwnd([IntPtr]::Zero); $ui.ScreenDpi = [double]$gx.DpiX; $gx.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ }
$ui.FormDpi = { try { $d = [double]$ui.Form.CurrentAutoScaleDimensions.Width; if ($d -gt 0) { $ui.Dpi = $d } } catch { $null = $_ } }
$ui.Sc = { param([double]$Px) [int][math]::Round($Px * $ui.Dpi / 96.0) }   # a size at 100 % in screen pixels, for parts made or drawn after the form has scaled

$ui.Standard = 'v1'

# Sizes, gaps and field widths, in pixels at 100 % (every size set after the form has scaled goes through $ui.Sc).

  G1 = 4; G2 = 8; G3 = 12; G4 = 16; G6 = 24

# Faces: name = @(family, the font file's name in the bundle ('' = none), the family used when the font cannot be loaded).

# Text styles: name = @(face, size in points at 100 %, font style ('' = regular)); uses: the file.

# ---- End of the UI tokens
# ---- Colors and Windows contrast themes (UI standard v1, the Administrator, 2026-11-20; docs/ui-standard.md B10, B11)
# One meaning each (the "use" of each token above): navy = card text, Air Force blue = the action and progress, yellow =
# your turn, dark red = FAILED, NEEDS REVIEW and the one destructive action, green = passed. Every text pair is at least
# 4.5:1 and every non-text pair 3:1 (scripts/ui_tokens.py computes them from engine/ui-tokens.json). While a Windows
# contrast theme is on (SystemInformation.HighContrast), each token is the system color of its role, so the window has
# the theme's colors; $ui.Recolor follows a theme that changes while the window is open.
$ui.HighOn = { try { return [bool][System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::HighContrast } catch { return $false } }   # no answer (an old host): the own colors
# The color of one token: its own color, or while $ui.High is on the system color of its role. Takes the token name; gives
# back a Color (WindowText for a name that is not a token, so no text is ever lost).
$ui.Color = { param([string]$Role)
  $t = $ui.Tok[$Role]
  if ($ui.High) { $r = $(if ($t) { [string]$t[3] } else { 'WindowText' }); try { $sc = [System.Drawing.SystemColors]::$r; if ($null -eq $sc) { $sc = [System.Drawing.SystemColors]::WindowText }; return $sc } catch { return [System.Drawing.Color]::Black } }   # a role with no color: WindowText; no system colors: black
  if (-not $t) { return [System.Drawing.Color]::Black }
  return [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb([int]$t[0], [int]$t[1], [int]$t[2]) }
# Puts the colors for a theme into $ui.C in place (every builder and paint handler reads them there). Takes $true for the
# system colors of a contrast theme, $false for the own colors.
$ui.UseColors = { param([bool]$High) $ui.High = $High; foreach ($k in @($ui.Tok.Keys)) { $ui.C[$k] = & $ui.Color $k } }
$ui.C = @{}; & $ui.UseColors (& $ui.HighOn)
# ---- Fonts, sizes and buttons
# Cosmetics never stop the window (R06: Font('Segoe UI', 10, 'Bold') failed with "Multiple ambiguous overloads"): a typed
# style and size, and the window font when a font cannot be made.
$ui.Bold = [Enum]::Parse(('System.Drawing.FontStyle' -as [type]), 'Bold')
# $Pt is the size at 100 % scaling; $ui.FontK (R28: text scales with the controls) makes it as much bigger as the controls are.
$ui.Font = { param([string]$Fam, [double]$Pt, $Style) try { $pk = [single]($Pt * $ui.FontK); if ($null -ne $Style) { return (New-Object System.Drawing.Font($Fam, $pk, $Style)) }; return (New-Object System.Drawing.Font($Fam, $pk)) } catch { return $ui.Form.Font } }
# FontScale: how much bigger than the screen's own text scaling the fonts must be, so that text follows the controls. A probe
# font of 100 pt Segoe UI is 177 px tall when the screen draws text at 96 dpi; its real height gives the dpi the text is drawn
# at. On the R25 device (autoScale 144, text at 96) the answer is 1.5; where Windows scales both, it is 1. The factor is
# kept to steps of 0.25 (the Windows scales); anything odd gives 1.
$ui.FontScale = { $ui.FontK = 1.0; $ui.FontDpi = 96.0
  try { $pf = New-Object System.Drawing.Font('Segoe UI', [single]100); $r = [double]$pf.Height / 177.3; try { $pf.Dispose() } catch { $null = $_ }
    if ($r -gt 0.6 -and $r -lt 4) { $k = [math]::Round(($ui.Dpi / 96.0) / $r * 4) / 4; if ($k -ge 0.5 -and $k -le 4) { $ui.FontK = [double]$k }; $ui.FontDpi = 96.0 * [math]::Max(1.0, [math]::Round($r * 4) / 4) } } catch { $null = $_ } }
# ---- The RADE fonts (UI standard v1, the Administrator, 2026-11-20; docs/ui-standard.md B12): Sofia Sans Condensed for
# titles and Sofia Sans for text, open fonts (engine/fonts/OFL.txt) that the bundle carries as base64 ($fontTtf). They are
# loaded for this process only (no install, no administrator): GDI+ gets them in a PrivateFontCollection (the Font objects)
# and GDI gets the same bytes as a memory font (AddFontMemResourceEx), because Windows Forms draws labels, boxes and
# buttons with GDI, which knows no GDI+ private font. A font that cannot be loaded is replaced by its face's fallback
# (Segoe UI), so the window always opens. $ui.FontNote says what was loaded (the SCALE line).
$ui.FontFam = @{}; $ui.FontMem = @(); $ui.FontNote = 'fallback (no font files)'
$ui.LoadFonts = {
  <#
  .SYNOPSIS
  Loads the fonts of $fontTtf (the bundle's base64 font files) for this process.
  .DESCRIPTION
  Each file goes into one PrivateFontCollection (GDI+) and, when the native type can be made, into GDI as a memory font.
  The memory of each file stays held while the process runs (GDI+ reads it when it draws). A bundle with no $fontTtf
  (an app window that copies this file) and any failure leave $ui.FontFam empty: every style then uses its fallback.
  .OUTPUTS
  Nothing. Fills $ui.FontFam (family name = FontFamily) and sets $ui.FontNote.
  #>
  $ttf = $null; try { $ttf = $fontTtf } catch { $null = $_ }   # no font files (an app window that copies this file; strict mode): the fallback fonts
  if (-not $ttf -or -not $ttf.Count) { return }
  $gdi = $false
  try { if (-not ('Rade.Fonts' -as [type])) { Add-Type -Namespace Rade -Name Fonts -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("gdi32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr AddFontMemResourceEx(IntPtr pbFont, uint cbFont, IntPtr pdv, ref uint pcFonts);' -ErrorAction Stop }; $gdi = $true } catch { $null = $_ }   # no GDI copy: GDI+ text still has the fonts
  try { $pfc = New-Object System.Drawing.Text.PrivateFontCollection; $n = 0
    foreach ($k in @($ttf.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
      $b = [Convert]::FromBase64String([string]$ttf[$k]); $p = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocCoTaskMem($b.Length)
      [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy($b, 0, $p, $b.Length); $ui.FontMem += $p; $pfc.AddMemoryFont($p, $b.Length); $n++
      if ($gdi) { $c = [uint32]0; if ([Rade.Fonts]::AddFontMemResourceEx($p, [uint32]$b.Length, [IntPtr]::Zero, [ref]$c) -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { $gdi = $false } } }   # a failed GDI load: the note says GDI+ only
    foreach ($fm in @($pfc.Families)) { $ui.FontFam[[string]$fm.Name] = $fm }
    $ui.Pfc = $pfc; $ui.FontNote = 'loaded ' + $n + ' files, ' + $ui.FontFam.Count + ' families' + $(if ($gdi) { '' } else { ' (GDI+ only)' })
  } catch { $ui.FontFam = @{}; $ui.FontNote = 'fallback (' + [string]$_.Exception.GetType().Name + ')' } }   # never stop the window for a font
# The font of one text style ($ui.Styles): its face's font when it was loaded, else the face's fallback ($ui.Font). Takes
# the style name; gives back a Font.
$ui.StyleFont = { param([string]$Name)
  $s = $ui.Styles[$Name]; $face = $ui.Faces[[string]$s[0]]; $pt = [double]$s[1]
  $st = $(if ([string]$s[2]) { [Enum]::Parse(('System.Drawing.FontStyle' -as [type]), [string]$s[2]) } else { $null })
  $fm = $ui.FontFam[[string]$face[0]]   # no System.Drawing type names in this block: on the test stand-ins they would stop it as it is read
  if ($fm) { $gu = $null; $rg = $null; try { $rg = [Enum]::Parse(('System.Drawing.FontStyle' -as [type]), 'Regular'); $gu = [Enum]::Parse(('System.Drawing.GraphicsUnit' -as [type]), 'Point') } catch { $null = $_ }   # no types: the fallback below
    foreach ($fs in @(@($st, $rg) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })) { try { return (New-Object System.Drawing.Font($fm, [single]($pt * $ui.FontK), $fs, $gu)) } catch { $null = $_ } } }   # a style the one-weight file lacks (Bold): its own weight
  return (& $ui.Font ([string]$face[2]) $pt $st) }
& $ui.FormDpi; & $ui.FontScale; & $ui.LoadFonts; $ui.Form.Font = (& $ui.StyleFont 'Small')
# Text styles (the Administrator, 2026-11-17; faces and sizes from the UI tokens, UI standard v1): Sent = headline; Body =
# paragraphs, step lines, help line; Small = second lines, notes, box text; SmallB = the line in capitals, labels, every
# button, key numbers, the Record's heads and result words; Link = SmallB underlined (a link is marked by more than
# color); Word = RADE in the logo line; Mono = the Record's text box only; Turn = "Your turn" (in the accent color).
$ui.F = @{}; foreach ($k in @($ui.Styles.Keys)) { $ui.F[$k] = & $ui.StyleFont $k }; $ui.F.Small = $ui.Form.Font
# Sizes: the UI tokens above (gaps 4, 8, 12, 16, 24; a 4 px margin around a button or link for its focus ring).
$ui.Pad = { param([int]$L, [int]$T, [int]$R, [int]$B) New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($L, $T, $R, $B) }
$ui.Label = { param($Font, $Color, [int]$Top) $l = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label; $l.AutoSize = $true; $l.Font = $Font; $l.ForeColor = $Color; $l.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $l.UseMnemonic = $false; $l.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 $Top 0 0); $l.Visible = $false; $l }
# ---- Card text that can be selected (R28, the Administrator, 2026-11-17)
# The headline, the lines, the help, the notes and the questions of a card are read-only, borderless text boxes: the same look as
# a label, but the text can be highlighted and copied (Ctrl+C, or right-click: Copy, Select All). No tab stop, no caret shown.
# A text box does not size itself to its text, so $ui.Reflow gives it the size the text needs (measured as the edit control wraps:
# WordBreak, TextBoxControl) whenever its text, its font or its wrap width changes. The wrap width is $ui.Wrap[box] (set with
# $ui.SetWrap): a text box's own MaximumSize would cut the few extra pixels the edit control keeps at its edges.
$ui.Wrap = @{}
# A text box with a fixed number of lines ($ui.Hold[box] = n): $ui.Reflow makes it n lines tall whatever its text, also with no
# text, so the parts under it never move when the text changes (the Run card's now-doing line: the Administrator, 2026-11-19,
# "the cancel button jumps up and down"). Its text is cut to n lines with $ui.FitLines.
$ui.Hold = @{}
# A text box with a least number of lines ($ui.MinLines[box] = n): at least n lines tall, also with no text (the line in
# capitals: the "Your turn" line under it never moves up on a card with no line).
$ui.MinLines = @{}
# A text box that shows changing values ($ui.Range[box] = every text it can show on this card, set by $ui.SetCard): it is as
# wide and as tall as the largest of them, so a new value never moves or resizes a part of the card (the Administrator,
# 2026-11-19: "values cause fluttering and distortion as things fly around").
$ui.Range = @{}
$ui.GetWrap = { param($C) if ($C -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBox]) { return [int]$ui.Wrap[$C] }; return [int]$C.MaximumSize.Width }
$ui.SetWrap = { param($C, [int]$W) if ($C -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBox]) { $ui.Wrap[$C] = $W; & $ui.Reflow $C } else { $C.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($W, 0) } }
$ui.Reflow = { param($T)
  try { $txt = [string]$T.Text; $n = [int]$ui.Hold[$T]
    if ($n -gt 0) {   # a fixed number of lines: as wide as its wrap width, n lines tall
      $w = [int]$ui.Wrap[$T]; $one = & $ui.Meas 'Ag' $T.Font 100000
      $ns = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($(if ($w -gt 0) { $w + (& $ui.Sc 4) } else { $one.Width }), ($n * $one.Height + (& $ui.Sc 2))); if ($T.Width -ne $ns.Width -or $T.Height -ne $ns.Height) { $T.Size = $ns }; return }
    $all = @(@($ui.Range[$T]) + @($txt) | Where-Object { $_ }); $m = [int]$ui.MinLines[$T]; if (-not $all.Count -and $m -le 0) { return }   # its text and its range
    $w = [int]$ui.Wrap[$T]; $bw = 0; $bh = 0
    foreach ($x in $all) { $s = & $ui.TextSize ([string]$x) $T.Font $w; $bw = [math]::Max($bw, $s.Width); $bh = [math]::Max($bh, $s.Height) }
    if ($m -gt 0) { $bw = [math]::Max($bw, (& $ui.Sc 4)); $bh = [math]::Max($bh, ($m * (& $ui.Meas 'Ag' $T.Font 100000).Height + (& $ui.Sc 2))) }
    $ns = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($bw, $bh); if ($T.Width -ne $ns.Width -or $T.Height -ne $ns.Height) { $T.Size = $ns } } catch { $null = $_ } }
# The size a card text box needs for one text: as the edit control wraps it at the wrap width (0: no wrap), with the few
# pixels the control keeps at its edges. Takes the text, the font and the wrap width; gives back the size.
$ui.TextSize = { param([string]$Txt, $Font, [int]$W)
  $sl = & $ui.Sc 4; $one = & $ui.Meas $Txt $Font 100000; $sz = $one
  if ($W -gt 0 -and $one.Width -gt $W) { $sz = & $ui.Meas $Txt $Font $W; $bw = $W + $sl } else { $bw = $one.Width + 2 * $sl }
  return (New-Object System.Drawing.Size($bw, ($sz.Height + (& $ui.Sc 2)))) }
$ui.Menu = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ContextMenuStrip; $ui.Menu.AccessibleName = 'Text menu'; $ui.MenuCopy = $ui.Menu.Items.Add('Copy'); $ui.MenuAll = $ui.Menu.Items.Add('Select All')
# Copy gives the text as written (R28 N4): a word that RADE broke to fit a line is whole again (the break is a lone line feed), and the
# lines of a hand step (a rich text box) lose the tabs of their number column: "1. Open the page." on its own line.
$ui.CopyText = { param($C)
  try { if (-not ($C -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBoxBase]) -or $C.SelectionLength -le 0) { return $false }
    $s = [string]$C.SelectedText
    if ($C -is [System.Windows.Forms.RichTextBox]) { $s = ($s -replace '\r?\n', "`n" -replace ([string][char]0x2007), '' -replace '\t', ' ') -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    elseif (& $ui.IsCardText $C) { $s = $s -replace '(?<!\r)\n', '' }
    if ($s) { [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($s); return $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
  return $false }
# R34 (the PFM: the answer box did not take a pasted block): a one-line box keeps only the first line of a paste, so a
# paste into it comes here. $ui.OneLine joins the lines of a text with one space and cuts it to the room that is left.
# Takes the text and the room (characters); gives back the text to put in.
$ui.OneLine = { param([string]$T, [int]$Room) $s = ($T -replace '\s*(\r\n|\r|\n)\s*', ' ' -replace '\t', ' ').Trim(); if ($Room -lt 0) { $Room = 0 }; if ($s.Length -gt $Room) { $s = $s.Substring(0, $Room) }; return $s }
# Pastes the clipboard text into a one-line text box as one line, in place of its selection. When the text is longer
# than the room, it is cut and the gray line under the box says how many characters did not fit (R7, the Administrator,
# 2026-11-19; docs/window-design.md "Cards"). Takes the box; gives back $true when it pasted (the key is then handled),
# $false when the clipboard has no text or the box is multi-line.
$ui.PasteLine = { param($Tb)
  try { if ($Tb.Multiline -or $Tb.ReadOnly -or -not [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::ContainsText()) { return $false }
    $room = [int]$Tb.MaxLength - ([string]$Tb.Text).Length + [int]$Tb.SelectionLength
    $whole = & $ui.OneLine ([System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetText()) ([int]::MaxValue)
    $Tb.SelectedText = & $ui.OneLine $whole $room
    $lost = $whole.Length - [math]::Max(0, $room)
    $msg = $(if ($lost -gt 0) { 'The paste was too long: ' + $lost.ToString('N0', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) + $(if ($lost -eq 1) { ' character did' } else { ' characters did' }) + ' not fit.' } else { '' })
    if ($msg) { & $ui.Say1 $msg; $ui.PasteNote = $msg } elseif ($ui.PasteNote -and [string]$ui.Note.Text -ceq [string]$ui.PasteNote) { & $ui.Say1 ''; $ui.PasteNote = '' }   # clear only a note this paste wrote
    return $true } catch { return $false } }
$ui.MenuCopy.Add_Click({ $null = & $ui.CopyText $ui.Menu.SourceControl })
$ui.MenuAll.Add_Click({ try { $ui.Menu.SourceControl.SelectAll() } catch { $null = $_ } })
$ui.Menu.Add_Opening({ try { $ui.MenuCopy.Enabled = [bool]($ui.Menu.SourceControl.SelectionLength -gt 0) } catch { $null = $_ } })
$ui.NoCaret = { param($C) try { if ($script:native) { $null = [Rade.Native]::HideCaret($C.Handle) } } catch { $null = $_ } }
$ui.Text = { param($Font, $Color, [int]$Top, [string]$Name)
  $t = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox; $t.Multiline = $true; $t.ReadOnly = $true; $t.WordWrap = $true; $t.ScrollBars = 'None'; $t.BorderStyle = 'None'; $t.TabStop = $false; $t.AutoSize = $false
  $t.Font = $Font; $t.ForeColor = $Color; $t.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $t.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 $Top 0 0); $t.Visible = $false; $t.ContextMenuStrip = $ui.Menu; $t.AccessibleName = $Name
  $ui.Wrap[$t] = 0; $t.Add_TextChanged({ & $ui.Reflow $this }); $t.Add_FontChanged({ & $ui.Reflow $this })
  $t.Add_GotFocus({ & $ui.NoCaret $this }); $t.Add_MouseUp({ & $ui.NoCaret $this }); $t.Add_KeyUp({ & $ui.NoCaret $this }); $t }
$ui.InField = { $a = $ui.Form.ActiveControl; return [bool](($a -is [System.Windows.Forms.TextBox]) -and $a.TabStop) }   # a box the user types in (card text is not one)
$ui.Flow = { param([int]$Top) $f = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FlowLayoutPanel; $f.AutoSize = $true; $f.WrapContents = $false; $f.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $f.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 $Top 0 0); $f.Visible = $false; $f }
# Focus is always visible: a 2 px navy ring around the control that has it, drawn by its parent ($ui.Ring), also after a
# mouse click. Each focusable control tells its parent to repaint ($ui.Cue) and keeps a 4 px margin for the ring.
$ui.Cue = { param($C) $C.Add_GotFocus({ try { $this.Parent.Invalidate() } catch { $null = $_ } }); $C.Add_LostFocus({ try { $this.Parent.Invalidate() } catch { $null = $_ } }) }
$ui.Ring = { param($P) $P.Add_Paint({ try { foreach ($c in $this.Controls) { if (($c.Focused -or ($ui.Boxes -contains $c -and $c.ContainsFocus)) -and $c.Visible) {
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Focus, [single](& $ui.Sc 2)); $b = $c.Bounds; $o = & $ui.Sc 2; $_.Graphics.DrawRectangle($pn, ($b.Left - $o), ($b.Top - $o), ($b.Width + 2 * $o - 1), ($b.Height + 2 * $o - 1)); $pn.Dispose() } } } catch { $null = $_ } }) }
$ui.Style = { param($B, [string]$Kind)
  # primary = Air Force blue; danger = dark red; off = not available (gray, text 6.3:1); dangeroff = the destructive
  # action while it is not available (gray, dark red text and edge, 8:1); else white with a gray edge. The colors under
  # the pointer and while pressed are set here too (Windows picks its own otherwise): a white button goes to the hair
  # and the off gray, a blue or dark red button keeps its color.
  $ui.Kinds[$B] = $Kind; $B.Enabled = ($Kind -notin 'off', 'dangeroff'); $B.FlatStyle = 'Flat'; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 1; $B.Font = $ui.F.SmallB; $over = $null; $down = $null
  if ($Kind -eq 'off') { $B.BackColor = $ui.C.Off; $B.ForeColor = $ui.C.OffInk; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = $ui.C.Track }
  elseif ($Kind -eq 'dangeroff') { $B.BackColor = $ui.C.Off; $B.ForeColor = $ui.C.Red; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = $ui.C.Red }
  elseif ($Kind -eq 'primary') { $B.BackColor = $ui.C.Blue; $B.ForeColor = $ui.C.OnBlue; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = $ui.C.Blue }
  elseif ($Kind -eq 'danger') { $B.BackColor = $ui.C.Red; $B.ForeColor = $ui.C.White; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = $ui.C.Red }
  else { $B.BackColor = $ui.C.Face; $B.ForeColor = $ui.C.FaceInk; $B.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = $ui.C.Edge; $over = $ui.C.Hair; $down = $ui.C.Off }
  if (-not $over) { $over = $B.BackColor; $down = $B.BackColor }
  try { $B.FlatAppearance.MouseOverBackColor = $over; $B.FlatAppearance.MouseDownBackColor = $down } catch { $null = $_ } }
# Every button draws its own face, border and text in every state (normal, under the pointer, pressed, focused, default,
# not available), over what Windows drew: no theme border, no black default-button border, no dotted focus rectangle
# (R24: a black or gray outline on a work computer). The focus is the navy ring its parent draws ($ui.Ring).
$ui.Hot = $null; $ui.Down = $null
# A card's buttons and choices take no click in the first $ui.GuardMs (400) ms after the card changed (R2 review: the second
# click of a double-click on Done answered the first question unseen). Enter and Space click the same buttons: same guard.
# Monotonic time (a Stopwatch, not the wall clock: M1 review); a negative elapsed time never blocks a click.
$ui.Settled = { $e = $ui.Clock.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds - [double]$ui.CardAt; ($e -ge $ui.GuardMs -or $e -lt 0) }
$ui.Face = { param($B, $G) try { if (-not $B.Text) { return }
    $w = $B.ClientSize.Width; $h = $B.ClientSize.Height; $fa = $B.FlatAppearance
    # While RADE is busy a button does nothing, so it looks like one that is not available (R28), except the ones marked to work then (Cancel).
    $busy = [bool]($ui.Busy -and -not (($B.Tag -is [int]) -and $ui.Always[[int]$B.Tag]))
    $bg = $(if ($busy -and [int]$fa.BorderSize -gt 0) { $ui.C.Off } elseif (-not $B.Enabled) { $B.BackColor } elseif ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Down, $B)) { $fa.MouseDownBackColor } elseif ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Hot, $B)) { $fa.MouseOverBackColor } else { $B.BackColor })
    $G.Clear($bg)
    if ([int]$fa.BorderSize -gt 0) { $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($(if ($busy) { $ui.C.Track } else { $fa.BorderColor })); $G.DrawRectangle($pn, 0, 0, ($w - 1), ($h - 1)); $pn.Dispose() }
    # A link (no edge) draws its text at the left, a button in the middle (R28: a link in a wide box started 38 px right of the card edge).
    & $ui.Word $G ([string]$B.Text) $B.Font $(if ($busy) { $ui.C.OffInk } else { $B.ForeColor }) 0 0 $w $h $(if ([int]$fa.BorderSize -gt 0) { 'HorizontalCenter, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine' } else { 'Left, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }) } catch { $null = $_ } }
$ui.Own = { param($B) $B.UseVisualStyleBackColor = $false; $B.Add_Paint({ & $ui.Face $this $_.Graphics })
  $B.Add_MouseEnter({ $ui.Hot = $this; $this.Invalidate() }); $B.Add_MouseLeave({ if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Hot, $this)) { $ui.Hot = $null }; $this.Invalidate() })
  $B.Add_MouseDown({ if ([string]$_.Button -eq 'Left') { $ui.Down = $this; $this.Invalidate() } }); $B.Add_MouseUp({ $ui.Down = $null; $this.Invalidate() })
  $B.Add_VisibleChanged({ if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Hot, $this)) { $ui.Hot = $null }; if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Down, $this)) { $ui.Down = $null } }) }
# Buttons have fixed sizes (UI standard v1, B1; the Administrator, 2026-11-20): no AutoSize, so a button never grows or
# shrinks with its text. $Kind: 'action' (a card's buttons: 160 x 40, or 240 x 40 when its label needs more room) or
# 'compact' (96 x 30: beside a box, "Back (Esc)", the Record's buttons; 160 x 30 when its label needs more room). A label
# that needs more than the widest size is cut, and the self-check reports it (rule B1). Sizes: $ui.Z.
$ui.BtnKind = @{}
# The size of a button of a kind for its text: at 100 % before the window has its scale (Windows Forms scales it), else scaled.
$ui.BtnSize = { param($B)
  $k = [string]$ui.BtnKind[$B]; $s = $(if ($ui.Scaled) { $ui.Sc } else { { param([double]$Px) [int]$Px } })
  $h = $(if ($k -eq 'compact') { $ui.Z.CompactH } else { $ui.Z.ActionH }); $ws = $(if ($k -eq 'compact') { @($ui.Z.CompactW, $ui.Z.ActionW) } else { @($ui.Z.ActionW, $ui.Z.WideW) })
  $need = 0; try { if ($B.Text) { $need = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$B.Text, $B.Font).Width + (& $ui.Sc (2 * $ui.Z.G2)) } } catch { $null = $_ }   # no measure: the first width
  $w = $(if ($need -le (& $ui.Sc $ws[0])) { $ws[0] } else { $ws[1] })
  return (New-Object System.Drawing.Size((& $s $w), (& $s $h))) }
# Gives a button the size of its kind for its text ($ui.BtnSize). Takes the button.
$ui.FitBtn = { param($B) try { $ns = & $ui.BtnSize $B; if ($B.Width -ne $ns.Width -or $B.Height -ne $ns.Height) { $B.Size = $ns } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no size now: the next text sets it
$ui.AutoNames = @{}   # the name $ui.AutoName gave each button
# AccessibleName on every control (docs/window-design.md; fleet v2): a button whose name nobody set takes its text and
# follows it when the text changes; a name set by hand stays. Takes the button; gives back nothing.
$ui.AutoName = { param($B) if (-not [string]$B.AccessibleName -or [string]$ui.AutoNames[$B] -eq [string]$B.AccessibleName) {
    $B.AccessibleName = [string]$B.Text; $ui.AutoNames[$B] = [string]$B.Text } }
# Makes a button of a kind ('action' or 'compact'), styled, with its focus ring and own face. Takes the kind; gives back the button.
$ui.Btn = { param([string]$Kind) $b = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $b.AutoSize = $false; $ui.BtnKind[$b] = $(if ($Kind -eq 'compact') { 'compact' } else { 'action' })
  $b.Padding = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.G2 0 $ui.Z.G2 0); $b.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M); $b.UseMnemonic = $false; & $ui.Style $b ''; & $ui.Cue $b; & $ui.Own $b
  & $ui.FitBtn $b; $b.Add_TextChanged({ & $ui.FitBtn $this; & $ui.AutoName $this }); $b }   # gives back the button
$ui.LinkBtn = { param([string]$Text) $b = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $b.Text = $Text; $b.AutoSize = $true; $b.AutoSizeMode = 'GrowAndShrink'; $b.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, $ui.Z.LinkH); $b.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M $ui.Z.M); $b.UseMnemonic = $false
  $b.FlatStyle = 'Flat'; $b.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0; $b.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $b.ForeColor = $ui.C.Link; $b.Font = $ui.F.Link; $ui.Links += $b; try { $b.FlatAppearance.MouseOverBackColor = $ui.C.White; $b.FlatAppearance.MouseDownBackColor = $ui.C.Hair } catch { $null = $_ }; & $ui.Cue $b; & $ui.Own $b   # no hover colors: the link still works
  & $ui.AutoName $b; $b.Add_TextChanged({ & $ui.AutoName $this }); $b }   # a link: Air Force blue, semibold and underlined (not color alone), 28 high
$ui.Kinds = @{}; $ui.Links = @()   # the kind each button was last styled with; every link ($ui.Recolor styles them again)
# ---- A contrast theme that changes while the window is open (UI standard v1, B11; backlog item 24)
# The form's SystemColorsChanged event (Windows sends WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE when a contrast theme comes on or goes off) calls
# $ui.Recolor on the window's own thread: PowerShell code cannot run on the thread of SystemEvents, and the event goes with
# the form when it closes, so nothing is left to detach. $ui.Roles keeps, for each control and color property, the token
# it was painted with (found from the colors it had), so a switch back gives each part its own color again.
$ui.Roles = @{}; $ui.Recolor = {
  <#
  .SYNOPSIS
  Paints the window again in the colors of the current Windows theme (its own colors, or a contrast theme's system colors).
  .DESCRIPTION
  Does nothing when the theme did not change, unless Force is set. Each property gets the color of its token (see above).
  .PARAMETER Force
  $true to paint again also when the theme did not change.
  .OUTPUTS
  Nothing.
  #>
  param([bool]$Force)
  $hi = [bool](& $ui.HighOn); if ($hi -eq [bool]$ui.High -and -not $Force) { return }
  try { $rev = @{}; foreach ($k in @($ui.Tok.Keys)) { $a = $ui.C[$k].ToArgb(); if (-not $rev.ContainsKey($a)) { $rev[$a] = $k } }   # the colors before the change: color -> token
    $todo = New-Object System.Collections.Stack; $todo.Push($ui.Form); $all = @()
    while ($todo.Count) { $c = $todo.Pop(); $all += $c; foreach ($k in @($c.Controls)) { $todo.Push($k) } }
    foreach ($c in $all) { if (-not $ui.Roles.ContainsKey($c)) { $ui.Roles[$c] = @{} }; $r = $ui.Roles[$c]
      foreach ($pp in 'ForeColor', 'BackColor') { try { $a = $c.$pp.ToArgb(); $t0 = [string]$r[$pp]   # the token it had keeps its place while its color is still on the control
          if (-not ($t0 -and $ui.C[$t0].ToArgb() -eq $a)) { $t = $rev[$a]; if ($t) { $r[$pp] = $t } } } catch { $null = $_ } } }   # a color that is no token stays as it is
    & $ui.UseColors $hi
    foreach ($c in $all) { $r = $ui.Roles[$c]; foreach ($pp in @($r.Keys)) { try { $c.$pp = $ui.C[[string]$r[$pp]] } catch { $null = $_ } } }   # a property that cannot be set keeps its color
    foreach ($b in @($ui.Kinds.Keys)) { try { $en = $b.Enabled; & $ui.Style $b ([string]$ui.Kinds[$b]); if ([string]$ui.Kinds[$b] -notin 'off', 'dangeroff') { $b.Enabled = $en } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # a button that is gone: nothing to paint
    foreach ($b in @($ui.Links)) { try { $b.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $b.ForeColor = $ui.C.Link; $b.FlatAppearance.MouseOverBackColor = $ui.C.White; $b.FlatAppearance.MouseDownBackColor = $ui.C.Hair } catch { $null = $_ } }   # same: a link that is gone
    if ($ui.CardNow -and -not $ui.RecOn -and -not $ui.Busy -and -not $ui.Running) { $k = @([string]$ui.Field.Text, [string]$ui.ErrBox.Text, [string]$ui.Note.Text); $on = $ui.LayOn; $ui.LayOn = $false
      try { & $ui.SetCard $ui.CardNow } finally { $ui.LayOn = $on }; $ui.Field.Text = $k[0]; $ui.ErrBox.Text = $k[1]; & $ui.Say1 $k[2] }; $ui.Form.Invalidate($true) } catch { $null = $_ } }   # the card's own colors, typed text kept; never stops the window
# Where ink starts, ink-tight text, long words, shortened text, drawing and measuring ($ui.Ink to $ui.Meas): engine/rade_ui_text.ps1.
# ---- The layout self-check (docs/window-design.md "Proof"): in a test round, and in the Windows job, RADE measures each
# card it showed: a text that needs more room than its control has, a control that a parent cuts, two parts that
# overlap. The result is one line under "Window: OK" in the results e-mail draft ("PASS layout" or the defects), so a
# cut text is found by a measure, not by a person's eye. A deploy does not run it. It reads sizes only.
$ui.LayOn = $false; $ui.LayBad = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; $ui.LaySeen = @{}; $ui.LayCards = @{}; $ui.LayScroll = @{}
try { $ui.LayOn = [bool]([System.Windows.Forms.Application].GetMethod('SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault') -and ($env:RADE_LAYOUT -eq '1' -or @($apps | Where-Object { [string]$_.Mode -ne 'deploy' }).Count)) } catch { $null = $_ }   # the real Windows Forms only: the test stand-ins have no layout
$ui.NameOf = { param($C)
  foreach ($k in @($ui.Keys)) { if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui[$k], $C)) { return [string]$k } }
  foreach ($k in 'B', 'P') { for ($i = 0; $ui[$k] -and $i -lt @($ui[$k]).Count; $i++) { if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($ui[$k][$i], $C)) { return ($k + $i) } } }
  return $C.GetType().Name }
# ---- The alignment rules
# The alignment rules (docs/window-design.md "Sizes"), on measured numbers so the tests can give them a layout:
# RowBad: the parts of an aligned row (@{ N; Top; H; Kind }) share one midpoint within 1 px, and a box and a button in
# it are as tall as each other. EdgeBad: the visible left edges of a card's parts (@{ N; X }) are within 1 px.
$ui.RowBad = { param([string]$Card, [string]$Row, $Parts)
  # A row that wraps (the test extras in a small window) has a midpoint on each line: Line = the top of a part's margin box.
  $out = @(); $byLine = [ordered]@{}; foreach ($q in @($Parts | Where-Object { $_ })) { $k = [string][int]$q.Line; if (-not $byLine.Contains($k)) { $byLine[$k] = @() }; $byLine[$k] += $q }
  if ($byLine.Count -gt 1) { foreach ($k in @($byLine.Keys)) { $out += & $ui.RowBad $Card $Row @($byLine[$k] | ForEach-Object { $c = $_.Clone(); $c.Line = 0; $c }) }; return $out }
  $tol = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.Sc 1)); $ps = @($Parts | Where-Object { $_ }); if ($ps.Count -lt 2) { return $out }
  $m0 = $ps[0].Top + $ps[0].H / 2.0
  foreach ($q in $ps) { $m = $q.Top + $q.H / 2.0; if ([math]::Abs($m - $m0) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' ' + $Row + ' ' + $q.N + ' midpoint: ' + $m + ', the row midpoint is ' + $m0) } }
  $bx = @($ps | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'box' }); $bt = @($ps | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'button' })
  foreach ($a in $bx) { foreach ($b in $bt) { if ([math]::Abs($a.H - $b.H) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' ' + $Row + ' heights: box ' + $a.N + ' ' + $a.H + ', button ' + $b.N + ' ' + $b.H) } } }
  return $out }
$ui.EdgeBad = { param([string]$Card, $Edges)
  $out = @(); $tol = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.Sc 1)); $es = @($Edges | Where-Object { $_ }); if ($es.Count -lt 2) { return $out }
  foreach ($e in $es) { if ([math]::Abs($e.X - $es[0].X) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' ' + $e.N + ' edge: starts at ' + $e.X + ', the card edge is ' + $es[0].X + ' (' + $es[0].N + ')' + $(if ($e.D) { ' [' + $e.D + ']' } else { '' })) } }
  return $out }
# HeadBad (R29b V1): the ink of the word RADE and of the line under it (@{ N; X }) start at the same x; any difference is a defect.
$ui.HeadBad = { param([string]$Card, $Title, $Sub)
  if ([int]$Title.X -eq [int]$Sub.X) { return @() }
  return @('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' header ' + $Sub.N + ' edge: starts at ' + $Sub.X + ', ' + $Title.N + ' starts at ' + $Title.X) }
# HeadRuleBad (L2, the Administrator, 2026-11-19; it replaces the 4 px box gap of R29b V1): without an application logo,
# under the word RADE comes a gap, a thin line as wide as the word's ink and on its left edge, the same gap, then the
# capitals of the application name. Takes the card, the measured numbers @{ WordBottom; WordLeft; WordW; RuleTop;
# RuleBottom; RuleLeft; RuleW; AppTop } (AppTop $null: a name with no capital, digit or tall letter is not measured) and
# the gap it must be (4 px, scaled); the tolerance is 1 px, scaled. Gives back the defect lines.
$ui.HeadRuleBad = { param([string]$Card, $M, [int]$Want)
  $out = @(); $tol = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.Sc 1))
  $g1 = [int]$M.RuleTop - [int]$M.WordBottom; if ([math]::Abs($g1 - $Want) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' header gap: ' + $g1 + ' between the word RADE and the line, the gap is ' + $Want) }
  if ($null -ne $M.AppTop) { $g2 = [int]$M.AppTop - [int]$M.RuleBottom; if ([math]::Abs($g2 - $Want) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' header gap: ' + $g2 + ' between the line and the application name, the gap is ' + $Want) } }
  if ([math]::Abs([int]$M.RuleW - [int]$M.WordW) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' header line: ' + $M.RuleW + ' wide, the word RADE is ' + $M.WordW) }
  if ([math]::Abs([int]$M.RuleLeft - [int]$M.WordLeft) -gt $tol) { $out += ('LAYOUT ' + $Card + ' header line: starts at ' + $M.RuleLeft + ', the word RADE starts at ' + $M.WordLeft) }
  return $out }
# AboveBad (L3, the Administrator, 2026-11-19): a label above its box. The label's bottom is not under the box's top, the
# box starts on the card's edge and it is as wide as the card's text (from the edge to the end of the text column), each
# within 1 px (scaled). Takes the card and @{ LabelBottom; BoxTop; BoxLeft; BoxW; Edge; TextW }; gives back the defect lines.
# <<< rade-ui
'@ }
# ---- File 6 of 29: T22\90161Z-T22-ui2-r15.ps1 (from scripts/gov/90161Z-T22-ui2-r15.ps1, sha256 b0b5c2ca57bf)
$files += @{ Dir = 'T22'; Name = '90161Z-T22-ui2-r15.ps1'; Kind = 'text'; Sha = 'b0b5c2ca57bf'; Data = @'
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 22 r15, part "ui2": the second half of the RADE shared UI file, generated into this file, and the colors
  for Windows high contrast.
.DESCRIPTION
  R11 (R38; PFM 20 Nov 26): new part. engine-v29's shared UI file (599 lines) is split in 2 so each part stays under the
  600-line file cap (code standard C4); scripts/build_task_scripts.py writes the block between the rade-ui-2 markers from
  the pinned RADE commit (scripts/rade.lock.json); never edit it here. It runs right after part "ui", inside the main
  script's try block. The lines after the block choose the colors for Windows high contrast (R31 W2): Select-T22Color
  and $ui.UseColors (the window part applies them: $wn.Recolor).

  $ui.OwnPc, $ui.OwnC, $ui.High, $ui.UseColors and the function Select-T22Color.

  Network: none.
  Writes: none.
  Credentials: none.
