<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 21 probe r12, module "person": the parts Person (the second person for test T4), Ask (the round asks that
  person for a new row, R36) and Clean (removes the person, the list and the library again).
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T21-probe-r12.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values the main file sets ($site, $dir, $StateName, $ListTitle, $ListFolder, $LibTitle, $LibFolder,
  $TestDir, $NoLaunch) and the helpers of the module "common". Outputs: result lines through Add-Item.
  The second person's e-mail address is read in a small window and used in memory only: it is never written to a file,
  a result line or an output stream (tests/ps/Test-T21.ps1 checks this text).
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection.
  Writes: Person: adds one person to the site's Visitors group; on this computer the state file (3 numbers or flags) and
          the clipboard (the new row form link). Ask: the line T4Asked=yes in that state file and the clipboard (the new
          row form link); nothing on the site. Clean: removes that person from Visitors and PFM Office again, moves the probe list
          and library to the site Recycle Bin, deletes the state file.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in); no password is asked for.
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T21-probe-r12.ps1 -Part Person (or Ask, or Clean) loads it.
#>

function Read-PersonAddress {
  # The second person's address, typed by the PFM in a small window. It is returned to the caller and used in memory only; this
  # function writes nothing. In a test run (-TestDir) a fake address may come from the test.
  if ($TestDir -and $env:T21_TEST_ADDRESS) { return ([string]$env:T21_TEST_ADDRESS).Trim() }
  $prompt = 'Type the e-mail address of the second person for test T4 (a person who is not you), then select OK. It is used once, stays on this computer and is not saved or sent.'
  try {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic -ErrorAction Stop
    return ([string][Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction]::InputBox($prompt, '90-161.Z test T4', '')).Trim()
  } catch {
    if ($env:RADE_CONTRACT) { throw 'ADDRESS window not available: the window for the second person could not open on this computer.' }
    return ([string](Read-Host 'E-mail address of the second person (it is not saved), then press Enter')).Trim()
  }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Person, step p3: puts the found person into the Visitors group, unless the person is a member already. The numbers are
  saved in the state file before the change, so Clean can find the person even if this part stops half way.
.DESCRIPTION
  A state file from an earlier run of this part that added a person is kept (review, 17 Nov 26): a second run must not
  turn "added by this test" into "was a member before", or Clean would leave the person in Visitors.
.PARAMETER VisitorId
  The Id of the site's Visitors group.
.PARAMETER UserId
  The site user number of the person.
.PARAMETER LoginName
  The person's login name for Add-PnPGroupMember (used in memory only).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. State ('yes', 'was', 'no' or 'other') and Why (the status text, no identity).
#>
function Add-VisitorMember([int]$VisitorId, [int]$UserId, [string]$LoginName) {
  $state = 'no'; $why = ''
  $was = (Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId
  $old = Read-State $script:dir
  $keep = ($old -and $old['WasMember'] -eq 'no')
  if ($keep -and [int]$old['UserId'] -ne $UserId) {
    $state = 'other'; $why = 'a person added by an earlier run is still on file: run the Clean part first, then this part again'
  } else {
    if ($keep) { $was = $false }
    else {
      $stateLines = @(('UserId=' + $UserId), ('GroupId=' + $VisitorId), ('WasMember=' + $(if ($was) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })))
      Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -Value $stateLines -Encoding ASCII
    }
  }
  if ($state -eq 'other') { $null = $state }
  elseif ($was) { $state = 'was'; $why = 'the person was already a member and stays one' }
  elseif ($keep -and ((Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId)) { $state = 'yes'; $why = 'added by an earlier run of this part; Clean removes the person' }
  else {
    try {
      $null = Add-PnPGroupMember -LoginName $LoginName -Group $VisitorId -ErrorAction Stop
      if ((Get-GroupMemberId $VisitorId) -contains $UserId) { $state = 'yes' } else { $why = 'the group does not list the person after the add' }
    } catch { $why = 'the add was refused: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) }
  }
  return @{ State = $state; Why = $why }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Person, steps p2 and p3: asks for the address, finds the person on the site and adds the person to Visitors. The
  address is read into one variable, used in the next calls and cleared; it is never written, printed or saved.
.PARAMETER VisitorId
  The Id of the site's Visitors group.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. State ('yes', 'was', 'no' or 'other') and Why (the status text, no identity).
#>
function Add-SecondPerson([int]$VisitorId) {
  $result = @{ State = 'no'; Why = '' }
  Write-Now 'Asking for the address of the second person in a small window'
  $personAddr = Read-PersonAddress
  $addrOk = ($personAddr -match '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$')
  if (-not $addrOk) { Add-Item 'p2-person' 'FAIL' 'no valid address was given in the window'; $result.Why = 'no valid address was given' }
  else {
    $userId = 0; $loginName = ''
    Write-Now 'Looking for the second person on the site'
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Post' '_api/web/ensureuser' (@{ logonName = ('i:0#.f|membership|' + $personAddr) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
      if ($raw -match '"Id"\s*:\s*(\d+)') { $userId = [int]$Matches[1] }
      if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
    } catch { $userId = 0 }
    if ($userId -le 0) {
      try {
        $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ("_api/web/siteusers/getbyemail('" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($personAddr) + "')?" + '$select=Id,LoginName') ''
        if ($raw -match '"Id"\s*:\s*(\d+)') { $userId = [int]$Matches[1] }
        if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
      } catch { $userId = 0 }
    }
    if (-not $loginName) { $loginName = 'i:0#.f|membership|' + $personAddr }
    if ($userId -le 0) { Add-Item 'p2-person' 'FAIL' 'the person was not found on this site'; $result.Why = 'the person was not found on this site' }
    else {
      Add-Item 'p2-person' 'PASS' 'the person was found on this site (the site user number is saved in the state file, no address and no name)'
      Write-Now 'Adding the second person to the Visitors group'
      $result = Add-VisitorMember $VisitorId $userId $loginName
      $isIn = ($result.State -eq 'yes' -or $result.State -eq 'was')
      $inText = $(if ($result.State -eq 'no' -or $result.State -eq 'other') { 'no' } else { 'yes' })
      Add-Item 'p3-visitors' $(if ($isIn) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('person in the Visitors group=' + $inText + $(if ($result.Why) { ' (' + $result.Why + ')' } else { '' }))
    }
  }
  $personAddr = $null; $loginName = $null; $raw = $null
  return $result
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Person (T4 retry, PFM 17 Nov 26): the second person is added to the Visitors group with your sign-in, and
  removed again by Clean. Prints "added to Visitors: yes" or "no" and a status, never who; puts the form link on the
  clipboard.
#>
function Invoke-PersonPart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list and the Visitors group'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $visitorId = Get-VisitorGroupId
  $result = @{ State = 'no'; Why = '' }
  if ($visitorId -le 0) { Add-Item 'p1-group' 'FAIL' 'the site has no Visitors group'; $result.Why = 'the site has no Visitors group' }
  else {
    Add-Item 'p1-group' 'PASS' 'the site has a Visitors group'
    $result = Add-SecondPerson $visitorId
  }
  $state = $result.State
  $status = $(if ($state -eq 'yes') { 'added and listed in the group' } elseif ($state -eq 'was') { 'already a member (Clean leaves the person in the group)' } else { $result.Why })
  $script:lines.Add('VISITORS added to Visitors: ' + $(if ($state -eq 'yes') { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; status: ' + $status)
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/NewForm.aspx'); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM p4-link INFO the link of the new row form is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Ask (R36; on this computer only, no sign-in): the round asks the second person to add one new row titled T4a
  through the new row form. Writes T4Asked=yes into the state file of Person (the other lines stay), so Read counts T4
  even when no row came (R35: T4 read FAIL when no step had asked), and puts the link of the new row form on the
  clipboard. With no second person on file it writes nothing and fails.
#>
function Invoke-AskPart {
  Write-Now 'Reading the state file of the second person'
  $st = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $st) { Add-Item 'k1-asked' 'FAIL' 'no second person on file: run the part Person first'; return }
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $StateName
  $keep = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f | Where-Object { [string]$_ -notmatch '^T4Asked=' })
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value (@($keep) + 'T4Asked=yes') -Encoding ASCII
  $ok = ((Read-State $script:dir)['T4Asked'] -eq 'yes')
  Add-Item 'k1-asked' $(if ($ok) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('T4Asked=yes in the state file (Read now counts T4)=' + $(if ($ok) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/NewForm.aspx'); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM k2-link INFO the link of the new row form is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, step c1: removes the second person from the Visitors group again (found by the saved numbers in the state file),
  then deletes the state file. A person who was a member before the test stays. Adds one ITEM line.
#>
function Clear-SecondPerson {
  $state = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $state) { Add-Item 'c1-person' 'PASS' 'no second person on file (nothing to remove)'; return }
  if ($state['WasMember'] -eq 'yes') {
    Add-Item 'c1-person' 'PASS' 'the second person was a Visitors member before the test, so the person stays (state file deleted)'
    try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $null = $_ }
    return
  }
  Write-Now 'Removing the second person from the Visitors group'
  try {
    $uid = [int]$state['UserId']; $gid = 0
    if ($state['GroupId'] -match '^\d+$') { $gid = [int]$state['GroupId'] }
    if ($gid -le 0) { $gid = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/associatedvisitorgroup?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id }
    $members = Get-GroupMemberId $gid
    if ($members -contains $uid) {
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ('_api/web/sitegroups/getbyid(' + $gid + ')/users/removebyid(' + $uid + ')') '{}'
      $members = Get-GroupMemberId $gid
    }
    $still = $members -contains $uid
    $text = $(if (-not $still) { 'the second person is not in the Visitors group (state file deleted)' } else { 'the second person is still in the Visitors group (state file kept; run Clean again)' })
    Add-Item 'c1-person' $(if (-not $still) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $text
    if (-not $still) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $script:dir $StateName) -ErrorAction Stop }
  } catch { Add-Item 'c1-person' 'FAIL' ('the second person could not be removed: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) + ' (state file kept; run Clean again)') }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Clean: runs each step on its own, even if an earlier one failed. First the person (Visitors, then PFM Office:
  module "office"), then the two objects (found
  by their folder name), to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days). The probe flows stay in the solution.
#>
function Invoke-CleanPart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for a second person on file'
  Clear-SecondPerson
  Clear-OfficeMember
  foreach ($o in @(@('c2-list', $ListTitle, $ListFolder), @('c3-library', $LibTitle, $LibFolder))) {
    try {
      $x = Find-ByFolder $o[2]
      if (-not $x) { Add-Item $o[0] 'PASS' ('"' + $o[1] + '" was not on the site (nothing to remove)'); continue }
      Write-Now ('Moving ' + $o[1] + ' to the site Recycle Bin')
      # R29a finding 7: the command returns the Recycle Bin item ID; it is not shown (it reached the log as a raw table).
      $null = Remove-PnPList -Identity ([string]$x.Id) -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      $still = Find-ByFolder $o[2]
      $text = $(if (-not $still) { 'moved to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days)' } else { 'is still on the site' })
      Add-Item $o[0] $(if (-not $still) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('"' + $o[1] + '" ' + $text)
    } catch { Add-Item $o[0] 'FAIL' ('"' + $o[1] + '" could not be removed: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) + ' (run Clean again)') }
  }
  $flows = '"90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" and "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6"'
  $script:lines.Add('NOTE the probe flows ' + $flows + ' are flows of the solution "90-161.Z flows"; this script does not touch flows or solutions')
}
'@ }

$files += @{ Dir = 'T21'; Name = '90161Z-T21-look-r12.ps1'; Kind = 'text'; Sha = '3c665aa995dc'; Data = @'
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 21 probe r12, module "look": the parts Form (a header on the list form) and View (a list view with a
  button that starts the button flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6" of the solution "90-161.Z flows"). The part Look runs
  both.
.DESCRIPTION

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Sets a formatting JSON on a content type (form header) or a view. Easy path first: the CSOM property; then the REST
  merge.
.PARAMETER Kind
  'form' (content type) or 'view'.
.PARAMETER Json
  The formatting JSON text.
.PARAMETER ListId
  The probe list's Id.
.PARAMETER TargetId
  The content type Id (form) or the view Id (view).
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. 'csom', 'rest' or 'none'; the last error text is kept in $script:fmtError.
#>
function Send-Formatter([string]$Kind, [string]$Json, [string]$ListId, [string]$TargetId) {
  $script:fmtError = ''
  try {
    $ctx = Get-PnPContext
    $list = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$ListId)
    if ($Kind -eq 'form') { $t = $list.ContentTypes.GetById($TargetId); $t.ClientFormCustomFormatter = $Json; $t.Update($false) }
    else { $t = $list.Views.GetById([guid]$TargetId); $t.CustomFormatter = $Json; $t.Update() }
    $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
    return 'csom'
  } catch { $script:fmtError = [string]$_.Exception.Message }
  try {
    $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $ListId + "')"
    if ($Kind -eq 'form') {
      $body = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.ContentType' }; ClientFormCustomFormatter = $Json } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Merge' ($lbase + "/contenttypes('" + $TargetId + "')") $body
    } else {
      $body = @{ __metadata = @{ type = 'SP.View' }; CustomFormatter = $Json } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
      $null = Invoke-Rest 'Merge' ($lbase + "/views(guid'" + $TargetId + "')") $body
    }
    return 'rest'
  } catch { $script:fmtError = [string]$_.Exception.Message }
  return 'none'
}

# Finds the probe list or stops the part (Form and View need it).
function Get-ProbeListOrStop {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  return $lst
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Form (a): the header of the list form (the form formatting of the content type), read back from the content
  type. Adds the ITEM line l1-form and the test FORM.
#>
function Invoke-FormPart {
  $lst = Get-ProbeListOrStop
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $lst.Id + "')"
  $ctId = ''
  try { $cts = @(Get-RestValue ($lbase + '/contenttypes?$select=Id,Name')); if ($cts.Count) { $ctId = [string]$cts[0].Id.StringValue } } catch { $ctId = '' }
  $formPass = $false; $route = 'none'; $readBack = 'no'
  if (-not $ctId) { Add-Item 'l1-form' 'FAIL' 'no content type found on the list' }
  else {
    $hdr = [ordered]@{ headerJSONFormatter = [ordered]@{ elmType = 'div'; style = [ordered]@{ padding = '12px'; 'font-size' = '18px'; 'font-weight' = '600' }; txtContent = $HeaderText } }
    Write-Now 'Setting the header on the list form and reading it back'
    $route = Send-Formatter 'form' ($hdr | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress) ([string]$lst.Id) $ctId
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + "/contenttypes('" + $ctId + "')?" + '$select=ClientFormCustomFormatter') ''
      if ($raw.Contains($HeaderText)) { $readBack = 'yes' }
    } catch { $readBack = 'not read' }
    $formPass = ($readBack -eq 'yes')
    $why = $(if ($route -eq 'none') { '; ' + (Format-Detail $script:fmtError) } else { '' })
    Add-Item 'l1-form' $(if ($formPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('header formatting set (route=' + $route + ') and read back from the content type=' + $readBack + $why)
  }
  $summary = 'a header on the list form (form formatting set by script)=' + $(if ($formPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' (route=' + $route + '; read back=' + $readBack + ')'
  Add-Test 'FORM' @($summary + '; what the form shows is left to your answers') $formPass
}

# The button flow's ID from the button-flow-id block (lower case), or '' when the block holds no ID.
function Get-ButtonFlowId {
  $bt = ([string]$ButtonFlowId).Trim()
  if ($bt -match '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$') { return $bt.ToLowerInvariant() }
  return ''
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Makes the view "ProbeButton" when it is missing and returns its Id ('' when it is not there after the create step).
.PARAMETER ListBase
  The REST address of the probe list (_api/web/lists(guid'...')).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Collections.Hashtable. Id (the view Id or '') and Made (1 when the view was made now, else 0).
#>
function Get-ButtonView([string]$ListBase) {
  $viewId = ''
  try { $vs = @(Get-RestValue ($ListBase + '/views?$select=Id,Title') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $ViewTitle }); if ($vs.Count) { $viewId = [string]$vs[0].Id } } catch { $viewId = '' }
  $viewMade = 0
  if (-not $viewId) {
    Write-Now ('Making the view ' + $ViewTitle)
    $null = Add-PnPView -List $ListTitle -Title $ViewTitle -Fields @('Title', 'ProbeTest', 'ProbeResult') -ErrorAction Stop
    $viewMade++
    $vs = @(Get-RestValue ($ListBase + '/views?$select=Id,Title') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Title -eq $ViewTitle }); if ($vs.Count) { $viewId = [string]$vs[0].Id }
  }
  return @{ Id = $viewId; Made = $viewMade }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part View (b): a view with a button that starts the button flow (customRowAction executeFlow with the ID of the
  flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6" from the button-flow-id block), read back from the view. Adds the ITEM line l2-view and
  the test VIEW.
#>
function Invoke-ViewPart {
  $lst = Get-ProbeListOrStop
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $lst.Id + "')"
  $btnId = Get-ButtonFlowId
  if (-not $btnId) {
    Add-Item 'l2-view' 'FAIL' 'no button flow ID in the look module (its button-flow-id block is empty), so the view was not made'
    Add-Test 'VIEW' @('b a view formatted by script with a button that starts a flow=FAIL (flow ID known to the script=no; the build left no ID)') $false
    return
  }
  $view = Get-ButtonView $lbase
  $viewPass = $false; $vroute = 'none'; $vback = 'no'
  if (-not $view.Id) { Add-Item 'l2-view' 'FAIL' 'the view is not on the list after the create step' }
  else {
    $params = '{"id":"' + $btnId + '","headerText":"Run the test flow","runFlowButtonText":"Run"}'
    $fmt = [ordered]@{ '$schema' = 'https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/sp/view-formatting.schema.json'
      rowFormatter = [ordered]@{ elmType = 'div'; style = [ordered]@{ display = 'flex'; 'align-items' = 'center'; padding = '4px' }
        children = @([ordered]@{ elmType = 'span'; style = [ordered]@{ flex = '1' }; txtContent = '[$Title]' },
          [ordered]@{ elmType = 'button'; txtContent = 'Run the test flow'; customRowAction = [ordered]@{ action = 'executeFlow'; actionParams = $params } }) } }
    Write-Now 'Setting the button on the view and reading it back'
    $vroute = Send-Formatter 'view' ($fmt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress) ([string]$lst.Id) $view.Id
    try {
      $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + "/views(guid'" + $view.Id + "')?" + '$select=CustomFormatter') ''
      if ($raw.Contains('executeFlow') -and $raw.Contains($btnId)) { $vback = 'yes' }
    } catch { $vback = 'not read' }
    $viewPass = ($vback -eq 'yes')
    $why = $(if ($vroute -eq 'none') { '; ' + (Format-Detail $script:fmtError) } else { '' })
    Add-Item 'l2-view' $(if ($viewPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('view made now=' + $view.Made + '; formatting set (route=' + $vroute + ') and read back from the view=' + $vback + $why)
  }
  $summary = 'b a view formatted by script with a button that starts a flow=' + $(if ($viewPass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' })
  Add-Test 'VIEW' @($summary + ' (route=' + $vroute + '; read back=' + $vback + '; flow ID known to the script=yes); whether the button runs is read by the Read part') $viewPass
}
'@ }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test HEALTH: the flow "90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" of the solution "90-161.Z flows" ran on the solution's
  SharePoint connection: it writes one RESULT row after the newest command row (r7: it no longer lists flows, because the
  Power Automate Management connector is not in the solution).
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow).
.PARAMETER HealthFloor
  The Id of the newest RUN-HEALTH command row (0 when there is none).
#>
function Add-HealthTest($Rows, [int]$HealthFloor) {
  $name = 'a health flow on the SharePoint connection of the solution='
  $h = $null
  if ($HealthFloor -gt 0) { $h = Find-Result @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Id -gt $HealthFloor }) 'HEALTH' 'a' }
  # R11 (R38; PFM 20 Nov 26: rounds drop steps that passed): no command row means this round did not start the health
  # flow, so one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted (HEALTH passed in R36 and R37).
  if (-not $HealthFloor) { $script:lines.Add('HEALTH NOT RUN: this round did not start the health flow (HEALTH passed in R36 and R37)'); return }
  if (-not $h) {
    $why = 'no result row after the wait: the flow did not run; check that "90161Z T21 Probe Health r6" reads On in the solution "90-161.Z flows"'
    Add-Test 'HEALTH' @($name + 'FAIL (' + $why + ')') $false
  } else {
    $d = Format-Detail $h.ProbeDetail
    Add-Test 'HEALTH' @($name + $h.ProbeResult + $(if ($d) { ' (' + $d + ')' } else { '' })) ($h.ProbeResult -eq 'PASS')
  }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test T4: a person who is a Visitors member writes a row through the list form (list-level Contribute on this list only; the site stays Read).
  Rows by anyone but you count; RESULT rows do not. With no state file and no row by another person the round had no
  second person (R30a: T4 passed in R29a): one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow).
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
#>
function Add-T4Test($Rows, [int]$MeId) {
  $others = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Title -ne 'RESULT' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $MeId })
  $t4a = @($Rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title).Trim() -eq 'T4a' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $MeId })
  $st = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $st -and $others.Count -eq 0) { $script:lines.Add('T4 NOT RUN: no second person in this round (T4 passed in R29a)'); return }
  # R35 (19 Nov 26): a second person was added for EDITALL only, and no step asked for a new row, so T4 read FAIL. T4 counts only
  # when the round asked (T4Asked=yes in the state file) or a row by another person is there.
  if ($others.Count -eq 0 -and -not ($st -and $st['T4Asked'] -eq 'yes')) { $script:lines.Add('T4 NOT RUN: this round did not ask the second person to add a row (T4 passed in R29a)'); return }
  $addedText = $(if (-not $st) { 'not tried (no state file)' } elseif ($st['WasMember'] -eq 'yes') { 'already a member' } else { 'yes' })
  $t4pass = ($others.Count -ge 1)
  $counts = '(rows=' + $others.Count + '; T4a rows=' + $t4a.Count + '; person in the Visitors group=' + $addedText + ')'
  $t4 = @('a list form by a second person (Visitors member)=' + $(if ($t4pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' ' + $counts)
  if (-not $t4pass) {
    $t4 += ('next: the second person opens the new row form link and saves one row; a form that says no permission means the Visitors group' +
      ' does not hold Contribute on this list (the Make part gives it; for the app lists, run T20 r4 and read ITEM W01 to W03)') }
  Add-Test 'T4' $t4 $t4pass
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, test EDITALL (F2 B, PFM 19 Nov 26): the second person, as a PFM Office member, saved the EDITALL row that you wrote
  on the probe list, which is set to "edit own rows". With no office state file and no EDITALL row the round had no
  Office part: one NOT RUN line, no RESULT line, not counted.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The probe list rows (from Get-ListRow, with Author and Editor).
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
#>
function Add-EditAllTest($Rows, [int]$MeId) {
  $mine = @($Rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title) -like 'EDITALL *' -and $MeId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -eq $MeId })
  $st = Read-OfficeState; $ids = @(); if ($st) { $ids = @($st.UserIds) }   # the people the part Office added (module office)
  if (-not $ids.Count -and -not $mine.Count) { $script:lines.Add('EDITALL NOT RUN: no PFM Office test in this round'); return }
  $byOther = @($mine | Where-Object { $e = Get-EditorId $_; $e -gt 0 -and $e -ne $MeId -and (-not $ids.Count -or $ids -contains $e) })
  $pass = ($byOther.Count -ge 1)
  $counts = ' (EDITALL rows by you=' + $mine.Count + '; saved by the second person=' + $byOther.Count + ')'
  $piece = @('a PFM Office member who is not the author edits the row=' + $(if ($pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + $counts)
  if (-not $pass) { $piece += 'next: the second person opens the edit form link, changes the row and saves it; a form that will not save means the level did not give the right' }
  Add-Test 'EDITALL' $piece $pass
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Read: waits for the health flow's row (only when there is a command row), then one test line each for
  HEALTH, T4, EDITALL and BUTTON (counts only).
#>
function Invoke-ReadPart {
  Write-Now 'Reading the rows of the probe list'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $rf = @('Title', 'ProbeTest', 'ProbeWay', 'ProbeResult', 'ProbeDetail', 'Author', 'Editor')
  $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
  # The health flow answers a minute or more after its command row. Wait for it (default 4 minutes) only when there is one.
  $healthFloor = [int](@($rows | Where-Object { $_.Title -like 'RUN-HEALTH *' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Id }) + 0 | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
  if ($healthFloor -gt 0) {
    Write-Now ('Waiting for the health flow''s result row (up to ' + $WaitMinutes + ' minutes)')
    $ok = Wait-Until {
      $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
      [bool](Find-Result @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Id -gt $healthFloor }) 'HEALTH' 'a') } 'the health flow''s result row'
    $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle $rf)
    $script:lines.Add('WAIT health row ' + $(if ($ok) { 'there' } else { 'not there (time ran out)' }))
  } else { $script:lines.Add('WAIT none: no RUN-HEALTH row on the list') }
  $meId = 0
  try { $meId = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' '_api/web/currentuser?$select=Id' '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { $meId = 0 }
  Add-HealthTest $rows $healthFloor
  Add-T4Test $rows $meId
  Add-EditAllTest $rows $meId
  # BUTTON: the button flow "90161Z T21 Probe Button r6", started by the view button, wrote one row titled BTN-FLOW.
  $btn = @($rows | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title).Trim() -like 'BTN-FLOW*' })
  # R11 (R38): with no BTN-FLOW row and no RUN-HEALTH row the round ran no flow step, so BUTTON did not run (one NOT RUN
  # line, not counted; BUTTON passed in R36 and R37). A round with flow steps still reports BUTTON FAIL when the row is missing.
  if (-not $btn.Count -and -not $healthFloor) { $script:lines.Add('BUTTON NOT RUN: this round ran no flow step (BUTTON passed in R36 and R37)') }
  else { Add-Test 'BUTTON' @('b a view button starts a flow=' + $(if ($btn.Count) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' (rows titled BTN-FLOW=' + $btn.Count + ')') ($btn.Count -ge 1) }
  $script:lines.Add('NOTE FORM and VIEW: what the screen showed is left to the answers you give in the RADE window (this script does not read them)')
}
'@ }

# SharePoint permission bits (SP.BasePermissions, low word): EditListItems 0x4; CancelCheckout 0x100 ("Override List Behaviors").
$EditItemsBit = 0x4
$OverrideBit = 0x100

# True when a permission answer ({High, Low}) holds Edit Items and Override List Behaviors: the right to edit every row.
function Test-EditAll($Bits) { $low = [long]$Bits.Low; return (($low -band $EditItemsBit) -ne 0 -and ($low -band $OverrideBit) -ne 0) }

# Finds a site group by its name (one request for that group, its name encoded); returns its Id, or 0 when it is missing.
function Get-GroupIdByName([string]$Name) {
  try { return [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' ("_api/web/sitegroups/getbyname('" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($Name) + "')?" + '$select=Id') '') | ConvertFrom-Json).Id }
  catch { return 0 }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, steps o1 to o3: finds the group and the level (made by T20 r2), sets "edit own rows" on the probe list and gives
  the group the level on that list. Each change is made only when it is missing and is read back.
.PARAMETER List
  The probe list (from Find-ByFolder).
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The Id of the group PFM Office, or 0 when the group or the level is missing (the part stops there).
#>
function Grant-OfficeOnProbe($List) {
  $gid = Get-GroupIdByName $OfficeGroup
  if (-not $gid) { Add-Item 'o1-group' 'FAIL' ('the site has no group ' + $OfficeGroup + ': run T20 r2 first'); return 0 }
  $level = @(Get-RestValue ('_api/web/roledefinitions?$select=Id,Name,BasePermissions&$top=500') | Where-Object { [string]$_.Name -eq $OfficeLevel })
  if (-not $level.Count -or -not (Test-EditAll $level[0].BasePermissions)) {
    Add-Item 'o1-group' 'FAIL' ('the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' is missing or lacks Override List Behaviors: run T20 r2 first'); return 0
  }
  Add-Item 'o1-group' 'PASS' ('the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' and the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' (Edit plus Override List Behaviors) are on the site')
  $lbase = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')"
  Write-Now 'Setting "edit own rows" on the probe list'
  $ctx = Get-PnPContext; $l = $ctx.Web.Lists.GetById([guid]$List.Id); $l.WriteSecurity = 2; $l.Update(); $ctx.ExecuteQuery()
  $ws = [int]((Invoke-Rest 'Get' ($lbase + '?$select=WriteSecurity') '') | ConvertFrom-Json).WriteSecurity
  Add-Item 'o2-edit-own' $(if ($ws -eq 2) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) ('the probe list lets a person edit only own rows=' + $(if ($ws -eq 2) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $has = $false
  $bindings = $lbase + '/roleassignments/getbyprincipalid(' + $gid + ')/roledefinitionbindings?$select=Id'
  try { $has = @(Get-RestValue $bindings | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$level[0].Id }).Count -gt 0 } catch { $has = $false }
  if (-not $has) {
    Write-Now ('Giving the level ' + $OfficeLevel + ' to the group on the probe list')
    $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ($lbase + '/roleassignments/addroleassignment(principalid=' + $gid + ',roledefid=' + [int]$level[0].Id + ')') '{}'
  }
  Add-Item 'o3-level' 'PASS' ('the group holds the level on the probe list (given now=' + $(if ($has) { 'no' } else { 'yes' }) + ')')
  return $gid
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, step o4: one row titled EDITALL that you write (so you are its author); a row from an earlier run is used again.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The row's Id.
#>
function Add-OfficeRow {
  $rows = @(Get-ListRow $ListTitle @('Title', 'Author') | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Title) -like 'EDITALL *' } | Sort-Object { $_.Id } -Descending)
  if ($rows.Count) { $id = [int]$rows[0].Id; $made = 'no' }
  else {
    Write-Now 'Adding the row the second person edits'
    $tag = 'R35' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
    $id = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List $ListTitle -Values @{ Title = ('EDITALL ' + $tag); ProbeTest = 'EDITALL' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id
    $made = 'yes'
  }
  Add-Item 'o4-row' 'PASS' ('the row titled EDITALL is on the probe list, you are its author (made now=' + $made + ')')
  return $id
}

# The office state file: GroupId=<n> and UserIds=<n>,<n> (each person this part added to PFM Office that Clean has not
# removed yet). Returns @{ GroupId; UserIds } or $null when there is no file. Numbers only, never an address or a name.
function Read-OfficeState {
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $OfficeStateName
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
  $h = @{ GroupId = 0; UserIds = @() }
  foreach ($l in @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f)) {
    if ([string]$l -match '^GroupId=(\d+)$') { $h.GroupId = [int]$Matches[1] }
    if ([string]$l -match '^UserIds=([\d,]*)$') { $h.UserIds = @($Matches[1] -split ',' | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ }) }
  }
  return $h
}
# Writes the office state file (the group Id and the user Ids still to remove); deletes it when no Id is left.
function Write-OfficeState([int]$GroupId, [int[]]$UserIds) {
  $f = Join-Path $script:dir $OfficeStateName
  if (-not @($UserIds).Count) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; return }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $f -Value @(('GroupId=' + $GroupId), ('UserIds=' + (@($UserIds) -join ','))) -Encoding ASCII
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Office, step o5: puts the second person of the part Person into the group PFM Office and reads back that the person
  can now edit every row of the probe list. A person who could do that before is not used: the test would prove nothing.
  The person's Id is added to the office state file before the change, so Clean can remove the person even if this
  stops. Every person this part adds is recorded: a person from an earlier run that Clean has not removed yet stays on
  file next to the new one, and Clean removes both (review of 19 Nov 26). A person who was a member before is not recorded.
.PARAMETER GroupId
  The Id of the group PFM Office.
.PARAMETER List
  The probe list (from Find-ByFolder).
.OUTPUTS
  System.String. The status text for the OFFICE line (no identity).
#>
function Add-OfficeMember([int]$GroupId, $List) {
  $person = Read-State $script:dir
  if (-not $person) { Add-Item 'o5-person' 'FAIL' 'no second person on file: run the part Person first'; return 'no second person on file' }
  $uid = [int]$person['UserId']
  $loginName = ''
  $raw = Invoke-Rest 'Get' ('_api/web/getuserbyid(' + $uid + ')?$select=LoginName') ''
  if ($raw -match '"LoginName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"') { $loginName = $Matches[1] }
  $permUri = "_api/web/lists(guid'" + $List.Id + "')/getusereffectivepermissions(@u)?@u='" + [uri]::EscapeDataString($loginName) + "'"
  $was = (Get-GroupMemberId $GroupId) -contains $uid
  if (-not $was -and (Test-EditAll ((Invoke-Rest 'Get' $permUri '') | ConvertFrom-Json))) {
    $loginName = $null
    Add-Item 'o5-person' 'FAIL' 'the second person can edit every row already, without PFM Office: use a person who is only a Visitor'
    return 'the person can edit every row already'
  }
  $st = Read-OfficeState
  $ids = @(); if ($st) { $ids = @($st.UserIds) }
  if (@($ids | Where-Object { $_ -ne $uid }).Count) { $script:lines.Add('NOTE o5: a person from an earlier run is still on file for PFM Office; Clean removes both') }
  if (-not $was -and $ids -notcontains $uid) { $ids += $uid }
  $mine = $ids -contains $uid
  if ($ids.Count) { Write-OfficeState $GroupId $ids }
  if (-not $was) {
    Write-Now ('Adding the second person to the group ' + $OfficeGroup)
    try { $null = Add-PnPGroupMember -LoginName $loginName -Group $GroupId -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $null = $_ }
  }
  $in = (Get-GroupMemberId $GroupId) -contains $uid
  $can = $in -and (Test-EditAll ((Invoke-Rest 'Get' $permUri '') | ConvertFrom-Json))
  $loginName = $null
  $text = 'person in PFM Office=' + $(if ($in) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; can edit every row of the probe list now=' + $(if ($can) { 'yes' } else { 'no' })
  Add-Item 'o5-person' $(if ($can) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) $text
  return $(if (-not $mine) { 'already a member (Clean leaves the person in the group)' } elseif ($in) { 'added and listed in the group' } else { 'the add was refused' })
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Office (F2 B, PFM 19 Nov 26): the group PFM Office gets the level on the probe list, you write one EDITALL row,
  the second person joins the group, and the row's edit form link goes on the clipboard for that person. Read checks that
  the person saved the row (test EDITALL); Clean removes the person from the group.
#>
function Invoke-OfficePart {
  Write-Now 'Looking for the probe list, the group PFM Office and its level'
  $lst = Find-ByFolder $ListFolder
  if (-not $lst) { throw 'LIST not found: run -Part Make first.' }
  $status = 'the group or the level is missing'
  $rowId = 0
  $gid = Grant-OfficeOnProbe $lst
  if ($gid) {
    $rowId = Add-OfficeRow
    $status = Add-OfficeMember $gid $lst
  }
  $script:lines.Add('OFFICE second person in ' + $OfficeGroup + ': ' + $(if ($status -like 'added*' -or $status -like 'already*') { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; status: ' + $status)
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($NoLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } elseif ($rowId) {
    try { Set-Clipboard -Value ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $ListFolder + '/EditForm.aspx?ID=' + $rowId); $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' }
  }
  $script:lines.Add('ITEM o6-link INFO the link of the edit form of the EDITALL row is on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, step c1b: removes every person on the office state file from the group PFM Office again, then deletes the file
  (it keeps the Ids that are still in the group). A failure is its own FAIL line and never stops the later Clean steps.
  R35 (W8): with -Label first (the check before the test) a recorded person who is still in PFM Office is a leftover of an
  earlier test: it is a FAIL line that says what to do, and nobody is removed (the Clean at the end, -Label last, removes
  the person). The group PFM Office and its level stay: they are app setup (T20), not leftovers.
.OUTPUTS
  None.
#>
function Clear-OfficeMember {
  $st = Read-OfficeState
  if (-not $st -or -not @($st.UserIds).Count) { Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'INFO' 'no PFM Office test on file (nothing to remove)'; Write-OfficeState 0 @(); return }
  try {
    $members = Get-GroupMemberId $st.GroupId
    if ($Label -eq 'first') {
      $left = @($st.UserIds | Where-Object { $members -contains $_ })
      if ($left.Count) {
        $todo = 'What to do: go on to the last Clean step of this round, which removes them, or remove them from the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' by hand and run this step again'
        Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'FAIL' ('leftover: ' + $left.Count + ' test person(s) from an earlier test still in the group ' + $OfficeGroup + ' (state file kept). ' + $todo)
      } else {
        Write-OfficeState $st.GroupId @()
        Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'PASS' ('no test person is left in ' + $OfficeGroup + ' (state file deleted)')
      }
      return
    }
    foreach ($uid in @($st.UserIds | Where-Object { $members -contains $_ })) {
      Write-Now ('Removing a person of this test from the group ' + $OfficeGroup)
      try { $null = Invoke-Rest 'Post' ('_api/web/sitegroups/getbyid(' + $st.GroupId + ')/users/removebyid(' + $uid + ')') '{}' } catch { $null = $_ }
    }
    $members = Get-GroupMemberId $st.GroupId
    $still = @($st.UserIds | Where-Object { $members -contains $_ })
    Write-OfficeState $st.GroupId $still
    $n = @($st.UserIds).Count
    $text = 'the people of this test are not in PFM Office (' + $n + '; state file deleted)'
    if ($still.Count) { $text = 'still in PFM Office: ' + $still.Count + ' of ' + $n + ' (state file kept; run Clean again)' }
    Add-Item 'c1b-office' $(if ($still.Count) { 'FAIL' } else { 'PASS' }) $text
  } catch { Add-Item 'c1b-office' 'FAIL' ('PFM Office could not be cleaned: ' + (Format-Detail ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) + ' (state file kept; run Clean again)') }
}
'@ }

# @@SHARED site-common-cc1bf548@@ (RADE writes the shared block "site-common" here; its text is in the bundle part "Shared blocks")

$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:passed = 0; $script:failed = 0
# Adds one "ITEM <name> <status> <text>" line and counts a PASS or a FAIL.
function Add-Item([string]$Name, [string]$Status, [string]$Text) {
  $lines.Add('ITEM ' + $Name + ' ' + $Status + ' ' + $Text)
  if ($Status -eq 'PASS') { $script:passed++ } elseif ($Status -eq 'FAIL') { $script:failed++ }
}
# The state file as a hashtable (key=value lines); empty when the file is missing.
function Read-State([string]$Path) {
  $h = @{}
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf) {
    foreach ($l in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path)) { $i = ([string]$l).IndexOf('='); if ($i -gt 0) { $h[([string]$l).Substring(0, $i)] = ([string]$l).Substring($i + 1) } } }
  return $h
}
# Writes the state hashtable to the state file as sorted key=value lines (row numbers and flags only).
function Save-State([string]$Path, $State) { Set-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Value @($State.Keys | Sort-Object | ForEach-Object { $_ + '=' + $State[$_] }) -Encoding ASCII }
# The answer value of a row in ASCII (an unknown value is "other", so no free text from the site reaches a line).
function Get-AnswerText($V) {
  $t = ([string]$V).Replace([string][char]0x2014, '-').Trim()
  if ($Answers -contains $t) { return $t }
  return 'other'
}
# The site user number of the author of a row, or 0 when the row has none.
function Get-AuthorId($Row) { $a = $Row['Author']; if ($a -and $a.LookupId) { return [int]$a.LookupId }; return 0 }
# The rows of list $List whose lookup column $Field points at row $Id (all rows read, then filtered here).
function Get-RowsFor([string]$List, [string]$Field, [int]$Id) {
  return @(Get-PnPListItem -List $List -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $v = $_[$Field]; $v -and [int]$v.LookupId -eq $Id })
}
# The fake publication rows (exact title), oldest first.
function Find-FakePub {
  $all = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Fields 'Title' -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop)
  return @($all | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $PubTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
}
# Loads PnP.PowerShell and signs in to the one site with the web login (CAC).
function Connect-EndorseSite {
  $mod = @(Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name PnP.PowerShell | Sort-Object Version -Descending)
  if (-not $mod.Count) { throw 'PNP not installed: PnP.PowerShell is not on this computer.' }
  $null = & { Import-Module PnP.PowerShell -RequiredVersion $mod[0].Version -DisableNameChecking } *>&1
  Write-Host 'NOW Signing in to the site (if a sign-in window opens, sign in with your CAC)'
  $null = & { Connect-PnPOnline -Url $script:site -UseWebLogin -ErrorAction Stop } *>&1
  $lines.Add('ROUTE web-login PASS')
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Make: the fake publication (found or made once) and, on the clipboard, the new row form link and the steps
  for the second person.
#>
function Invoke-MakePart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pub = @(Find-FakePub)
  if ($pub.Count) { $pubId = [int]$pub[0].Id; Add-Item 'm1-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication is there (made by an earlier run; it is used again)' }
  else {
    $step = @(Get-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Process Steps' -Fields 'Title', 'StepNumber' -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { [int]$_['StepNumber'] -eq 1 })
    if (-not $step.Count) { throw 'STEP not found: PFM Process Steps has no row with step number 1 (run T20 first).' }
    Write-Host 'NOW Making the fake publication'
    $pubId = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Values @{ Title = $PubTitle; ActionType = 'New'; ProductType = 'Publication'
        ProcessStep = $step[0].Id; ActionStatus = 'On Track' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id
    $st['Made'] = 'yes'; Add-Item 'm1-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication was made (step 1, On Track)' }
  $st['PubId'] = [string]$pubId; if (-not $st['Made']) { $st['Made'] = 'no' }
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st   # saved before the edit row: if that write fails, Clean still finds the publication it made
  $editId = Add-EditRow $pubId; $st['EditId'] = [string]$editId
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $list = $script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/Lists/' + $EndorseFolder
  $steps = @(($list + '/NewForm.aspx'), '1. Open the link above.', ('2. In Title, type: ' + $AnswerTitle), ('3. In Publication, pick: ' + $PubTitle),
    '4. In Endorsement Status, pick your answer, for example Concur.', '5. Select Save, then tell me if it saved.',
    ($list + '/EditForm.aspx?ID=' + $editId), '6. Open this second link.', '7. In Endorsement Status, pick your answer, for example Concur.',
    '8. Select Save, then tell me if it saved or said that you have no permission.')
  $clip = 'no'
  if ($script:noLaunch) { $clip = 'no (test run)' } else { try { Set-Clipboard -Value $steps; $clip = 'yes' } catch { $clip = 'no' } }
  $lines.Add('ITEM m3-link INFO the 2 form links of PFM Endorsements (new row, edit your row) and the 8 steps for the second person are on the clipboard=' + $clip)
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Make, step m2 (PFM 20 Nov 26): the fake endorsement row that you make on the fake publication ("Not Started"), which the
  second person then tries to edit in its edit form. A row with that title on the publication is used again.
.PARAMETER PubId
  The row number of the fake publication.
.OUTPUTS
  System.Int32. The row number of the endorsement row.
#>
function Add-EditRow([int]$PubId) {
  $have = @(Get-RowsFor 'PFM Endorsements' 'Publication' $PubId | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $EditTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id })
  if ($have.Count) { Add-Item 'm2-edit-row' 'PASS' 'the fake endorsement row to edit is there (made by an earlier run)'; return [int]$have[0].Id }
  Write-Host 'NOW Making the fake endorsement row that the second person tries to edit'
  $id = [int](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $EditTitle; Publication = $PubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
      EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id
  Add-Item 'm2-edit-row' 'PASS' 'the fake endorsement row to edit was made (Not Started, you are its author)'
  return $id
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Read (reads only): the rows of PFM Endorsements on the fake publication that another person saved; one
  RESULT line with the answer on the newest one and the row count.
#>
function Invoke-ReadPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { $p = @(Find-FakePub); if ($p.Count) { [int]$p[0].Id } else { 0 } })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Item 'r1-publication' 'FAIL' 'no fake publication: run the part Make first'; $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE FAIL'); return }
  $meId = 0
  try { $meId = [int]((Invoke-PnPSPRestMethod -Method Get -Url ($script:site.TrimEnd('/') + '/_api/web/currentuser?$select=Id') -Raw -ErrorAction Stop) | ConvertFrom-Json).Id } catch { $meId = 0 }
  Write-Host 'NOW Reading the answers on PFM Endorsements'
  $rows = @(Get-RowsFor 'PFM Endorsements' 'Publication' $pubId)
  $other = @($rows | Where-Object { $meId -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -gt 0 -and (Get-AuthorId $_) -ne $meId -and ([string]$_['Title']) -ne $EditTitle } |
      Sort-Object { $_.Id } -Descending)
  $answered = @($other | Where-Object { (Get-AnswerText $_['EndorsementStatus']) -ne 'Not Started' })
  $marked = @($other | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']).StartsWith('90161Z TEST') }).Count
  $answer = $(if ($answered.Count) { Get-AnswerText $answered[0]['EndorsementStatus'] } else { 'none' })
  $pass = ($answered.Count -ge 1)
  $lines.Add('ENDORSE rows on the fake publication=' + $rows.Count + '; by another person=' + $other.Count + '; with an answer=' + $answered.Count +
    '; with the fake-data title=' + $marked + $(if ($meId -le 0) { ' (your own user number could not be read)' } else { '' }))
  $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE ' + $(if ($pass) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + ' answer=' + $answer + ' rows=' + $answered.Count)
  if ($pass) { $script:passed++ } else {
    $script:failed++
    $lines.Add('next: the second person opens the new row form link, types the title, picks the fake publication and an answer, and selects Save;' +
      ' a form that says no permission means the Visitors group does not hold Contribute on PFM Endorsements (run T20 r4)') }
  Add-EditResult $rows $meId ([string]$st['EditId'])
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Read, the edit (PFM 20 Nov 26): did the second person change the endorsement row that you made? PFM Endorsements is
  "edit own rows" (PFM 10A), so a refusal is the expected outcome: RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED is recorded and is not
  counted as a failure (it holds neither PASS nor FAIL). A saved change by another person: RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT PASS
  answer=<choice>.
.PARAMETER Rows
  The endorsement rows of the fake publication.
.PARAMETER MeId
  Your own site user number (0 when it cannot be read).
.PARAMETER EditId
  The row number Make saved in the state file ('' when none).
#>
function Add-EditResult($Rows, [int]$MeId, [string]$EditId) {
  $row = @($Rows | Where-Object { ($EditId -match '^\d+$' -and [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$EditId) -or ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $EditTitle } | Sort-Object { $_.Id }) | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $row) { $lines.Add('ENDORSE-EDIT the row to edit is not on the site (run the part Make first)'); $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED (no row to edit)'); return }
  $ed = 0; $e = $row['Editor']; if ($e -and $e.LookupId) { $ed = [int]$e.LookupId }
  $ans = Get-AnswerText $row['EndorsementStatus']
  $changed = ($MeId -gt 0 -and $ed -gt 0 -and $ed -ne $MeId -and $ans -ne 'Not Started')
  $lines.Add('ENDORSE-EDIT the row you made: last saved by another person=' + $(if ($ed -gt 0 -and $MeId -gt 0 -and $ed -ne $MeId) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }) + '; answer=' + $ans)
  if ($changed) { $script:passed++; $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT PASS answer=' + $ans) }
  else { $lines.Add('RESULT ENDORSE-EDIT REFUSED (expected under edit own rows: recorded; it does not count against the round)') }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Clean: recycles the endorsement and log rows of the fake publication, then the publication when Make made
  it, and deletes the state file. Each step runs even when one fails.
#>
function Invoke-CleanPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  $script:pauseBad = $false; Restore-PauseRow $st
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { 0 })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Item 'c1-rows' 'PASS' 'no fake publication on file (nothing to remove)'; return }
  $n = 0; $bad = 0
  foreach ($l in 'PFM Endorsements', 'PFM Activity Log') {
    try { foreach ($r in (Get-RowsFor $l 'Publication' $pubId)) { $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List $l -Identity $r.Id -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $n++ } }
    catch { $bad++; $lines.Add('NOTE rows of ' + $l + ' not all removed: ' + ([string]$_.Exception.Message).Substring(0, [Math]::Min(120, ([string]$_.Exception.Message).Length))) } }
  Add-Item 'c1-rows' $(if ($bad) { 'FAIL' } else { 'PASS' }) ('rows moved to the site Recycle Bin=' + $n + $(if ($bad) { ' (run Clean again)' } else { '' }))
  if ($st['Made'] -eq 'yes') {
    try { $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Publications' -Identity $pubId -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication moved to the site Recycle Bin' }
    catch { $bad++; Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'FAIL' 'the fake publication could not be removed (run Clean again)' } }
  else { Add-Item 'c2-publication' 'PASS' 'the fake publication was not made by this task, so it stays' }
  if (-not $bad -and -not $script:pauseBad) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:stateFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Clean, the pause-switch row (the PFM, 21 Nov 26): back to its value from before the round, only when it differs.
.DESCRIPTION
  The value before the round is the word the first Rows run saved (PauseBefore). Yes, No and empty are written back as
  they were; a row that was missing or held other text gets the off value (No). With no Rows on file nothing is
  done. Logs RESULT PAUSEROW PASS value=<word>, or FAIL (then the state file stays, so Clean can run again).
.PARAMETER State
  The state hashtable of this task.
#>
function Restore-PauseRow($State) {
  $want = [string]$State['PauseBefore']
  if (-not $want) { return }   # Rows did not run: the round did not touch the row
  if ($want -notin 'Yes', 'No', 'empty') { $want = Get-ValueWord $Pause.Off }   # missing or other text: the off value, never a read-back
  $value = $(if ($want -eq 'empty') { '' } else { $want })
  try {
    $rows = @(Get-PauseRow)
    if ($rows.Count -ne 1) { $script:pauseBad = $true; Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false ('rows named ' + $Pause.Title + '=' + $rows.Count + ': set it by hand'); return }
    if (([string]$rows[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() -cne $value) { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Identity $rows[0].Id -Values @{ $Pause.Field = $value } -ErrorAction Stop }
    $now = Get-ValueWord (@(Get-PauseRow))[0][$Pause.Field]
    if ($now -ne $want) { $script:pauseBad = $true }
    Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($now -eq $want) ('value=' + $now)
  } catch { $script:pauseBad = $true; Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false 'the pause-switch row could not be set back (run Clean again)' }
}

$fatal = $false; $site = ''; $secret = @(); $dir = ''
try {
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  # The Restore test parts are dot-sourced here, in this script's scope, so they see the values and helpers above.

  $who = Get-TaskId $Id; $secret = $who.Secret
  if ($TestDir) { $dir = $TestDir } else { $dir = Get-TaskDir $who.Id $task 'Task 26' -Create }
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $dir
  $script:stateFile = Join-Path $dir $StateName

  Connect-EndorseSite
  switch ($Part) { 'Make' { Invoke-MakePart } 'Read' { Invoke-ReadPart } 'Clean' { Invoke-CleanPart } 'Rows' { Invoke-RowsPart } 'Change' { Invoke-ChangePart }
    default { Invoke-CheckPart (Split-Path -Parent $dir) } }
  try { $null = & { Disconnect-PnPOnline -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } *>&1 } catch { $null = $_ }

  $lines.Add('STOPPED: ' + $m.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(300, $m.Length)) + ' (the part can be run again)')

  $masked | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
  if (-not $NoPause -and -not $env:RADE_CONTRACT) { [void](Read-Host 'Press Enter to close') }
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  90-161.Z Task 26 r2, module "restore": the parts Rows, Change and Check of the RADE Restore test (R41). Moved here from
  90161Z-T26-endorse-r2.ps1 (code standard file size cap, C4); the code is unchanged.
.DESCRIPTION
  Loaded by 90161Z-T26-endorse-r2.ps1 (dot-sourced from the same folder, in its scope); it does nothing when it is run alone.
  Inputs: the values and helpers of the main file ($lines, $Pause, $script:stateFile, Add-Item,
  Read-State, Save-State, Get-RowsFor, Find-FakePub). Outputs: RESULT lines in $lines; the part functions Invoke-RowsPart,
  Invoke-ChangePart and Invoke-CheckPart.
  Network: the one SharePoint site of the main file, through the PnP.PowerShell connection of the main file.
  Writes: Rows and Change: the fake rows named in the main file (and the pause-switch row) on the site and the state file; Check writes nothing.
  Credentials: none of its own (the main file signs in).
  Run: not alone; powershell.exe -File 90161Z-T26-endorse-r2.ps1 loads it.
#>
# The Restore test (R41): the fake rows on the fake publication (moved here with the parts that use them).
$BinTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore {0} (delete me)'   # the 3 endorsement rows that go to the Recycle Bin ({0} = 1 to 3)
$LogTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore log (delete me)'   # the log row that is deleted for good
$NewTitle = '90161Z TEST R41 restore new (delete me)'   # the row made after the backup: Restore must leave it
# ---- The RADE Restore test (R41): the parts Rows, Change and Check ----
# Adds one "RESULT <name> PASS|FAIL <text>" line and counts it.
function Add-Result([string]$Name, [bool]$Ok, [string]$Text) {
  $lines.Add('RESULT ' + $Name + ' ' + $(if ($Ok) { 'PASS' } else { 'FAIL' }) + $(if ($Text) { ' ' + $Text } else { '' }))
  if ($Ok) { $script:passed++ } else { $script:failed++ }
}
# A value of the pause-switch row as a word for a result line: Yes, No, empty or other (no free text from the site).
function Get-ValueWord($V) { $t = ([string]$V).Trim(); if ($t -in 'Yes', 'No') { return $t }; if (-not $t) { return 'empty' }; return 'other' }
# The rows of PFM Settings whose title is the pause-switch row.
function Get-PauseRow {
  return @(Get-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Fields 'Title', $Pause.Field -PageSize 500 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']).Trim() -eq $Pause.Title })
}
# The rows of list $List with title $Title on the fake publication $PubId, oldest first.
function Get-TitledRow([string]$List, [string]$Title, [int]$PubId) { return @(Get-RowsFor $List 'Publication' $PubId | Where-Object { ([string]$_['Title']) -eq $Title } | Sort-Object { $_.Id }) }
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Rows, the pause-switch row: there once, with the off value; then read back (RESULT PAUSEROW).
.DESCRIPTION
  A missing row is made with the off value; a row with another value is set to it; two or more rows with that title
  are a FAIL (RADE reads one row) and are not changed. The value before goes into the state file as a word.
.PARAMETER State
  The state hashtable (gets PauseBefore and PauseAfter).
#>
function Initialize-PauseRow($State) {
  $rows = @(Get-PauseRow)
  if ($rows.Count -gt 1) { Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' $false ('rows named ' + $Pause.Title + '=' + $rows.Count + ': keep one, delete the others, then run again'); return }
  if (-not $rows.Count) {
    Write-Host 'NOW Making the pause-switch row in PFM Settings'
    $null = Add-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Values @{ Title = $Pause.Title; $Pause.Field = $Pause.Off } -ErrorAction Stop; $did = 'made'
    if (-not $State['PauseBefore']) { $State['PauseBefore'] = 'missing' } }
  else {
    # Only the first Rows run of a round saves the value before it: a rerun would save the round's own off value (review MAJOR)
    if (-not $State['PauseBefore']) { $State['PauseBefore'] = Get-ValueWord $rows[0][$Pause.Field] }
    if (([string]$rows[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() -ceq $Pause.Off) { $did = 'kept' }
    else { $null = Set-PnPListItem -List $Pause.List -Identity $rows[0].Id -Values @{ $Pause.Field = $Pause.Off } -ErrorAction Stop; $did = 'set' } }
  $now = @(Get-PauseRow); $val = $(if ($now.Count -eq 1) { ([string]$now[0][$Pause.Field]).Trim() } else { '' })
  $State['PauseAfter'] = Get-ValueWord $val
  $text = 'row=' + $did + ' before=' + $State['PauseBefore'] + ' now=' + $State['PauseAfter'] + ' (RADE turns it to ' + $Pause.On + ' while Restore writes)'
  Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($now.Count -eq 1 -and $val -ceq $Pause.Off) $text
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Rows: the pause-switch row, then the 3 endorsement rows and the log row on the fake publication.
.DESCRIPTION
  A row with the same title on the fake publication is used again, so a second run makes no second row. The row
  numbers go into the state file for the parts Change and Check.
#>
function Invoke-RowsPart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  Initialize-PauseRow $st; Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  Write-Host 'NOW Looking for the fake publication'
  $pubId = $(if ($st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$') { [int]$st['PubId'] } else { $p = @(Find-FakePub); if ($p.Count) { [int]$p[0].Id } else { 0 } })
  if (-not $pubId) { Add-Result 'ROWS' $false 'no fake publication: run the part Make first'; return }
  $st['PubId'] = [string]$pubId; $made = 0; $found = 0
  $old = @((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) + $st['LogId']) -join ','
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) {
    $title = $BinTitle -f $i; $have = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' $title $pubId)
    if ($have.Count) { $st['Bin' + $i] = [string]$have[0].Id; $found++; continue }
    $st['Bin' + $i] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $title; Publication = $pubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
        EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $made++
    Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
  $have = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId)
  if ($have.Count) { $st['LogId'] = [string]$have[0].Id; $found++ }
  else { $st['LogId'] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Activity Log' -Values @{ Title = $LogTitle; Publication = $pubId; EventType = 'Other' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $made++ }
  # Other row numbers than on file (rows made new): the marks of an earlier Change are for the old rows, so they go.
  if ((@((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) + $st['LogId']) -join ',') -ne $old) { foreach ($k in 'Gone1', 'Gone2', 'Gone3', 'Purged', 'NewId', 'ChangedAt') { $st.Remove($k) } }
  $st['RowsAt'] = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $lines.Add('ROWS endorsement rows=' + ((@(1, 2, 3) | ForEach-Object { $st['Bin' + $_] }) -join ',') + '; log row=' + $st['LogId'])
  Add-Result 'ROWS' $true ('made=' + $made + ' found=' + $found + ' (3 on PFM Endorsements, 1 on PFM Activity Log, all on the fake publication)')
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Change (after the Back up): 3 rows to the Recycle Bin, 1 row deleted for good, 1 new row.
.DESCRIPTION
  Each write is marked in the state file when it is done, so a second run does only what is left. Remove-PnPListItem
  without -Recycle deletes the row for good: it never reaches the Recycle Bin, so Restore must make it again as a new row.
#>
function Invoke-ChangePart {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  if (-not ($st['LogId'] -match '^\d+$' -and $st['PubId'] -match '^\d+$')) { Add-Result 'CHANGE' $false 'no rows on file: run the part Rows first'; return }
  $pubId = [int]$st['PubId']; $gone = 0; $purged = 0; $added = 0; $skip = 0
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) {
    if ($st['Gone' + $i] -eq 'yes') { continue }
    # Only a row with its fake-data title on the fake publication is deleted.
    if (-not @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' ($BinTitle -f $i) $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['Bin' + $i] }).Count) { $skip++; continue }
    $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Identity ([int]$st['Bin' + $i]) -Recycle -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    $st['Gone' + $i] = 'yes'; $gone++; Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
  if ($st['Purged'] -ne 'yes') {
    # Deleted for good only when the row on file still has the fake-data title ("90161Z TEST ...") on the fake publication.
    if (@(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['LogId'] -and ([string]$_['Title']).StartsWith('90161Z TEST') }).Count) {
      $null = Remove-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Activity Log' -Identity ([int]$st['LogId']) -Force -ErrorAction Stop
      $st['Purged'] = 'yes'; $purged++; Save-State $script:stateFile $st }
    else { $skip++ } }
  if ($st['NewId'] -notmatch '^\d+$') {
    $st['NewId'] = [string](Add-PnPListItem -List 'PFM Endorsements' -Values @{ Title = $NewTitle; Publication = $pubId; CoordinationStage = 'Formal Coordination'
        EndorsementStatus = 'Not Started' } -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $added++ }
  if (-not $st['ChangedAt']) { $st['ChangedAt'] = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') }
  Save-State $script:stateFile $st
  $text = 'to the Recycle Bin=' + $gone + ' deleted for good=' + $purged + ' new row=' + $added + ' (new row number ' + $st['NewId'] + ')'
  if ($skip) { $text += '; rows on file not found with the fake-data title=' + $skip + ' (not deleted: run the part Rows again)' }
  Add-Result 'CHANGE' (-not $skip) $text
}
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  The part Check (after Restore; reads only): the rows Restore put back, the new row, the pause switch, the fresh backup.
.PARAMETER App
  The app folder (RADE\90-161.Z), which holds the Backups folder.
#>
function Invoke-CheckPart([string]$App) {
  $st = Read-State $script:stateFile
  if ($st['NewId'] -notmatch '^\d+$' -or $st['PubId'] -notmatch '^\d+$') { Add-Result 'RESTORE-BIN' $false 'no change on file: run the parts Rows and Change first'; return }
  $pubId = [int]$st['PubId']; $back = 0; $twice = 0
  for ($i = 1; $i -le 3; $i++) { $rows = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' ($BinTitle -f $i) $pubId)
    if (@($rows | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['Bin' + $i] }).Count) { $back++ }; if ($rows.Count -gt 1) { $twice++ } }
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-BIN' ($back -eq 3 -and -not $twice) ('back with the old row number=' + $back + ' of 3; made twice=' + $twice)
  $logs = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Activity Log' $LogTitle $pubId); $old = @($logs | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['LogId'] }).Count
  $newNo = $(if ($logs.Count) { [string]$logs[0].Id } else { 'none' })
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-NEW' ($logs.Count -eq 1 -and -not $old) ('log rows=' + $logs.Count + '; with the old row number=' + $old + '; new row number=' + $newNo)
  $keep = @(Get-TitledRow 'PFM Endorsements' $NewTitle $pubId | Where-Object { [int]$_.Id -eq [int]$st['NewId'] }).Count
  Add-Result 'RESTORE-KEEP' ($keep -eq 1) ('the row made after the backup is there=' + $(if ($keep -eq 1) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }))
  $p = @(Get-PauseRow); $word = $(if ($p.Count -eq 1) { Get-ValueWord $p[0][$Pause.Field] } else { 'rows=' + $p.Count })
  Add-Result 'PAUSEROW' ($p.Count -eq 1 -and $word -eq $st['PauseAfter']) ('now=' + $word + ' before Restore=' + $st['PauseAfter'])
  $since = [datetime]::ParseExact($st['ChangedAt'], 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $fresh = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $App 'Backups') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CreationTime -gt $since -and -not $_.Name.StartsWith('~') })
  Add-Result 'FRESH-BACKUP' ($fresh.Count -ge 1) ('Backups folders made after the change=' + $fresh.Count)
}
'@ }

# ==== Part 6 of 6: the RADE engine (engine/ps, in run order)
# ==== Engine part: engine/ps/01-base.ps1 (sha256 ed0e1410780e)
# RADE engine part 01, the base: finds the user's OneDrive and RADE folders, masks the DODID in text,
# moves an old app folder into OneDrive\RADE, and resolves the working folder. Used by every later part.
# Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

# ---------------- RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (generated; same engine in every round bundle) ----------------
# Returns the secrets to mask (the DODID, the profile folder name, the user name), each 4 or more characters, longest
# first so a longer one is masked before a shorter one inside it. Takes the DODID and the profile folder name.
function Get-Secret([string]$Id, [string]$Leaf) {
  @($Id, $Leaf, $env:USERNAME) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Length -ge 4 } | Sort-Object -Unique | Sort-Object Length -Descending
}
# Replaces every secret (the DODID, the profile folder name, the user name) in the text with <DODID>. Takes the text;
# gives back the masked text.
function ConvertTo-Masked([string]$Text) {
  foreach ($x in $script:secret) { $Text = $Text -replace [regex]::Escape($x), '<DODID>' }
  return $Text
}
# Gives the name of the Windows profile folder (the DODID); an empty text when there is none. Takes nothing.
function Get-ProfileLeaf { if ($env:USERPROFILE) { return (Split-Path -Leaf $env:USERPROFILE) }; return '' }
# Gives the path of the user's OneDrive folder (under $usersRoot, from the profile folder name). It only builds the
# path; takes nothing.
function Get-OneDrivePath {
  $leaf = Get-ProfileLeaf
  if (-not $leaf) { $leaf = 'no-profile-folder' }
  return (Join-Path (Join-Path $usersRoot $leaf) 'OneDrive - United States Air Force')
}
# Gives the path of the RADE folder inside OneDrive (OneDrive\RADE). Takes nothing; creates nothing.
function Get-RadePath { return (Join-Path (Get-OneDrivePath) 'RADE') }
# Gives the path of the app's old folder (OneDrive\<app>), from before RADE had its own folder. Takes nothing.
function Get-OldBasePath { return (Join-Path (Get-OneDrivePath) $appFolder) }
function Get-BasePath {
  # The real path (shown on screen, PFM 13 Nov: no placeholder). Reports and e-mails show <DODID> instead.
  # PFM 14 Nov 26: OneDrive\RADE\<app>. Until RADE has moved it (on Run), an old OneDrive\<app> folder is used.
  $new = Join-Path (Get-RadePath) $appFolder
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $new -PathType Container) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-OldBasePath) -PathType Container)) { return (Get-OldBasePath) }
  return $new
}
function Get-RadeMove {
  # The one-time move of OneDrive\<app> into OneDrive\RADE (PFM 14 Nov 26). Both there: nothing moves, the RADE copy is used.
  $old = Get-OldBasePath; $new = Join-Path (Get-RadePath) $appFolder
  $o = Test-Path -LiteralPath $old -PathType Container; $n = Test-Path -LiteralPath $new -PathType Container
  return @{ Needed = ($o -and -not $n); Both = ($o -and $n); From = $old; To = $new }
}
function Move-ToRade([scriptblock]$Say) {
  # One folder move inside OneDrive (every file keeps its place). On failure the round keeps the old folder and says why.
  $m = Get-RadeMove
  if ($m.Both) { & $Say ('Note: both ' + $appFolder + ' and RADE\' + $appFolder + ' are in your OneDrive. RADE uses RADE\' + $appFolder + '; move anything you still need from the old ' + $appFolder + ' folder by hand.') }
  if (-not $m.Needed) { return (Get-BasePath) }
  try {
    $rade = Get-RadePath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rade -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $rade -Force) }
    [System.IO.Directory]::Move($m.From, $m.To)
    & $Say ('Moved the folder ' + $appFolder + ' into RADE (RADE\' + $appFolder + '). Every file kept its place.')
  } catch {
    & $Say ('Folder move could not run: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked $_.Exception.Message) + ' This round uses the old ' + $appFolder + ' folder; the next round tries again.')
  }
  return (Get-BasePath)
}
function Resolve-Base {
  # No DODID question (PFM 13 Nov): the Windows profile folder name is the DODID.
  $leaf = Get-ProfileLeaf
  $script:secret = Get-Secret $leaf $leaf
  if ($leaf -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{4,}$') { throw 'PROFILE folder name not usable (Windows profile not found). Sign in to Windows with your own account, then run again.' }
  $base = Get-BasePath
  $oneDrive = Get-OneDrivePath
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $oneDrive -PathType Container)) { throw ('FOLDER not found: ' + $oneDrive + '. OneDrive is not set up in this Windows profile.') }
  $script:dodid = $leaf
  return $base
}

# Turns seconds into text like "3m 05s". Takes the seconds (a number); gives back the text.
function Format-Duration([double]$Seconds) {
  $s = [int][math]::Round($Seconds)
  return ('{0}m {1:00}s' -f [math]::Floor($s / 60), ($s % 60))
}
# What the window calls a step to a person: its manifest "title", else its name. The log, the report, the summary, the results
# files and every key keep the name.
function Get-StepTitle($Step) { if ($Step -and [string]$Step.Title) { return [string]$Step.Title }; return [string]$Step.Name }
# Says whether Word is running. Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
function Test-WordOpen { return (@(Get-Process -Name WINWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -gt 0) }
# Says whether the text is one or more e-mail addresses separated by ";". Takes the text; gives back $true or $false.
# Sends nothing.
function Test-MailTo([string]$To) {
  $one = '[^@\s;,]+@[^@\s;,]+\.[^@\s;,]+'
  return ($To -match ('^\s*' + $one + '(\s*;\s*' + $one + ')*\s*;?\s*$'))
}
# Returns the path of a file in the app's Config folder. Takes the app folder and the file name.
function Get-ConfigFile([string]$Base, [string]$Name) { return (Join-Path (Join-Path $Base 'Config') $Name) }
# Returns the path of a file in RADE's own Config folder (a test can set $script:configOver). Takes the file name.
function Get-RadeConfigFile([string]$Name) { if ($script:configOver) { return (Join-Path $script:configOver $Name) }; return (Join-Path (Join-Path (Get-RadePath) 'Config') $Name) }   # the engine's own settings (R17)
function Read-WindowState {
  # R28 (the Administrator, 2026-11-17): where the user last closed the window. RADE\Config\rade-window.json (a cache: when it
  # is lost or does not read, the window opens maximized on the screen with the mouse). { x, y, w, h, state, dpi, closed: { w, h, state } }
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window.json'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
    $j = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($k in 'x', 'y', 'w', 'h') { if ($null -eq $j.$k -or -not ([string]$j.$k -match '^-?\d{1,5}$')) { return $null } }
    if ([int]$j.w -lt 100 -or [int]$j.h -lt 100) { return $null }
    $st = $(if ([string]$j.state -eq 'Maximized') { 'Maximized' } else { 'Normal' })
    $cl = ''; if ($j.closed -and [string]$j.closed.w -match '^\d{1,5}$' -and [string]$j.closed.h -match '^\d{1,5}$') { $cl = [string]$j.closed.w + 'x' + [string]$j.closed.h + '/' + [string]$j.closed.state -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9/x]', '' }
    return @{ X = [int]$j.x; Y = [int]$j.y; W = [int]$j.w; H = [int]$j.h; State = $st; Dpi = $(if ([string]$j.dpi -match '^\d{2,3}$') { [int]$j.dpi } else { 0 }); Closed = $cl }
  } catch { return $null }
}
function Save-WindowState([int]$X, [int]$Y, [int]$W, [int]$H, [string]$State, [int]$Dpi, [int]$ClientW, [int]$ClientH, [string]$CloseState) {
  # Numbers and two words only: no name, path or text. A write that fails is ignored (the window is closing).
  try { $o = [ordered]@{ about = 'RADE window place (a cache; delete it to open maximized again)'; x = $X; y = $Y; w = $W; h = $H; state = $State; dpi = $Dpi; closed = [ordered]@{ w = $ClientW; h = $ClientH; state = $CloseState } }
    Write-FileWhole (Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window.json') (($o | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4) + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ }
}
# L6 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): says whether the RADE tour was shown for this Windows profile before
# (RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt is there). Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false ($true when the file cannot be looked
# for, so a problem never shows the tour each time).
function Test-TourSeen { try { return [bool](Test-Path -LiteralPath (Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-tour.txt') -PathType Leaf) } catch { return $true } }
# Remembers that the RADE tour was shown: writes the date to RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt; a failure is ignored. Takes
# nothing; gives back nothing.
function Save-TourSeen {
  try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-tour.txt'; $d = Split-Path -Parent $p
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force) }
    Write-FileWhole $p ((Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd') + "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ }   # not saved: the tour shows one more time
}
function Get-MailTo([string]$Base) {
  # RADE\Config\rade-mail-to.txt: the address the results e-mail goes to (PFM 13 Nov; RADE R17). The window box saves it.
  # Until it exists, the app's old Config\90161Z-mail-to.txt is read.
  foreach ($p in @((Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-mail-to.txt'), (Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-mail-to.txt'))) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { return ([string](Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -TotalCount 1)).Trim() } catch { return '' } }
  }
  return ''
}
# Writes the results e-mail address to RADE\Config\rade-mail-to.txt, creating the folder if needed. Takes the base
# folder (not used) and the address; gives back nothing.
function Save-MailTo([string]$Base, [string]$To) {
  $null = $Base
  $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-mail-to.txt'
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, ($To.Trim() + "`r`n"), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true))
}
function Read-RoundHistory([string]$Base) {
  # Config\90161Z-history.csv: round, step, finish time, status, seconds (no DODID). Feeds the banner and the estimates.
  $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-history.csv'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $p) } catch { return @() } }
  return @()
}
# Adds one row (round, step, time, status, seconds) to the history file; a failure is ignored. Takes the base folder,
# step name, status and seconds; gives back nothing.
function Add-RoundHistory([string]$Base, [string]$Step, [string]$Status, [int]$Seconds) {
  try {
    $p = Get-ConfigFile $Base '90161Z-history.csv'
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force) }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Round = $round; Step = $Step; Finished = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'); Status = $Status; Seconds = $Seconds } |
      Export-Csv -LiteralPath $p -Append -NoTypeInformation
  } catch { $null = $_ }   # history is a convenience: never stop a round for it
}
function Get-NewerRound {
  # Reads go.md in the repository (the bookmark page's source; data, not code) and returns the highest round number listed in an open task
  # heading when it is newer than this one, else ''. Short timeout; any failure is silent, so it never blocks a run.
  try {
    $rq = Get-WebRequest $goUrl 4000   # engine/ps/07-checks.ps1: no Windows sign-in for the address, only for the proxy
    $rs = $rq.GetResponse()
    try { $text = (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($rs.GetResponseStream())).ReadToEnd() } finally { $rs.Close() }
    $mine = [int]($round -replace '\D', '')
    $max = 0
    foreach ($m in [regex]::Matches($text, '(?m)^## [^\r\n]*Round R(\d{2})[^\r\n]*\(open')) { $n = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value; if ($n -gt $max) { $max = $n } }
    if ($max -gt $mine) { return ('R{0:00}' -f $max) }
  } catch { $null = $_ }
  return ''
}
# Gives the one line about the last round on this computer, or says none is recorded. Takes the history rows; gives back
# the text.
function Get-LastRoundText($Hist) {
  $r = @($Hist | Where-Object { $_.Step -eq 'ROUND' })
  if (-not $r.Count) { return 'Last round on this computer: none recorded yet.' }
  $l = $r[-1]
  $word = @{ OK = 'passed'; CHECK = 'needed review'; STOPPED = 'stopped' }[[string]$l.Status]; if (-not $word) { $word = [string]$l.Status }
  return ('Last round on this computer: ' + $l.Round + ' ' + $word + ' on ' + $l.Finished + ' (took ' + (Format-Duration ([double]$l.Seconds)) + ').')
}
# Returns the seconds of the last successful run of a step on this computer, or 0. Takes the history and the step name.
function Get-StepEstimate($Hist, [string]$Name) {
  $r = @($Hist | Where-Object { $_.Step -eq $Name -and $_.Status -eq 'OK' -and $_.Seconds })   # last good run only
  if ($r.Count) { return [int]$r[-1].Seconds }
  return 0
}

# Gives a "What to do: ..." help line for a log line that matches a known problem, once for each problem in a round;
# else an empty text. Takes the log line; marks the problem as helped.
function Get-WhatToDo([string]$Line) {
