    $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecHead, 0, 0); $ui.Rec.SetColumnSpan($ui.RecHead, 3)
    # The painted list sits in a panel that scrolls only when the list is taller than the window (many reused checks at 150 %).
    $ui.RecScroll = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel
    $ui.RecScroll.Dock = 'Fill'; $ui.RecScroll.AutoScroll = $true; $ui.RecScroll.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $ui.RecScroll.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 4 0 24 0)
    $ui.RecScroll.Controls.Add($ui.RecChecks)
    $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecScroll, 0, 1); $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecSteps, 1, 1); $ui.Rec.Controls.Add($ui.RecText, 2, 1)
    # The Fill parts go in first: they dock last, inside the light, the logo line, the bottom line and the edge bar.
    foreach ($c in @($ui.Card, $ui.Rec, $ui.Bottom, $ui.Edge, $ui.Top, $ui.Light)) { $ui.Form.Controls.Add($c) }
    $ui.Form.ResumeLayout($false); $ui.Form.PerformLayout()

    # The lines of a hand step (the Administrator, 2026-11-17; R28 N4): a guide line that starts with "<digits>. " is numbered:
    # its number right-aligned in the left column, its text wrapped in the right column; any other line follows the list,
    # small and gray. All of it is ONE rich text box ($ui.Guide), so a person can select across lines. The plain parts stay in
    # $ui.GuideNums, $ui.GuideTexts and $ui.GuideRest (the tests read them). RTF: figure spaces right-align the numbers, a tab
    # and a hanging indent start the text column; sizes in twips from the pixels the box draws at.
    $ui.SetSteps = { param($Guide)
      $ui.GuideNums = @(); $ui.GuideTexts = @(); $ui.GuideRest = @()
      foreach ($g in @($Guide)) { $g = [string]$g
        if ($g -match '^(\d+)\.\s+(\S.*)$') { $ui.GuideNums += ($Matches[1] + '.'); $ui.GuideTexts += $Matches[2] } elseif ($g.Trim()) { $ui.GuideRest += $g.Trim() } }
      $on = [bool](@($ui.GuideNums).Count -or @($ui.GuideRest).Count); $ui.Guide.Visible = $on
      if (-not $on) { try { $ui.Guide.Clear() } catch { $null = $_ }; return }
      & $ui.GuideBuild; & $ui.FitSteps }
    # Escapes text for rich text (RTF): backslash and braces, and characters above 126 as \u codes. Takes the text; gives
    # back the escaped text.
    $ui.RtfEsc = { param([string]$T) $sb = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
      foreach ($ch in $T.ToCharArray()) { $n = [int]$ch; if ($ch -eq [char]92 -or $ch -eq '{' -or $ch -eq '}') { [void]$sb.Append([char]92).Append($ch) } elseif ($n -gt 126) { [void]$sb.Append('\u' + $(if ($n -gt 32767) { $n - 65536 } else { $n }) + '?') } elseif ($n -lt 32) { [void]$sb.Append(' ') } else { [void]$sb.Append($ch) } }
      return $sb.ToString() }
    # Builds the rich text of the hand-step box from $ui.GuideNums, $ui.GuideTexts and $ui.GuideRest (numbers right-aligned
    # in a column, then the small gray lines) and sets it into the box. Takes nothing; sets $ui.Guide.Rtf, $ui.GuideInkAt
    # and the box's screen-reader text.
    $ui.GuideBuild = {
      $g = $null; try { $g = $ui.Guide.CreateGraphics() } catch { $null = $_ }
      $dpi = 96.0; try { if ($g -and [double]$g.DpiX -gt 0) { $dpi = [double]$g.DpiX } } catch { $null = $_ }
      # Turns screen pixels into twips (1/1440 inch) at the box's dpi. Takes the pixels; gives back a whole number.
      $tw = { param([double]$Px) [int][math]::Round($Px * 1440.0 / $dpi) }
      $nw = 0; foreach ($n in @($ui.GuideNums)) { $w = 0; try { $w = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($g, $n, $ui.F.Body, (New-Object System.Drawing.Size(100000, 0)), [System.Windows.Forms.TextFormatFlags]'NoPadding, SingleLine').Width } catch { $w = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($n, $ui.F.Body).Width }; $nw = [math]::Max($nw, $w) }
      try { if ($g) { $g.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }
      $cT = & $tw ($nw + (& $ui.Sc 8)); $g1 = & $tw (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1); $g3 = & $tw (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G3)
      # Writes a color as the RTF color text (red, green, blue). Takes the color; gives back the text.
      $col = { param($C) '\red' + $C.R + '\green' + $C.G + '\blue' + $C.B + ';' }
      $fb = [int][math]::Round([double]$ui.F.Body.SizeInPoints * 2); $fs = [int][math]::Round([double]$ui.F.Small.SizeInPoints * 2)
      $paras = @(); $plain = 0; $wide = ''; $ui.GuideInkAt = 0
      # A shorter number gets figure spaces (as wide as a digit) in front: the numbers end on one line, and every line starts at
      # the left indent, so the first letter's place never depends on a tab (R28 job: a right tab was laid out late).
      $ml = 0; foreach ($n in @($ui.GuideNums)) { $ml = [math]::Max($ml, ([string]$n).Length) }
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideNums).Count; $i++) {
        $n = [string]$ui.GuideNums[$i]; $t = [string]$ui.GuideTexts[$i]; $pad = ([string][char]0x2007) * ($ml - $n.Length)
        if ($n.Length -eq $ml -and -not $wide) { $wide = $n; $ui.GuideInkAt = $plain }   # a widest number: its first letter is on the card edge
        $paras += ('\pard\li' + $cT + '\fi-' + $cT + '\tx' + $cT + '\sb' + $(if ($i) { $g1 } else { 0 }) + '\cf1\fs' + $fb + ' ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ($pad + $n)) + '\tab ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc $t))
        $plain += 2 + $pad.Length + $n.Length + $t.Length }   # padding, number, tab, text, and the line break
      for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideRest).Count; $i++) {
        $paras += ('\pard\li0\fi0\sb' + $(if ($i -or @($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $(if ($i) { 0 } else { $g3 }) } else { 0 }) + '\cf2\fs' + $fs + ' ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ([string]$ui.GuideRest[$i]))) }
      if (-not @($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $ui.GuideInkAt = 0 }
      $rtf = '{\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg1252\deff0\uc1{\fonttbl{\f0\fnil ' + (& $ui.RtfEsc ([string]$ui.F.Body.Name)) + ';}}{\colortbl ;' + (& $col $ui.C.Navy) + (& $col $ui.C.Gray) + '}\f0 ' + ($paras -join "\par`r`n") + '}'
      if ([int]$ui.ContentW -gt 0 -and $ui.Guide.Width -ne [int]$ui.ContentW) { $ui.Guide.Width = [int]$ui.ContentW }   # its final width first: a text laid out at the default 100 px kept a wrong place for its first letter (R28 job)
      $ui.GuideH = 0; $ui.Guide.Rtf = $rtf
      $ui.Guide.AccessibleDescription = ((@(for ($i = 0; $i -lt @($ui.GuideNums).Count; $i++) { [string]$ui.GuideNums[$i] + ' ' + [string]$ui.GuideTexts[$i] }) + @($ui.GuideRest)) -join ' ') }
    # How tall the text is: the rich text box says it (ContentsResized), or the place of its last letter plus one line.
    $ui.GuideNeed = { $h = [int]$ui.GuideH
      try { $n = [int]$ui.Guide.TextLength; if ($n -gt 0) { $pt = $ui.Guide.GetPositionFromCharIndex($n - 1); $lf = $(if (@($ui.GuideRest).Count) { $ui.F.Small } else { $ui.F.Body }); $h = [math]::Max($h, [int]$pt.Y + [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $lf).Height) } } catch { $null = $_ }
      return $h }
    # Sets the hand-step box to its width and the height its text needs. Takes nothing; changes the box size and does
    # nothing while it is already fitting.
    $ui.GuideFit = { if ($ui.InGuideFit) { return }; $ui.InGuideFit = $true
      try { if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $w = [int]$ui.ContentW; $h = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.GuideNeed) + (& $ui.Sc 2)); if ($ui.Guide.Width -ne $w) { $ui.GuideH = 0; $ui.Guide.Width = $w; $h = [math]::Max(1, (& $ui.GuideNeed) + (& $ui.Sc 2)) }; if ($ui.Guide.Height -ne $h) { $ui.Guide.Height = $h } } } catch { $null = $_ } finally { $ui.InGuideFit = $false } }
    # Where the ink of the guide's first number starts in the box: the place of the letter (as the box lays it out) plus the
    # letter's own left side (drawn once into a bitmap). A rich text box cannot be drawn into a bitmap, so $ui.Ink cannot measure it.
    $ui.Bearing = { param([string]$Ch, $F)
      $k = 'bearing|' + $F.Name + '|' + $F.SizeInPoints + '|' + $Ch; if ($ui.Inks.ContainsKey($k)) { return [int]$ui.Inks[$k] }; $v = 0
      try { $bm = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap(160, 160); try { $gb = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bm); $gb.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::White)
          [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::DrawText($gb, $Ch, $F, (New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0)), [System.Drawing.Color]::Black, [System.Windows.Forms.TextFormatFlags]'NoPadding'); $gb.Dispose(); $hit = -1
          for ($x = 0; $x -lt 80 -and $hit -lt 0; $x++) { for ($y = 0; $y -lt 160; $y++) { $px = $bm.GetPixel($x, $y); if ($px.R + $px.G + $px.B -lt 600) { $hit = $x; break } } }
          if ($hit -ge 0) { $v = $hit; $ui.Inks[$k] = $v } } finally { $bm.Dispose() } } catch { $null = $_ }
      return $v }
    # Gives the x place where the ink of the first number starts in the hand-step box (the letter's place plus its side
    # bearing); 0 when it cannot be read. Takes nothing.
    $ui.GuideInk = { try { $i = [int]$ui.GuideInkAt; $t = [string]$ui.Guide.Text; if ($i -ge $t.Length) { $i = 0 }; if (-not $t) { return 0 }
        $f = $(if (@($ui.GuideNums).Count) { $ui.F.Body } else { $ui.F.Small }); return ([int]$ui.Guide.GetPositionFromCharIndex($i).X + (& $ui.Bearing ([string]$t[$i]) $f)) } catch { return 0 } }
    # Fits the hand-step box after its text or the window width changed. Takes nothing; calls $ui.GuideFit.
    $ui.FitSteps = { & $ui.GuideFit }
    # Lays the card out again for the window's size: text widths, the choices, the step boxes and the buttons.
    $ui.Fit = {
      if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }   # R1 review: a size set while Windows Forms scales the form would be scaled again
      # Text wraps at the card's width; the choices are as wide as the card.
      # The text column: $ui.Layout.Share % of the card's width, at most $ui.Layout.MaxW (engine/window.json; the Administrator,
      # 2026-11-18), centered between the two sides. Below the cap the sides are (100 - share) / 2 % each, as before.
      $W = [int]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Width; $col = [math]::Min([int]($W * $ui.Layout.Share / 100), [int](& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.MaxW)); $side = [math]::Max(0, [int](($W - $col) / 2))
      try { if (@($ui.CardCols).Count -eq 3 -and ([int]$ui.CardCols[0].Width -ne $side -or [int]$ui.CardCols[1].Width -ne $col)) {
          $ui.CardCols[0].SizeType = 'Absolute'; $ui.CardCols[0].Width = $side; $ui.CardCols[1].SizeType = 'Absolute'; $ui.CardCols[1].Width = $col
          $ui.CardCols[2].SizeType = 'Percent'; $ui.CardCols[2].Width = 100 } } catch { $null = $_ }   # stand-in types or a form being closed: the card keeps its last columns
      $cw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 240), $col - (& $ui.Sc 4)); $ui.ContentW = $cw
      foreach ($l in @($ui.Kick, $ui.Turn, $ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathT, $ui.Now, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close)) { & $ui.SetWrap $l $cw }
      & $ui.SetWrap $ui.Sent ($cw - (& $ui.Sc 44))
      # Rows wrap at the card's width (a button or a box is never cut), and no box is wider than the card.
      $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M
      foreach ($r in @($ui.BtnRow, $ui.LinkRow, $ui.TestRow, $ui.FieldRow, $ui.StepRow)) { $r.MaximumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($cw + 2 * $mm), 0) }
      $ui.BtnRow.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($cw + 2 * $mm), 0)   # B3: the action row is as wide as the column, so the primary can stand at its right end (an auto-sized row wraps at its own width)
      & $ui.SetWrap $ui.StepName ($cw - (& $ui.Sc 8)); $ui.ErrBox.Width = [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.FieldL), ($cw - 2 * $mm))
      # The header's ink-tight texts get their size now that the window has its scale; a long name ends with "..." at the window's edge.
      try { $ui.AppL.Tag.MaxW = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 60), ($ui.Top.ClientSize.Width - (& $ui.LeftIn $ui.AppL $ui.Top) - (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.Inset))) } catch { $null = $_ }   # in the application row or the title column
      & $ui.InkFit $ui.WordL; & $ui.InkFit $ui.AppL
      try { $lh = [int][System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.Kick.Font).Height + (& $ui.Sc 2); if ($ui.Head.MinimumSize.Height -ne $lh) { $ui.Head.MinimumSize = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(0, $lh) } } catch { $null = $_ }   # L1: the header row keeps its height on a card with no line
      foreach ($l in @($ui.RightL, $ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac)) { & $ui.FixW $l }   # labels of changing values: one size from their widest value
      & $ui.FitRow; & $ui.Apart; & $ui.FitSent; & $ui.FitSteps; & $ui.FitEdges; & $ui.FitBar; & $ui.AlignRows
      foreach ($o in @($ui.Opts.Controls)) { $o.Width = $cw; try { $o.Height = (& $ui.OptPlan $o.Tag $cw).H } catch { $null = $_ } }
      & $ui.Squeeze }
    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/05-alignment.ps1 (sha256 5de96033a99f)
    # RADE window part 05, alignment and layout: centers a row of controls, breaks and fits long text, keeps the
    # card inside the window (Squeeze) and runs the layout self-check. Builds on 03-card.ps1.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- Alignment (the Administrator, 2026-11-15, after the R24 pictures; docs/window-design.md "Sizes"). An aligned row:
    # its parts share one vertical midpoint (each part's top margin is set from the tallest part). One left edge per card:
    # a label draws its text after a padding that grows with its font (Windows text padding: about 1/6 of the line), so a
    # 22 pt headline started about 3 px right of a 9 pt line and of the buttons. Each part moves by its own padding.
    # Where a part's ink starts, measured: the part drawn into a bitmap by Windows (DrawToBitmap: the same drawing as on
    # screen, with its own flags, padding and the first glyph's side bearing), the first column that differs from its back
    # color. A button with an edge starts at its edge. Without a bitmap (the test stand-ins), the text padding Windows adds
    # (1/6 em, rounded up). R24 job: a formula and a with/without-NoPadding measure both missed by 3 to 6 px.
    # One edge per card at $ui.Sc 10 from the card's column: room for the largest text inset (a 22 pt headline: about 7)
    # and for a button's 4 px margin, because a negative margin is taken as 0 in a table cell (R24 job).
    $ui.FitEdges = { try {
        $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; $x = & $ui.Sc 10; $ui.EdgeX = $x
        foreach ($l in @($ui.Kick, $ui.Turn, $ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathL, $ui.PathT, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close, $ui.Now, $ui.FieldL, $ui.TestL)) { & $ui.SetLeft $l ($x - (& $ui.Ink $l)) }
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.TickP 0; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.SentRow ($x - $(if ($ui.TickP.Visible) { & $ui.Ink $ui.TickP } else { & $ui.Ink $ui.Sent }))
        & $ui.FitStepEdge; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.ErrRow ($x - $ui.ErrBox.Margin.Left)
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.BtnRow ($x - $mm)   # a button's own 4 px margin (room for the ring)
        $l1 = @($ui.LinkRow.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($l1) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.LinkRow ($x - $mm - (& $ui.Ink $l1)) }   # a link's text is in the middle of its box
        if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Guide ($x - (& $ui.GuideInk)) }   # the widest number sits on the edge; shorter ones are right-aligned to it
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.Opts $x } catch { $null = $_ }
      & $ui.FitHead }
    # The step title's ink on the card's edge, and nothing after it in the step row moves when a new title starts with
    # another letter (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the row is 8 px left of the edge, and the title's left and right
    # margins share those 8 px (left = 8 - the ink of its first letter). Takes nothing; uses $ui.EdgeX.
    $ui.FitStepEdge = { $sd = & $ui.Sc 8; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.StepRow ([int]$ui.EdgeX - $sd); $il = [int][math]::Max(0, [math]::Min($sd, $sd - (& $ui.Ink $ui.StepName))); $m = $ui.StepName.Margin
      if ($m.Left -ne $il -or $m.Right -ne $sd - $il) { $ui.StepName.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($il, $m.Top, ($sd - $il), $m.Bottom) } }
    # R29b V1: the word RADE and the application name under it start their ink on one edge. Each sits at the same x in its row
    # (after a 64 px logo and its 12 px gap, or at 0) and draws its text ink-tight ($ui.InkText); what is left of a difference
    # (measured) moves each to the larger of the two. Takes nothing; changes the left margins of $ui.WordL, $ui.AppL and
    # $ui.HeadRule, and the width of $ui.HeadRule.
    $ui.FitHead = { try {
        if (-not (& $ui.HeadPair)) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.WordL 0; & $ui.SetLeft $ui.AppL 0; return }
        $iw = & $ui.Ink $ui.WordL; $ia = & $ui.Ink $ui.AppL; $e = [math]::Max($iw, $ia)
        & $ui.SetLeft $ui.WordL ($e - $iw); & $ui.SetLeft $ui.AppL ($e - $ia)
        # L2: the line under the word is as wide as the word's ink and starts where it starts.
        # R34: the width comes from the ink Windows drew in the panel ($ui.InkBox, the measure of the self-check), not from the
        # panel's width: at 150 % in ISE the panel was 114 wide and the drawn word 93 (each card had the defect).
        if ($ui.AppUnder) { & $ui.SetLeft $ui.HeadRule $e; $rw = & $ui.RuleW; if ($ui.HeadRule.Width -ne $rw) { $ui.HeadRule.Width = $rw } } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no measure (no window handle yet): the next fit sets the edges
    # The width of the line under the word RADE: the width of the word's drawn ink, measured once for each text, font and
    # panel size. Takes nothing; gives back the width in pixels (at least 1).
    $ui.RuleW = { $w = $ui.WordL; $f = $w.Font; $k = 'rule|' + [string]$w.Text + '|' + $f.Name + '|' + $f.SizeInPoints + '|' + $w.Width + 'x' + $w.Height
      if ($ui.Inks.ContainsKey($k)) { return [int]$ui.Inks[$k] }
      $b = & $ui.InkBox $w; $v = [math]::Max(1, [int]$b.Right - [int]$b.Left)
      $all = ([int]$b.Left -eq 0 -and [int]$b.Top -eq 0 -and [int]$b.Right -eq [int]$w.Width -and [int]$b.Bottom -eq [int]$w.Height)
      if (-not $all) { $ui.Inks[$k] = $v }   # only a measure is kept (review of PR 123: also when the ink is as wide as the panel); the whole box is the fallback
      return $v }   # no measure (no window handle yet): the next fit sets the edges
    # Whether the header shows the application name on the edge of the word RADE: the name has text and shows, and both rows
    # start at the same x (both logos, or no application logo). Takes nothing; gives back $true or $false.
    $ui.HeadPair = { [bool]([string]$ui.AppL.Text -and $(if ($ui.AppUnder) { $ui.AppL.Visible } else { $ui.AppRow.Visible }) -and ($ui.AppUnder -or $ui.Logo)) }
    # The x of a control inside one of its parents (the sum of the lefts on the way up). Takes the control and the parent;
    # gives back the pixels.
    $ui.LeftIn = { param($C, $P) $x = 0; $c = $C; while ($c -and -not [object]::ReferenceEquals($c, $P)) { $x += [int]$c.Left; $c = $c.Parent }; $x }
    # The step bar's own top margin, scaled ($ui.Z.BarTop at 100 %). Takes nothing; gives back the pixels.
    $ui.BarTop = { & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.BarTop }
    # The height a label has with a text in it. An empty label asks for less (31 against 33 px at 150 %; R32), so a row aligned
    # before its first text was 1.5 px off the bar afterwards. Takes the label; gives back the pixels.
    $ui.LabelH = { param($L) try { if (-not [string]$L.Text) { $ui.Probe.Font = $L.Font; $ui.Probe.Text = '0'; return [int]$ui.Probe.PreferredSize.Height } } catch { $null = $_ }; return [int]$L.PreferredSize.Height }   # no probe: the label's own answer
    # R29b N3: the time in this step and its count sit on the vertical midpoint of the step's bar (the same flow line: each
    # part's top is the line's top plus its top margin). A text taller than the bar's place moves the bar down; that lift is
    # worked out from $ui.BarTop each time, so it never adds up. Takes nothing; changes the top margins of $ui.StepBar,
    # $ui.StepTime and $ui.StepFrac.
    $ui.AlignTick = { try {
        $b0 = [int](& $ui.BarTop)
        $h = [int](& $ui.LabelH $ui.StepTime); $lift = [int][math]::Max(0, [math]::Ceiling($h / 2.0 - ($b0 + [double]$ui.StepBar.Height / 2.0)))   # a text taller than the bar's place: the bar moves down
        $m = $ui.StepBar.Margin; if ($m.Top -ne $b0 + $lift) { $ui.StepBar.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, ($b0 + $lift), $m.Right, $m.Bottom) }
        $bm = [double]$ui.StepBar.Margin.Top + [double]$ui.StepBar.Height / 2.0
        foreach ($l in @($ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac)) { $hl = [int](& $ui.LabelH $l); $t = [int][math]::Max(0, [math]::Round($bm - $hl / 2.0, [System.MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero)); $m = $l.Margin
          if ($m.Top -ne $t) { $l.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, $t, $m.Right, $m.Bottom) } } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no bar yet: the next fit aligns the row
    # R32 (the Administrator, 2026-11-18: "too much dead space", "the bar is not on the middle of the sentence"): in a narrow
    # window a step title of some length left no room for the 200 px bar, so the bar went to a line of its own under the
    # title. The bar now takes the room that is left beside the title and the time (200 px at most, 60 at least, at 100 %)
    # and goes under the title only when even 60 does not fit. Takes nothing; changes the width of $ui.StepBar.
    $ui.FitBar = { try {
        $full = & $ui.Sc 200; $m = $ui.StepBar.Margin; $row = [int]$ui.StepRow.MaximumSize.Width; if ($row -le 0) { return }
        $tw = [int]$ui.StepTime.Width   # one size from its widest value ($ui.FixW), so the bar keeps its width while the time counts
        $fw = [int]$ui.StepFrac.Width + $ui.StepFrac.Margin.Left   # the count is in the row also when it is empty: with no room it took a line of its own, which was the empty space under the title
        $room = $row - [int]$ui.StepName.Width - $ui.StepName.Margin.Left - $ui.StepName.Margin.Right - $m.Left - $m.Right - $tw - $fw - (& $ui.Sc 8)
        $w = $(if ($room -ge (& $ui.Sc 60)) { [int][math]::Min($full, $room) } else { $full })
        if ($ui.StepBar.Width -ne $w) { $ui.StepBar.Width = $w } } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no measure yet: the next fit sets it
    # Centers a row of controls up and down by changing their top and bottom margins. Takes the controls and the top margin
    # of the row; gives back nothing.
    $ui.AlignRow = { param($Parts, [int]$Base)
      try { $hs = @($Parts | ForEach-Object { if ($_.AutoSize) { [int]$_.PreferredSize.Height } else { [int]$_.Height } }); $hh = [int]($hs | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Parts.Count; $i++) { $m = $Parts[$i].Margin; $t = $Base + [int][math]::Floor(($hh - $hs[$i]) / 2); $b = $Base + $hh - $hs[$i] - ($t - $Base)
          if ($m.Top -ne $t -or $m.Bottom -ne $b) { $Parts[$i].Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($m.Left, $t, $m.Right, $b) } } } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Returns the controls of one aligned row (Top, FieldRow, ...). Takes the row name.
    $ui.RowParts = { param([string]$Row) switch ($Row) { 'Top' { @(@($ui.Logo, $ui.TitleCol) | Where-Object { $_ }) } 'AppRow' { @(@($ui.AppLogo, $ui.AppL) | Where-Object { $_ }) } 'FieldRow' { @($ui.FieldL, $ui.FieldBox) + @($(if ($ui.FieldBOn) { $ui.FieldB })) } 'TestRow' { @($ui.TestL, $ui.ToBoxF, $ui.DraftB, $ui.OkBox) } } }
    # Lines up every fixed row: box heights, the text box in its frame, then each row on one center line.
    $ui.AlignRows = { try { $bh = [int]$ui.FieldB.Height; if ($bh -gt 0) { foreach ($p in $ui.Boxes) { if ($p.Height -ne $bh) { $p.Height = $bh } } } } catch { $null = $_ }   # a box is as tall as the compact button, measured
      foreach ($p in $ui.Boxes) { & $ui.BoxFit $p }   # the text box fills its frame (R24 job: a frame whose size never changed kept a 100 px text box at its top)
      & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'Top') 0; if (-not $ui.AppUnder) { & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'AppRow') 0 };   # no application logo: the name is in the title column with its own 4 px gap (review of PR 106: a row of one part set it to 0)
      $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'TestRow') $mm; & $ui.AlignTick
      # L3 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): a label above its box (a text answer). The box is on the next line, on the card's edge, 4 px under the label.
      if ($ui.FieldAbove) { $ui.FieldL.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($ui.FieldL.Margin.Left, $mm, 0, 0); $ui.FieldBox.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding([int]$ui.EdgeX, (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1), $mm, $mm) }
      else { $bx = $ui.FieldBox.Margin; $g2 = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G2; if ($bx.Left -ne $g2) { $ui.FieldBox.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($g2, $bx.Top, $mm, $bx.Bottom) }; & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'FieldRow') $mm } }
    # The question headline (the prompt's first sentence, manifest "answers") shrinks to fit one line: from the headline size
    # in 0.5 pt steps to 60 % of it (never under the body size); only at that size does it wrap. Other cards keep the headline size.
    $ui.SentFonts = @{}
    # Every text the window puts into a wrapping label of the card: a word wider than the line is broken (M3 review). A
    # label's text set elsewhere since the last break (for example a note) is taken as its new text.
    $ui.Raw = @{}
    # Re-breaks the long words of every card text so each line fits its width. Takes nothing; changes the label texts (the
    # raw text is kept in $ui.Raw).
    $ui.BreakAll = { foreach ($l in @($ui.Kick, $ui.P[0], $ui.P[1], $ui.P[2], $ui.P[3], $ui.PathT, $ui.StepName, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.Close)) {
        try { $w = [int](& $ui.GetWrap $l); if ($w -le 0 -or -not $l.Text) { continue }
          $e = $ui.Raw[$l]; $raw = $(if ($e -and [string]$l.Text -ceq [string]$e.Out) { [string]$e.Raw } else { [string]$l.Text })
          $b = & $ui.BreakLong $raw $l.Font $w; $ui.Raw[$l] = @{ Raw = $raw; Out = $b }; if ([string]$l.Text -cne $b) { $l.Text = $b } } catch { $null = $_ } }
      & $ui.CutNow }   # the now-doing line is cut again from its whole text at the new width (review of PR 121)
    # Fits the headline: on an answer card the font shrinks, not below the body size, until the text fits one line; then it
    # breaks long words and calls $ui.BreakAll. Takes nothing; changes $ui.Sent.
    $ui.FitSent = { try {
        $f = $ui.F.Sent; $w = [int](& $ui.GetWrap $ui.Sent); $t = [string]$ui.SentRaw
        if ($ui.View -eq 'answer') { $pt = [double]$ui.F.Sent.SizeInPoints / $ui.FontK; $floor = [math]::Max($pt * 0.6, [double]$ui.F.Body.SizeInPoints / $ui.FontK)
          while ($w -gt 0 -and $pt -gt $floor -and [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText($t, $f).Width -gt $w) {
            $pt = [math]::Max($floor, $pt - 0.5); $k = [string]$pt; if (-not $ui.SentFonts.ContainsKey($k)) { $ui.SentFonts[$k] = & $ui.Font ([string]$ui.F.Sent.Name) $pt $null }; $f = $ui.SentFonts[$k] }
        }
        if (-not [object]::ReferenceEquals($ui.Sent.Font, $f)) { $ui.Sent.Font = $f }
        $b = & $ui.BreakLong $t $f $w; if ($ui.Sent.Text -ne $b) { $ui.Sent.Text = $b } } catch { $null = $_ }
      & $ui.BreakAll }
    $ui.FitRow = {
      # The box of a box row takes the width that is left beside its label and its button (at most 420). A box under its
      # label (L3) is as wide as the card's text: from the card's edge to the end of the text column.
      try { $cw = $ui.ContentW
        if ($ui.FieldAbove) { $ui.FieldBox.Width = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 160), ($cw - (& $ui.Sc 10))); return }
        $left = $cw - $ui.FieldL.PreferredSize.Width - (& $ui.Sc 20)
        if ($ui.FieldBOn) { $left -= ($ui.FieldB.Width + (& $ui.Sc 8)) }
        $ui.FieldBox.Width = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 160), [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.FieldM), [int]$left)) } catch { $null = $_ } }
    $ui.Apart = {
      # UI standard v1 (B3, the Administrator, 2026-11-20): the primary button is the last one and stands alone at the right
      # end of the action row ("Back (Esc)" at the left end, the others after it). When the row is too narrow for that, the
      # primary button starts its own row.
      try { $mm = & $ui.Sc $ui.Z.M; $n = -1; $prev = -1; $used = 0
        for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ui.NB; $k++) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.B[$k], $false); $ui.B[$k].Margin = (& $ui.Pad $mm $mm $mm $mm); if ($ui.BOn[$k] -and $ui.BMain[$k]) { $n = $k } }   # every button: a hidden one keeps no old margin
        $bt = $mm + $(if (@($ui.BOn | Where-Object { $_ }).Count) { [int][math]::Floor(((& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.ActionH) - $ui.BackB.Height) / 2) } else { 0 })   # Back (Esc) on the midpoint of the 40 px buttons
        $ui.BackB.Margin = (& $ui.Pad $mm $bt $mm $mm); $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.BackB, $false)
        if ($n -lt 0) { try { $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }; return }   # no layout yet: the card's layout does it
        if ($ui.BackOn) { $prev = -2; $used += $ui.BackB.Width + 2 * $mm }   # a flag, not .Visible: the row can still be hidden from the card before
        for ($k = 0; $k -lt $n; $k++) { if ($ui.BOn[$k]) { $prev = $k; $used += $ui.B[$k].Width + 2 * $mm } }
        if ($prev -eq -1) { $used = 0 }
        $room = $(if ($ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width -gt 0) { [int]$ui.BtnRow.MaximumSize.Width } else { $ui.ContentW + 2 * $mm }) - (& $ui.Sc 2)   # the width the row really wraps at, 2 px slack
        $left = $room - $used - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm
        if ($left -lt $mm) { if ($prev -ge 0) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.B[$prev], $true) } elseif ($prev -eq -2) { $ui.BtnRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.BackB, $true) }; $left = $room - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm }   # too narrow: its own row
        $ui.B[$n].Margin = (& $ui.Pad ([int][math]::Max($mm, $left)) $mm $mm $mm); $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout()
        $f = $(if ($ui.BackOn) { $ui.BackB } else { @(for ($k = 0; $k -lt $n; $k++) { if ($ui.BOn[$k]) { $ui.B[$k] } })[0] })   # the row still wrapped: the primary at the right end of its own row
        if ($f -and -not [object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.B[$n]) -and $ui.B[$n].Top -gt $f.Top + $f.Height) { $ui.B[$n].Margin = (& $ui.Pad ([int][math]::Max($mm, $room - $ui.B[$n].Width - $mm)) $mm $mm $mm) }
        $ui.BtnRow.PerformLayout()   # the row's height is right before the frame is placed ($ui.Squeeze)
      } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Places the card frame (L1) and lets the card's text scroll when the card is taller than the window (the help below).
    $ui.Squeeze = {
      <#
      .SYNOPSIS
      Places the card frame (L1) and lets the card's text scroll when the card is taller than the window, so the buttons stay in view.
      .DESCRIPTION
      The frame's top is fixed for a window size; a card too tall for the room under it moves up before it scrolls. A short
      card gets a gap above its buttons, so the frame is its minimum height.
      .OUTPUTS
      Nothing. Sets the card's top row, the size of $ui.Scroll and $ui.Gap, $ui.Scrolls and $ui.Frame (what the self-check compares).
      #>
      if (-not $ui.Scaled) { return }
      if ($ui.InSqueeze) { return }; $ui.InSqueeze = $true
      try { $bh = [int]$ui.Body.Height; $bw = [int]$ui.Body.Width; $H = [int]$ui.Card.ClientSize.Height; $hh = [int]$ui.Head.Height; $th = [int]$ui.Tail.Height
        $min = [math]::Min((& $ui.Sc $ui.Layout.FrameMin), $H); $want = [int][math]::Floor(($H - $min) * 0.4); $top = $want
        $need = $hh + $bh + $th; if ($need -gt $H - $top) { $top = [math]::Max(0, $H - $need) }   # a tall card moves up before it gets a scroll bar
        $avail = $H - $top - $hh - $th; $sh = $bh; $bar = 0
        if ($bh -gt $avail) { $sh = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 80), $avail); $bar = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VerticalScrollBarWidth + (& $ui.Sc 4) }
        $ui.Scrolls = [bool]$bar; $gap = [math]::Max(0, $min - $hh - $sh - $th)
        $ui.Frame = @{ WantTop = $want; MinH = $min; Moved = ($top -ne $want) }
        if ($ui.Scroll.Width -ne ($bw + $bar) -or $ui.Scroll.Height -ne $sh) { $ui.Scroll.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(($bw + $bar), $sh) }
        if ($ui.Gap.Height -ne $gap) { $ui.Gap.Height = $gap }; if ($ui.Gap.Visible -ne [bool]$gap) { $ui.Gap.Visible = [bool]$gap }
        try { if ([int]$ui.CardRows[0].Height -ne $top) { $ui.CardRows[0].Height = $top } } catch { $null = $_ }   # stand-in types: no row styles
      } catch { $null = $_ } finally { $ui.InSqueeze = $false } }   # a size that cannot be read: the next fit places the frame
    $ui.Body.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze }); $ui.Tail.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze }); $ui.Head.Add_SizeChanged({ & $ui.Squeeze })
    $ui.Card.Add_SizeChanged({ try { & $ui.Fit } catch { $null = $_ } })
    # Counts how many lines a text takes at a width, at least 1 and at most a limit (0 for no text). Takes the text, font,
    # width, one line's height and the limit; gives back the number.
    $ui.Rows = { param([string]$Text, $Font, [int]$W, [int]$LineH, [int]$Most) if (-not $Text) { return 0 }; [math]::Min($Most, [math]::Max(1, [int][math]::Round((& $ui.Meas $Text $Font $W).Height / [math]::Max(1, $LineH)))) }
    $ui.OptPlan = { param($o, [int]$w)
      # Where the parts of one choice go, and how tall it is. The name gets its width first. The two facts stay on the
      # right when the name and they fit on one line; else they go on one line under the summary. The summary, a blocked
      # application's reason and its "What to do" wrap to 2 lines each, then end with "...".
      $pad = & $ui.Sc 16; $x = $pad + (& $ui.Sc 38); $inner = $w - $x - $pad; $gap = & $ui.Sc 12
      $h1 = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.Body).Height; $h2 = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText('Ag', $ui.F.Small).Height
      $vw = 0; if ($o.Ver) { $vw = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$o.Ver, $ui.F.Small).Width }
      $nw = [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$o.Name, $ui.F.Body).Width
      $rw = 0; foreach ($r in @($o.R1, $o.R2)) { if ($r) { $rw = [math]::Max($rw, [System.Windows.Forms.TextRenderer]::MeasureText([string]$r, $ui.F.SmallB).Width) } }
      $under = [bool]($rw -and -not $o.Off -and ($nw + $vw + $gap + $rw) -gt $inner)
      $tw = $inner; if ($rw -and -not $under) { $tw = $inner - $rw - $gap }
      $s1 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub) $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }) $tw $h2 2; $s2 = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Sub2) $ui.F.Small $tw $h2 2; $nl = & $ui.Rows ([string]$o.Note) $ui.F.SmallB $tw $h2 2
      $need = $h1 + ($s1 + $s2 + $nl + [int]$under) * $h2
      $hh = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 66), ($need + (& $ui.Sc 20)))
      return @{ H = [int]$hh; Pad = $pad; X = $x; Tw = [int]$tw; Rw = $rw; Under = $under; S1 = $s1; S2 = $s2; NL = $nl; H1 = $h1; H2 = $h2; Vw = $vw; Nw = $nw; Y = [int](($hh - $need) / 2) } }
    $ui.PaintOpt = { param($P, $G)
      # One choice: a key (1 to 9), the name and version, the summary, an optional notice, and two facts. An application
      # that cannot run here is not a button: a red cross, the reason, what to do, and the word FAILED.
      try {
        $o = $P.Tag; $w = $P.ClientSize.Width; $h = $P.ClientSize.Height; $G.Clear($ui.C.White)
        $pl = & $ui.OptPlan $o $w; $pad = $pl.Pad; $x = $pl.X; $y = $pl.Y; $h1 = $pl.H1; $h2 = $pl.H2; $tw = $pl.Tw; $rw = $pl.Rw
        $one = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine, EndEllipsis'; $wrap = 'Left, Top, NoPrefix, WordBreak, EndEllipsis, TextBoxControl'
        if ($o.Off) {
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Hair); $G.DrawLine($pn, 0, 0, $w, 0); $pn.Dispose()
          $cp = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } else { $ui.C.Red }), [single](& $ui.Sc 2)); $d = & $ui.Sc 12; $cx = $pad + (& $ui.Sc 6); $cy = [int](($h - $d) / 2)
          if ($o.Soon) { $G.DrawLine($cp, $cx, ($cy + [int]($d / 2)), ($cx + $d), ($cy + [int]($d / 2))) }   # not built yet: a gray dash, no failure
          else { $G.DrawLine($cp, $cx, $cy, ($cx + $d), ($cy + $d)); $G.DrawLine($cp, ($cx + $d), $cy, $cx, ($cy + $d)) }; $cp.Dispose()
        } else {
          $foc = [bool]$P.Focused; $t = $(if ($foc) { & $ui.Sc 2 } else { 1 })
          $pn = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($(if ($foc) { $ui.C.Navy } else { $ui.C.Edge }), [single]$t); $i = [int]($t / 2); $G.DrawRectangle($pn, $i, $i, ($w - 1 - 2 * $i), ($h - 1 - 2 * $i)); $pn.Dispose()
          $k = & $ui.Sc 24; $ky = [int](($h - $k) / 2); $kp = New-Object System.Drawing.Pen($ui.C.Edge); $G.DrawRectangle($kp, $pad, $ky, $k, $k); $kp.Dispose()
          & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Key) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Gray $pad $ky $k $k 'HorizontalCenter, VerticalCenter, NoPrefix, SingleLine'
        }
        $nw = [math]::Max((& $ui.Sc 40), [math]::Min($pl.Nw, ($tw - $pl.Vw)))   # the name first; the version keeps its place after it
        & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Name) $ui.F.Body $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.C.Gray } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $x $y $nw $h1 $one
        if ($o.Ver) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Ver) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray ($x + $nw) $y ([math]::Max(1, ($tw - $nw))) $h1 $one }
        $yy = $y + $h1
        if ($o.Sub) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Sub) $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }) $(if ($o.Off -and -not $o.Soon) { $ui.C.Navy } else { $ui.C.Gray }) $x $yy $tw ($pl.S1 * $h2) $wrap; $yy += $pl.S1 * $h2 }
        if ($o.Sub2) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Sub2) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Navy $x $yy $tw ($pl.S2 * $h2) $wrap; $yy += $pl.S2 * $h2 }
        if ($pl.Under) { & $ui.Word $G ((@($o.R1, $o.R2) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join $dot) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Navy $x $yy $tw $h2 $one; $yy += $h2 }
        if ($o.Note) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.Note) $ui.F.SmallB $ui.C.Navy $x $yy $tw ($pl.NL * $h2) $wrap }
        if ($rw -and -not $pl.Under) {
          $rx = $w - $pad - $rw
          if ($o.R1) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.R1) $(if ($o.Off) { $ui.F.SmallB } else { $ui.F.Small }) $(if ($o.Soon) { $ui.C.Gray } elseif ($o.Off) { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.Navy }) $rx ($y + (& $ui.Sc 2)) $rw $h2 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
          if ($o.R2) { & $ui.Word $G ([string]$o.R2) $ui.F.Small $ui.C.Gray $rx ($y + $h1) $rw $h2 'Right, Top, NoPrefix, SingleLine' }
        }
      } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Fills the choice list with one button for each item (the old ones are kept to dispose after the window closes).
    # Takes the list of items (name, version, notes).
    $ui.FillOpts = { param($List)
      $ui.Trash = @($ui.Trash) + @($ui.Opts.Controls); $ui.Opts.Controls.Clear()   # old choices are disposed after the window has closed: a button is never disposed inside its own Click
      $n = 0
      foreach ($o in @($List | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        $said = (@($o.Name, $o.Ver, $o.Sub, $o.Sub2, $o.Note, $o.R1, $o.R2) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join '. '
        if ($o.Off) { $c = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Panel; $c.AccessibleRole = 'StaticText'; $c.AccessibleName = $said }
        else {
          $n++; $o.Key = $n
          $c = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button; $c.FlatStyle = 'Flat'; $c.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0; $c.UseVisualStyleBackColor = $false; $c.Text = ''; $c.AccessibleName = ('Choice ' + $n + ': ' + $said)
          $c.Add_Click({ if ($ui.OnOpt -and -not $ui.Busy -and (& $ui.Settled)) { & $ui.OnOpt ([int]$this.Tag.Index) } }); $c.Add_GotFocus({ $this.Invalidate() }); $c.Add_LostFocus({ $this.Invalidate() })
        }
        $c.Tag = $o; $c.BackColor = $ui.C.White; $c.Margin = (& $ui.Pad 0 0 0 (& $ui.Sc 8))
        $hh = & $ui.Sc $(if ($o.Note -or $o.Sub2) { 86 } else { 66 }); try { $hh = (& $ui.OptPlan $o $ui.ContentW).H } catch { $null = $_ }   # as tall as its lines, 66 at least
        $c.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size($ui.ContentW, $hh)
        $c.Add_Paint({ & $ui.PaintOpt $this $_.Graphics })
        [void]$ui.Opts.Controls.Add($c)
      } }
    $ui.Measure = { param([string]$Card)
      # The numbers for RowBad and EdgeBad, from the real layout (screen pixels).
      $out = @(); $sr = { param($C) $C.RectangleToScreen($C.ClientRectangle) }
      foreach ($row in 'Top', 'AppRow', 'FieldRow', 'TestRow') {
        $ps = @(& $ui.RowParts $row); if ($ps.Count -lt 2 -or -not $ps[0].Parent.Visible) { continue }   # the parts AlignRow aligns (R5 review: one rule for both)
        $out += & $ui.RowBad $Card $row @($ps | ForEach-Object { $rr = & $sr $_; @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $_); Top = $rr.Top; H = $rr.Height; Line = $rr.Top - $_.Margin.Top; Kind = $(if ($ui.Boxes -contains $_) { 'box' } elseif ($_ -is [System.Windows.Forms.Button] -and $_.FlatAppearance.BorderSize -gt 0) { 'button' } else { 'other' }) } })
      }
      # R32: the bottom line's link and its text at the right share one midpoint.
      if ($ui.RecB.Visible -and $ui.RightL.Visible -and [string]$ui.RightL.Text) { $out += & $ui.RowBad $Card 'Bottom' @(@($ui.RecB, $ui.RightL) | ForEach-Object { $rr = & $sr $_; @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $_); Top = $rr.Top; H = $rr.Height; Line = 0; Kind = 'other' } }) }
      # R29b: the header's two lines start their ink on one edge (no difference allowed), and the step's time and count sit on
      # the bar's midpoint (1 px at any scale) when they are on the bar's line.
      # Returns where a control's ink starts (its left edge plus the measured ink offset: text, edge or drawing). Takes the control.
      $tx = { param($C) (& $sr $C).Left + (& $ui.Ink $C) }
      if ($ui.WordL.Visible -and (& $ui.HeadPair)) { $out += & $ui.HeadBad $Card @{ N = 'WordL'; X = (& $tx $ui.WordL) } @{ N = 'AppL'; X = (& $tx $ui.AppL) } }
      if ($ui.AppUnder -and $ui.WordL.Visible -and (& $ui.HeadPair)) {   # L2: the word, 4 px, the line, 4 px, the name, measured on the ink Windows drew
        $rw = & $sr $ui.WordL; $rr = & $sr $ui.HeadRule; $ra = & $sr $ui.AppL; $wi = & $ui.InkBox $ui.WordL; $ai = & $ui.InkBox $ui.AppL
        $out += & $ui.HeadRuleBad $Card @{ WordBottom = $rw.Top + $wi.Bottom; WordLeft = $rw.Left + $wi.Left; WordW = $wi.Right - $wi.Left; RuleTop = $rr.Top; RuleBottom = $rr.Bottom; RuleLeft = $rr.Left; RuleW = $rr.Width
          AppTop = $(if ([string]$ui.AppL.Text -cmatch '[A-Z0-9bdfhklt]') { $ra.Top + $ai.Top } else { $null }) } (& $ui.Sc $ui.Z.G1) }
      if ($ui.FieldRow.Visible -and $ui.FieldAbove -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rl = & $sr $ui.FieldL; $rb = & $sr $ui.FieldBox   # L3: the label above its box
        $out += & $ui.AboveBad $Card @{ LabelBottom = $rl.Bottom; BoxTop = $rb.Top; BoxLeft = $rb.Left; BoxW = $rb.Width; Edge = (& $tx $ui.FieldL); TextW = ($ui.ContentW - (& $ui.Sc 10)) } }
      if ($ui.Frame -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rh = & $sr $ui.Head; $rt = & $sr $ui.Tail; $rc = & $sr $ui.Card   # L1: the header row at the fixed top, the frame at its minimum height at least
        $out += & $ui.FrameBad $Card @{ Top = $rh.Top - $rc.Top; WantTop = $ui.Frame.WantTop; H = $rt.Bottom - $rh.Top; MinH = $ui.Frame.MinH; Moved = $ui.Frame.Moved } }
      if ($ui.StepRow.Visible -and -not $ui.RecOn) { $rb = & $sr $ui.StepBar
        foreach ($l in @($ui.StepTime, $ui.StepFrac)) { $rl = & $sr $l; if (($rl.Top - $l.Margin.Top) -eq ($rb.Top - $ui.StepBar.Margin.Top) -and $rl.Left -gt $rb.Left) { $out += & $ui.TickBad $Card @{ Top = $rb.Top; H = $rb.Height } @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $l); Top = $rl.Top; H = $rl.Height } } } }
      if (-not $ui.RecOn) {
        $es = @()   # the card column: where each part's ink starts ($tx above)
        if ($ui.Kick.Visible -and $ui.Kick.Text) { $es += @{ N = 'Kick'; X = (& $tx $ui.Kick) } }
        if ($ui.Turn.Visible -and $ui.Turn.Text) { $es += @{ N = 'Turn'; X = (& $tx $ui.Turn) } }
        if ($ui.TickP.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'TickP'; X = (& $tx $ui.TickP) } } elseif ($ui.Sent.Visible -and $ui.Sent.Text) { $es += @{ N = 'Sent'; X = (& $tx $ui.Sent) } }
        foreach ($l in @(@($ui.P) + @($ui.PathL, $ui.PathT, $ui.Close, $ui.StepName, $ui.Now, $ui.FieldL, $ui.Note, $ui.Help, $ui.Foot, $ui.TestL))) { if ($l.Visible -and $l.Text) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $l); X = (& $tx $l) } } }
        if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'Guide'; X = (& $sr $ui.Guide).Left + (& $ui.GuideInk) } }   # the widest number of the numbered list
        if ($ui.ErrBox.Visible) { $es += @{ N = 'ErrBox'; X = (& $sr $ui.ErrBox).Left } }
        $k1 = @($ui.LinkRow.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($k1) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $k1); X = (& $tx $k1); D = ('link ink ' + (& $ui.Ink $k1) + ', width ' + $k1.Width + ', margin ' + $k1.Margin.Left + ', row margin ' + $ui.LinkRow.Margin.Left) } }
        $o1 = @($ui.Opts.Controls | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($o1) { $es += @{ N = 'choice 1'; X = (& $sr $o1).Left } }
        $b1 = @(@($ui.BackB) + @($ui.B | Where-Object { [string]$ui.Kinds[$_] -ne 'primary' }) | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; if ($b1) { $es += @{ N = (& $ui.NameOf $b1); X = (& $tx $b1) } }   # B3: the primary stands at the right end
        $out += & $ui.EdgeBad $Card $es
      }
      return $out }
    $ui.Scale = {
      # The scaling facts, numbers only (R24: the screen dpi said 100 % while every size was 1.5 x). DeviceDpi exists from .NET 4.7.
      try { $f = $ui.Form; $dd = 'n/a'; try { $pp = $f.GetType().GetProperty('DeviceDpi'); if ($pp) { $dd = [string]$pp.GetValue($f, $null) } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $as = $f.CurrentAutoScaleDimensions; $sn = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::FromControl($f)
        # The process dpi awareness, read from Windows Forms itself (its internal DpiHelper, .NET 4.7+); no native call: that
        # would need C# compiled on the work computer. PerMonitorV2 with dpiX 96 and autoScale 144 is the R24 case.
        $aw = 'n/a'; try { $dh = $f.GetType().Assembly.GetType('System.Windows.Forms.DpiHelper'); if ($dh) { $bf = [System.Reflection.BindingFlags]'NonPublic, Public, Static'; $pm = $dh.GetProperty('IsPerMonitorV2Awareness', $bf)
            if ($pm) { $aw = $(if ([bool]$pm.GetValue($null, $null)) { 'PerMonitorV2' } else { 'not-PerMonitorV2' }) } } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $sd = $f.AutoScaleDimensions; $rd = 'n/a'; try { if ($script:native -and $f.IsHandleCreated) { $rd = [string][Rade.Native]::GetDpiForWindow($f.Handle) } } catch { $null = $_ }
        $lg = $(if ($ui.Logo) { [string]$ui.Logo.Width + 'x' + $ui.Logo.Height } else { 'n/a' }); $b1 = @($ui.B | Where-Object { $_.Visible })[0]; $bt = $(if ($b1) { [string]$b1.Width + 'x' + $b1.Height } else { 'n/a' })
        $l = ('SCALE dpiX=' + [int]$ui.ScreenDpi + ' deviceDpi=' + $dd + ' mode=' + [string]$f.AutoScaleMode + ' asd=' + [int]$sd.Width + 'x' + [int]$sd.Height + ' autoScale=' + [int]$as.Width + 'x' + [int]$as.Height + ' font=' + [int]$f.Font.Height + ' fontPt=' + $f.Font.SizeInPoints + ' fontScale=' + $ui.FontK + ' ctlScale=' + [math]::Round($ui.Dpi / 96.0, 2) + ' realDpi=' + $rd + ' aware=' + $aw + ' screen=' + $sn.Bounds.Width + 'x' + $sn.Bounds.Height +
          ' work=' + $sn.WorkingArea.Width + 'x' + $sn.WorkingArea.Height + ' client=' + $f.ClientSize.Width + 'x' + $f.ClientSize.Height + ' state=' + [string]$f.WindowState + ' logo=' + $lg + ' btn=' + $bt + ' shown=' + $(if ($ui.ShownAt) { $ui.ShownAt } else { 'n/a' }) + ' placed=' + $ui.Placed + ' lastClose=' + $(if ($ui.LastClose) { $ui.LastClose } else { 'n/a' }))
        $sy = 'n/a'; try { $sy = [string][Rade.Dpi]::GetDpiForSystem() } catch { $null = $_ }   # no Rade.Dpi (not Windows, before 1607): n/a
        return ($l + ' thread=' + $script:dpiThread + ' sysDpi=' + $sy)   # R34: the window thread's dpi awareness (01-setup.ps1) and the system dpi
      } catch { return ('SCALE could not be read: ' + (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_.Exception.Message))) } }
    $ui.ScaleKeep = 20   # the SCALE lines rade-window-scale.txt keeps (E4)
    # E4 (R42 plan; the Administrator, 2026-11-21): each RADE window writes its SCALE line, with the time, its own host name and
    # its own process name (no other process is read), to RADE\Config\rade-window-scale.txt when it is shown, so a round's
    # results hold the line of every RADE window, also one opened from the RADE shortcut in another process. The file keeps
    # the last $ui.ScaleKeep lines. Numbers and names of programs only: no path, user or site. A failure is ignored. Takes nothing.
    $ui.LogScale = {
      try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window-scale.txt'; $d = Split-Path -Parent $p
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Container)) { [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force) }
        $exe = 'n/a'; try { $exe = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().ProcessName } catch { $null = $_ }   # no name: the line says n/a
        $line = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') + ' host=' + ([string]$Host.Name -replace '\s', '') + ' exe=' + $exe + ' build=' + $buildId + ' ' + (& $ui.Scale)
        $old = @(); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { $old = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $p | Where-Object { $_ }) }
        Write-FileWhole $p ((@(@($old) + @($line)) | Select-Object -Last $ui.ScaleKeep) -join "`r`n") } catch { $null = $_ } }   # not written: the round has no line of this window
    # The SCALE lines of the RADE windows shown since this window opened ($ui.OpenedAt), this one included, for the round's
    # results (E4). Takes nothing; gives back the lines (none when the file cannot be read).
    $ui.ScaleLines = {
      try { $p = Get-RadeConfigFile 'rade-window-scale.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)) { return @() }
        $since = $ui.OpenedAt.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
        return @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $p | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d) ' -and [string]::CompareOrdinal($Matches[1], $since) -ge 0 } | ForEach-Object { 'WINDOW ' + $_ }) } catch { return @() } }
    # Gives the result of the layout self-check: its pass line, or the defects found, with the window size and scale. Takes
    # nothing; gives back the text.
    $ui.LayLine = {
      & $ui.Check
      $pct = [int][math]::Round($ui.Dpi / 96.0 * 100); $sp = [int][math]::Round($ui.ScreenDpi / 96.0 * 100)   # the form's scale (the one source); the screen dpi beside it when it differs
      $size = [string]$ui.Form.ClientSize.Width + ' x ' + $ui.Form.ClientSize.Height + ' at ' + [string]$pct + ' %' + $(if ($sp -ne $pct) { ' (the form auto-scale; the screen dpi says ' + $sp + ' %)' } else { '' })
      $sc = $(if ($ui.LayScroll.Count) { '; the text scrolls on: ' + ((@($ui.LayScroll.Keys) | Sort-Object) -join ', ') } else { '' })
      if ($ui.LayBad.Count) { return ('Layout self-check: ' + $ui.LayBad.Count + ' defects in ' + $ui.LayCards.Count + ' cards (' + $size + ')' + $sc + "`r`n" + (& $ui.Scale) + "`r`n" + (@($ui.LayBad) -join "`r`n")) }
      return ('Layout self-check: PASS layout, ' + $ui.LayCards.Count + ' cards (' + $size + ')' + $sc + "`r`n" + (& $ui.Scale)) }
    # Sets a label's text and shows it only when the text is not empty. Takes the label and the text; gives back nothing.
    $ui.Show = { param($C, [string]$Text) $C.Text = $Text; $C.Visible = [bool]$Text }
    # A script whose hash does not match its own hash line (the Administrator, 2026-11-19; docs/specs/bundle-hash.md R3): on the
    # boot, choose and ready cards the last line says so in dark red, in place of the card's own last line, with the full
    # "Script check:" line under it (E1, R42 plan, the Owner, 2026-11-21: the values to compare, before Run). The Ready card
    # (the card with Run) always shows the full "Script check:" line under its own last line: checked, does not match, or not
    # available. A match and a hash that cannot be read show nothing on the boot and choose cards. Takes the card; changes the
    # color and text of $ui.Foot.
    $ui.ScriptWarn = { param($c)
      $bad = [bool]($script:scriptCheck.Short -and -not $script:scriptCheck.Ok); $line = [string]$script:scriptCheck.Line
      if ($bad -and [string]$c.View -in 'boot', 'choose', 'ready') { & $ui.Show $ui.Foot ('This script does not match its hash. Do not run it.' + $(if ($line) { "`r`n" + $line } else { '' })); $ui.Foot.ForeColor = $ui.C.Red }
      else { $ui.Foot.ForeColor = $ui.C.Gray
        if ([string]$c.View -eq 'ready' -and $line) { & $ui.Show $ui.Foot (@(@([string]$c.Foot, $line) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join "`r`n") } } }
    # Sets what each card text box with changing values can show on the card that comes ($ui.Range): the card's Range names
    # them (Kick, P0, StepName: lists of texts); a part the card does not name has no range. Takes the card's Range (or $null).
    $ui.SetRange = { param($R) foreach ($k in 'Kick', 'P0', 'StepName') { $box = $(if ($k -eq 'P0') { $ui.P[0] } else { $ui[$k] })
        $v = $(if ($R -and $R[$k]) { @($R[$k] | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) } else { $null }); if ($v) { $ui.Range[$box] = $v } else { $ui.Range.Remove($box) }; & $ui.Reflow $box } }
    $ui.SetCard = { param($c)
      # Shows one card. $c names the parts: View, Light ('you' = yellow and "Your turn", 'bad' = dark red), Range ($ui.SetRange), Kicker, Sentence, Tick, P (up to 4
      # paragraphs), Options + OnOption, Lines (guide lines, in order: numbered ones first, others after them; one selectable text), Path (a file path), StepRow, Field (Label, Text, Name, Button, Do, Max, Above), Err, Links, Note, Help, Close (the hand card's closing line),
      # Buttons (Text, Kind, Do, Apart; up to $ui.NB), Foot, Test, Right, Back, NoAccept, Focus ('field', 'fieldbutton', 'err' or 'text').
      & $ui.Check   # the card that goes away (test rounds only)
      $ui.Hot = $null; $ui.Down = $null   # no hover or pressed state is carried over (R4 review)
      if ($ui.RecOn -and ($c.Light -or $c.View -eq 'done')) { $ui.RecOn = $false; $ui.Rec.Visible = $false; $ui.Card.Visible = $true; $ui.RecB.Visible = $true }   # a card that needs you closes the Record
      $ui.View = [string]$c.View; $ui.Card.SuspendLayout()
      $ui.Light.BackColor = $(if ($c.Light -eq 'you') { $ui.C.Yellow } elseif ($c.Light -eq 'bad') { $ui.C.Red } else { $ui.C.White })
      $ui.Light.AccessibleName = 'Status light: ' + $(if ($c.Light -eq 'you') { 'your turn' } elseif ($c.Light -eq 'bad') { 'failed' } else { 'off' })
      & $ui.SetRange $c.Range; $ui.Kick.Text = ([string]$c.Kicker).ToUpperInvariant()   # the line in capitals keeps its line also when empty
      $ui.Turn.Text = $(if ($c.Light -eq 'you') { 'Your turn' } else { '' }); $ui.Turn.AccessibleName = $(if ($ui.Turn.Text) { 'Your turn' } else { 'Your turn line (empty)' })
      $ui.SentRaw = [string]$c.Sentence; $ui.Sent.Text = $ui.SentRaw; $ui.TickP.Visible = [bool]$c.Tick
      $ps = @($c.P | Where-Object { $_ }); for ($k = 0; $k -lt 4; $k++) { & $ui.Show $ui.P[$k] $(if ($k -lt $ps.Count) { [string]$ps[$k] } else { '' }) }
      $ui.OnOpt = $c.OnOption; & $ui.FillOpts $c.Options; $ui.Opts.Visible = [bool]$ui.Opts.Controls.Count
      & $ui.SetSteps $c.Lines
      $ui.PathL.Visible = [bool]$c.Path; & $ui.Show $ui.PathT ([string]$c.Path)
      $ui.StepRow.Visible = [bool]$c.StepRow; $ui.NowRaw = ''; $ui.Now.Text = ''; $ui.Now.Visible = [bool]$c.StepRow; if ($c.StepRow) { $ui.StepTime.Text = '' }   # the run card keeps the now-doing room, empty until a text comes
      $ui.FieldRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Field; $ui.FieldDo = $null
      $ui.FieldAbove = [bool]($c.Field -and $c.Field.Above); try { $ui.FieldRow.SetFlowBreak($ui.FieldL, $ui.FieldAbove) } catch { $null = $_ }   # L3: the box goes under its label
      if ($c.Field) { $ui.FieldL.Text = [string]$c.Field.Label; $ui.Field.Text = [string]$c.Field.Text; $ui.Field.AccessibleName = [string]$c.Field.Name; $ui.FieldB.Visible = [bool]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldBOn = [bool]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldB.Text = [string]$c.Field.Button; $ui.FieldDo = $c.Field.Act; $ui.Field.MaxLength = $(if ($c.Field.Max) { [int]$c.Field.Max } else { 32767 }); & $ui.FitRow }
      $ui.ErrRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Err; if ($c.Err) { $ui.ErrBox.Text = '' }
      $ui.LinkRow.Visible = [bool]($c.Links -or $c.PageLink); $ui.CopyPathB.Visible = [bool]$c.Links; $ui.ShowFileB.Visible = [bool]$c.Links; $ui.PageB.Visible = [bool]$c.PageLink
      & $ui.Show $ui.Note ([string]$c.Note); & $ui.Show $ui.Help ([string]$c.Help); & $ui.Show $ui.Foot ([string]$c.Foot); & $ui.Show $ui.Close ([string]$c.Close)
      & $ui.ScriptWarn $c   # the script's hash does not match: a red last line on the boot, Choose and Ready cards
      $bm = & $ui.Sc $(if ($c.Close) { $ui.Z.G2 - $ui.Z.M } else { $ui.Z.G4 - $ui.Z.M }); $bn = $ui.BtnRow.Margin; if ($bn.Top -ne $bm) { $ui.BtnRow.Margin = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Padding($bn.Left, $bm, $bn.Right, $bn.Bottom) }   # 8 under the closing line, else 16
      # UI standard v1 (B3, B4): the primary button goes last (Enter selects it); the others keep their order.
      $bs = @(@($c.Buttons | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.Kind -ne 'primary' }) + @($c.Buttons | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]$_.Kind -eq 'primary' }))
      $ui.Acts = @(); $first = $null; $accept = $null; $ui.BOn = @($false) * $ui.NB; $ui.BMain = @($false) * $ui.NB; $ui.Always = @($false) * $ui.NB
      $ui.Back = $c.Back; $ui.BackOn = ([bool]$c.Back -and -not $ui.RecOn); $ui.BackB.Visible = $ui.BackOn   # B6: Back (Esc) at the left end of the action row
      for ($k = 0; $k -lt $ui.NB; $k++) {
        $b = $ui.B[$k]
        if ($k -lt $bs.Count) {
          $b.Text = [string]$bs[$k].Text; & $ui.Style $b ([string]$bs[$k].Kind); $b.Visible = $true; $ui.Acts += $bs[$k].Act; $ui.BOn[$k] = $true; $ui.BMain[$k] = ([string]$bs[$k].Kind -eq 'primary'); $ui.Always[$k] = [bool]$bs[$k].Always
          if ($b.Enabled -and -not $first) { $first = $b }; if ($b.Enabled -and -not $accept -and $bs[$k].Kind -eq 'primary') { $accept = $b }
        } else { $b.Visible = $false; $ui.Acts += $null }
      }
      & $ui.Apart
      $ui.BtnRow.Visible = [bool]($bs.Count -or $ui.BackOn)
      $ui.TestRow.Visible = [bool]$c.Test
      $ui.Form.AcceptButton = $(if ($c.NoAccept) { $null } else { $accept })   # Enter = the primary button, except on a hand step
      $ui.CardNow = $c; $ui.TourB.Visible = ($ui.HelpViews -contains [string]$c.View -and -not $ui.RecOn)   # L6: Help on a card that can be shown again
      $ui.FeedB.Visible = [bool]((& $ui.NoteOn) -and -not $ui.RecOn -and [string]$c.View -notin $ui.NoNoteViews); $ui.RightL.Text = $(if ($c.Right) { [string]$c.Right } else { '' })   # R-top-bar (2026-11-19): no state words; only the percent, the time or a result word
      & $ui.FitSent; & $ui.FitEdges; & $ui.FitBar; & $ui.AlignRows   # the step bar's width for this card's step row before it is drawn (R35 job: the first Run card wrapped the time under the title)
      $ui.Card.ResumeLayout(); try { $ui.Card.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }
      if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { try { $ui.Guide.Refresh() } catch { $null = $_ }; & $ui.GuideFit; & $ui.FitEdges }   # the rich text box finishes its layout when it paints: paint it (no message pump), then measure its edge again (R28 job: 4 to 13 px off on the first hand card)
      try { $ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0) } catch { $null = $_ }; & $ui.Squeeze   # a new card starts at its top
      $f = $null
      if ($c.Focus -eq 'field') { $f = $ui.Field } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'fieldbutton') { $f = $ui.FieldB } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'err') { $f = $ui.ErrBox } elseif ($c.Focus -eq 'text') { $f = $(if ($ui.Guide.Visible) { $ui.Guide } else { $ui.Sent }) }   # a card with no box: the focus on its text, so Enter answers nothing
      elseif ($ui.Opts.Controls.Count) { foreach ($o in @($ui.Opts.Controls)) { if (-not $o.Tag.Off) { $f = $o; break } } }
      if (-not $f) { $f = $accept }; if (-not $f) { $f = $first }; if (-not $f) { $f = $ui.RecB }
      if (-not $ui.RecOn) { try { [void]$f.Focus() } catch { $null = $_ } }
      # Focus on the card's own text (a hand step with no address) must not scroll it: Windows scrolls a focused control into
      # view, so the card started scrolled to its end (R35 job: deploy-tour-small 08-noaddress-hand, 11 px). It starts at its top.
      if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.Guide) -or [object]::ReferenceEquals($f, $ui.Sent)) { try { $ui.Scroll.AutoScrollPosition = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(0, 0) } catch { $null = $_ } }   # no scroll position yet: the card is at its top
      # The guard counts from here, when the card is built and the person can see it (M2 review): a click that waited in the
      # queue while the card was built comes in during this DoEvents, inside the guard, and is dropped.
      $ui.CardAt = $ui.Clock.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds
      [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
    # Brings the window to the front (restores it when minimized) without keeping it on top.
    $ui.ToFront = { try { if ([string]$ui.Form.WindowState -eq 'Minimized') { $ui.Form.WindowState = 'Normal' }; $ui.Form.TopMost = $true; $ui.Form.Activate(); $ui.Form.TopMost = $false } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Shows one gray line under the card's box or buttons, or hides it for empty text. Takes the text.
    $ui.Say1 = { param([string]$Text) $ui.Note.Text = $Text; $ui.Note.Visible = [bool]$Text }   # one gray line under the card's box or buttons

    # ==== Engine part: engine/ps/window/06-open.ps1 (sha256 8902d389d1b2)
    # RADE window part 06, the opening views: boot, Choose (pick an application), the site address card, and the
    # check cards (needs you, failed). Uses the card of 03-card.ps1 and the engine checks.
    # Joined into every bundle by engine/rade_build.py; Windows PowerShell 5.1.

    # ---- When the window opens: the Local checks of every application in the paste run once (base checks before Choose).
    # An application with a FAILED one cannot be chosen. A newer version on the RADE page is read here too (test and deploy).
    $ui.RunBase = {
      $ui.BaseIds = @(); foreach ($a in $apps) { foreach ($id in @($a.Checks)) { $d = Get-CheckDef $id; if ($d -and $d.Group -eq 'Local' -and $d.Kind -eq 'auto' -and $ui.BaseIds -notcontains $id) { $ui.BaseIds += $id } } }
      $cache = Read-CheckCache; $bp = Get-BasePath; $site = Get-SiteUrl $bp; $i = 0; $ui.Busy = $true; $ui.BaseRes = @{}
      try {
        foreach ($id in $ui.BaseIds) {
          if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
          $i++; $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $ui.RightL.Text = 'Check ' + $i + ' of ' + $ui.BaseIds.Count
          $r = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $false
          if (-not $r) { $r = Invoke-Check $d $bp $site { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() } }
          $ui.BaseRes[$id] = $r; & $ui.RecRefresh   # an open Record shows the new result
        }
        # One read per application (4 s at most each); after one slow read the others are not tried.
        $slow = $false
        for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) {
          if ($slow -or $ui.Newer.ContainsKey($j)) { continue }
          $t0 = Get-Date; $script:app = $apps[$j]; $ui.Newer[$j] = [string](Get-NewerVersion); if (((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds -gt 3) { $slow = $true }
        }
        if (-not $ui.ContainsKey('NewRound')) { $ui.NewRound = [string](Get-NewerRound) }
      } finally { $ui.Busy = $false; Select-App 0 } }
    $ui.VNoApps = {
      # R28: a paste that lists no application (a manifest or build fault): say so, with what to do, instead of an empty list.
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'noapps'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Nothing to choose'; Sentence = 'No application is listed in this paste.'
        P = @('This paste has nothing that RADE can install or run.', 'What to do: close this window and copy the paste again from the RADE page. If it is still empty, ask in the Teams channel.'); Help = (Get-HelpLine)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Close'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }) } }
    $ui.VBootErr = { param([string]$Why)
      # R28: the checks that run when the window opens stopped with an error: a card, not a blank window.
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'booterr'; Light = 'bad'; Kicker = 'Stopped'; Sentence = 'RADE could not check this computer.'
        P = @($Why, 'Nothing was changed.', 'What to do: select "Try again". If it stops again, ask in the Teams channel.'); Help = (Get-HelpLine)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Try again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Boot } }, @{ Text = 'Close'; Act = { $ui.Form.Close() } }) }
      & $ui.ToFront }
    # Shows the Choose card: one option for each application, off when one of its checks failed. Takes nothing; selects the
    # first application and sets the card.
    $ui.VChoose = {
      if (@($apps).Count -eq 0) { & $ui.VNoApps; return }
      Select-App 0; $ui.Picked = $false; $ui.Plan = $null; $ui.StartAfter = $false; $ui.AppL.Text = $ui.Tagline; & $ui.ShowAppRow $true; $list = @(); $dep = $false; $ui.Blocked = @{}; $ui.BlockedFix = @{}
      for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) { foreach ($id in @($apps[$j].Checks)) { $r = $ui.BaseRes[$id]; if ($r -and $r.State -eq 'FAILED') { $ui.Blocked[$j] = ((Get-CheckDef $id).Name + ': ' + $r.Detail); $ui.BlockedFix[$j] = $(if ($r.Fix) { 'What to do: ' + $r.Fix } else { '' }); break } } }
      for ($j = 0; $j -lt $apps.Count; $j++) {
        $a = $apps[$j]; if ([string]$a.Mode -eq 'deploy') { $dep = $true }
        if ($ui.Blocked.ContainsKey($j)) { $list += @{ Off = $true; Index = $j; Name = [string]$a.Name; Ver = $(if ($a.Version) { ' ' + $a.Version } else { '' }); Sub = [string]$ui.Blocked[$j]; Sub2 = [string]$ui.BlockedFix[$j]; R1 = 'FAILED' }; continue }
        $f = Get-AppFact $a $ui.Hist
        $list += @{ Index = $j; Name = [string]$a.Name; Ver = $(if ($a.Version) { ' ' + $a.Version } else { '' }); Sub = [string]$a.Summary; R1 = $f.Steps; R2 = $f.Installed
          Note = $(if ($ui.Newer[$j]) { 'Version ' + $ui.Newer[$j] + ' is on the RADE page. This paste installs ' + $a.Version + '.' } else { '' }) }
      }
      $nr = [string]$ui.NewRound
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'choose'; Sentence = $(if ($dep) { 'Which application do you want to install?' } else { 'Which application do you want to run?' })
        P = @($(if ($nr) { 'A newer round, ' + $nr + ', is in the repository. Close this window and run ' + $nr + ' instead.' } else { '' })); Options = $list; OnOption = { param($j) & $ui.Pick $j }
        PageLink = [bool](@($ui.Newer.Values | Where-Object { $_ }).Count)
        Buttons = @($(if ($ui.Blocked.Count) { @{ Text = 'Check this computer again'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Boot } } } else { $null })); Foot = $(if ($dep) { '' } else { Get-LastRoundText $ui.Hist }) } }
    # Shows "Checking this computer", runs the base checks and then shows Choose; shows the error card when they stop. Takes
    # nothing.
    $ui.Boot = {
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'boot'; Sentence = 'Checking this computer.'; P = @('This takes a few seconds. Nothing is changed.') }
      try { & $ui.RunBase } catch { if (-not ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing)) { & $ui.VBootErr (ConvertTo-Masked ([string]$_.Exception.Message)) }; return }
      if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
      if (Test-TourSeen) { & $ui.VChoose } else { $ui.TourFrom = $null; & $ui.VTour 0 } }   # L6: the tour comes one time, before the first Choose
    # L6 (the Administrator, 2026-11-19): the RADE tour, 5 cards: what RADE does, your turn and RADE's turn, what Done,
    # It failed and Skip mean, where the results go, and the Record. Shown one time for a Windows profile, before the first
    # Choose (RADE\Config\rade-tour.txt), and again from "Help (F1)". S = the headline of a card, P = its paragraphs.
    $ui.TourCards = @(
      @{ S = 'RADE installs and tests applications on this computer.'; P = @('You choose an application. RADE checks this computer, then does the work as a list of steps.', 'A test of an application is called a round.') },
      @{ S = 'RADE does most steps. Some steps are yours.'; P = @('When RADE does a step, the bottom right shows its progress. Keep the window open.', 'A yellow line at the top: RADE waits for you. The card says what to do.') },
      @{ S = 'A step that you do has up to three answers.'; P = @('"Done": you did the step and it worked.', '"It failed": the step did not work. RADE then asks what the error said.', '"Skip": you did not do the step. A card shows only the answers that fit its step.') },
      @{ S = 'The results stay on this computer.'; P = @('RADE writes a report into its results folder. RADE sends nothing.', 'After a test round RADE makes an e-mail draft with the results. You read it, and you send it.') },
      @{ S = 'The Record shows everything.'; P = @('Select "Record" or press F2 to see all checks, steps, files and the log.', 'Select "Help" or press F1 to see this tour again.') })
    # The cards that "Help (F1)" can leave and show again: no step or check runs on them, and none waits inside the engine.
    $ui.HelpViews = @('choose', 'maint', 'tools', 'toolres', 'restmark', 'restpick', 'restconfirm', 'site', 'fail', 'need', 'ready', 'nodrive', 'done', 'review', 'stopped', 'noapps', 'booterr')
    # Shows card $I of the tour (0 = the first). "Next" and "Back" move; "Skip the tour" and the last card's button end it.
    # Takes the card number.
    $ui.VTour = { param([int]$I)
      $n = $ui.TourCards.Count; $ui.TourI = [math]::Max(0, [math]::Min($n - 1, $I)); $tc = $ui.TourCards[$ui.TourI]; $last = ($ui.TourI -eq $n - 1)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'tour'; Kicker = ('RADE tour' + $dot + ($ui.TourI + 1) + ' of ' + $n); Sentence = [string]$tc.S; P = @($tc.P)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = $(if ($last) { 'Close the tour' } else { 'Next' }); Kind = 'primary'; Act = { if ($ui.TourI -ge $ui.TourCards.Count - 1) { & $ui.EndTour } else { & $ui.VTour ($ui.TourI + 1) } } },
          $(if ($last) { $null } else { @{ Text = 'Skip the tour'; Act = { & $ui.EndTour } } }))
        Back = $(if ($ui.TourI) { { & $ui.VTour ($ui.TourI - 1) } } else { $null }) } }   # B6: the one Back pattern
    # Ends the tour: remembers that it was shown (Save-TourSeen) and shows the card it came from (Choose on the first run).
    # Takes nothing.
    $ui.EndTour = { Save-TourSeen; $from = $ui.TourFrom; $ui.TourFrom = $null; if ($from) { & $ui.SetCard $from } else { & $ui.VChoose } }
    # "Help (F1)": opens the tour from a card of $ui.HelpViews while nothing runs; the tour's end shows that card again
    # (a box on it has its first text again). Takes nothing.
    $ui.OpenTour = {
      if ($ui.Busy -or $ui.Running -or $ui.RecOn -or $ui.HelpViews -notcontains [string]$ui.View) { return }
      $ui.TourFrom = $ui.CardNow; & $ui.VTour 0 }
    $ui.TourB.Add_Click({ & $ui.OpenTour })
    # Resets what the user chose: each step to its default, clean-up on, no step states. Takes nothing.
    $ui.InitSel = { $ui.Sel = @{}; foreach ($k in $script:appSteps) { $ui.Sel[[int]$k] = [bool](Get-StepDefault $k) }; $ui.Clean = $true; $ui.StepState = @{} }
    # Shows or hides the application row of the logo block (its logo, its name) and the link line above it (only when both
    # logos are there). Takes whether to show it.
    $ui.ShowAppRow = { param([bool]$On)
      # The name is as tall as its text before the row shows, and the window lays out once more so the logo block (docked,
      # sized by the window) takes the row's height: the first card after the choice is measured before the next fit
      # (Windows job, 18 Nov 26: the row at 76 needed 23 px in a 98 px block).
      if ($On) { & $ui.InkFit $ui.AppL }   # before the window has its scale: the next fit sizes it
      if ($ui.AppUnder) { $ui.AppL.Visible = $On; $ui.HeadRule.Visible = $On } else { $ui.AppL.Visible = $On; $ui.AppRow.Visible = $On }   # no application logo: the name is the subtitle under RADE (R29b V1)
      $ui.LinkLine.Visible = ($On -and $ui.Logo -and $ui.AppLogo)
      & $ui.FitHead; & $ui.AlignRow (& $ui.RowParts 'Top') 0   # the title column is taller with its subtitle: the RADE row is centered again
      try { $ui.Form.PerformLayout() } catch { $null = $_ }   # no form yet (text mode): nothing to lay out
      if ($ui.AppLogo) { $ui.AppLogo.AccessibleName = $(if ($On -and $ui.Picked) { $script:app.Name + ' logo' } else { 'Application logo' }) } }
    # Takes the application the user chose: selects it, reuses base check results that can be reused, and shows Maintenance
    # (already installed) or the checks. Takes the application number.
    $ui.Pick = { param([int]$J)
      Select-App $J; $ui.Picked = $true
      # The base checks are not run twice, except the ones whose answer can change at any time ($checkNoSave: Word open, disk, write).
      foreach ($id in $script:appChecks) { if ($ui.BaseRes.ContainsKey($id) -and $checkNoSave -notcontains $id -and $ui.BaseRes[$id].State -in 'PASSED', 'WARNING') { $script:checkResults[$id] = $ui.BaseRes[$id] } }
      $ui.AppL.Text = $script:app.Name + $(if ($script:app.Version) { ' ' + $script:app.Version } else { '' }); & $ui.ShowAppRow $true
      & $ui.InitSel
      $e = $null; if (Test-Deploy) { $e = (Read-Installed (Get-InstalledKey $script:app)) }
      if ($e -and $e.installed) { & $ui.VMaint $e.installed } else { & $ui.Checks $false } }
    # Shows the Maintenance card of an installed application. Takes its install record (version and date).
    $ui.VMaint = { param($Inst)
      $ui.MaintInst = $Inst   # Back on the Maintenance screen shows this card again
      # Maintenance (the Administrator, 2026-11-14; docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types"): shown for an application that is
      # installed. UI standard v1 (the Administrator, 2026-11-20): the card has Start, "Maintenance" (its own screen,
      # $ui.VTools: Update or Repair, Diagnose, Back up, Restore) and Uninstall set apart; Uninstall has no engine function yet.
      $on = ''; try { $on = $dot + 'installed ' + ([datetime][string]$Inst.at).ToString('d MMM yy', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) } catch { $null = $_ }
      $verb = 'Install ' + $script:app.Version
      try { $c = ([version][string]$script:app.Version).CompareTo([version][string]$Inst.version); if ($c -gt 0) { $verb = 'Update to ' + $script:app.Version } elseif ($c -eq 0) { $verb = 'Repair' } } catch { $null = $_ }
      # Start (R28 fix: the PFM found no Start button): the installed application with a start script can be started from here too.
      # It runs the checks first (Start comes only after they pass: AGENTS.md "RADE and the app"), then starts the application.
      $ui.StartAfter = $false; $startB = $null; $startMain = $false
      if ([string]$script:app.Start -and (Get-StartPath)) { $startMain = ([string]$Inst.version -eq [string]$script:app.Version); $startB = @{ Text = 'Start ' + $script:app.Name; Kind = $(if ($startMain) { 'primary' } else { '' }); Act = { $ui.StartAfter = $true; & $ui.Checks $false } } }
      $ui.MaintVerb = $verb   # read when the button is clicked (a scriptblock does not keep this card's local variables)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'maint'; Kicker = ($script:app.Name + ' ' + $Inst.version + $on); Sentence = 'Maintenance'
        P = @(('Maintenance holds ' + $verb + ', Diagnose, Back up and Restore.'), $(if ($startB) { 'Start runs the checks, then opens ' + $script:app.Name + '.' } else { '' }))
        Note = 'Uninstall is not in this version of RADE yet.'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Uninstall'; Kind = 'dangeroff' }, $startB, @{ Text = 'Maintenance'; Kind = $(if ($startMain) { '' } else { 'primary' }); Act = { & $ui.VTools $ui.MaintVerb } })   # Uninstall first: away from the primary   # B5: 1 primary + 3 others at most
        Back = { & $ui.VChoose } } }
    # The Maintenance screen (the Administrator, 2026-11-20): Update or Repair (works: the checks, then the install run),
    # and the list of Diagnose and Back up (engine-v30) and Restore (engine-v31; docs/engine.md "Maintenance run types").
    # Takes the install verb ("Update to <version>" or "Repair").
    $ui.VTools = { param([string]$Verb)
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'tools'; Kicker = [string]$ui.Kick.Text; Sentence = 'Maintenance'
        # The tools are a list (the Administrator, 2026-11-20: Repair must not stand alone on a row): one row each, as on Choose,
        # with what it does; shown not available until it is built. The action row is Back (Esc) and the install verb.
        P = @(($Verb + ' adds what is missing and keeps your data.'))
        Options = (& $ui.ToolRows); OnOption = { param($j) & $ui.RunTool $j }   # Diagnose and Back up run on a click; Restore opens its cards (window/11-tools.ps1)
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = $Verb; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.Checks $false } })
        Back = { & $ui.VMaint $ui.MaintInst } } }
    # Says whether the chosen application has a check that needs the site address. Takes nothing; gives back $true or
    # $false.
    $ui.NeedSite = { [bool](@($script:appChecks | Where-Object { $_ -in 'net-site', 'site-rights' }).Count) }
    # Shows the card that asks for the site address (filled with the saved one, or the DAF SharePoint start).
    $ui.VSite = {
      $v = Get-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath); if (-not $v) { $v = $sitePrefix }   # PFM 14 Nov 26: the box starts with the DAF SharePoint address
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'site'; Sentence = 'Which site does the application go to?'; P = @('RADE writes to this SharePoint site. The address is saved for next time.')
        Field = @{ Label = 'Site address'; Text = $v; Name = 'Site address, starts with https://' }; Focus = 'field'
        Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Continue'; Kind = 'primary'; Act = { & $ui.SaveSite } }); Back = { & $ui.VChoose } }
      try { $ui.Field.SelectionStart = $ui.Field.Text.Length; $ui.Field.SelectionLength = 0 } catch { $null = $_ } }
    # Saves the address in the box when it is a valid site address, drops the site checks' old results and runs the checks
    # again; else says what is wrong. Takes nothing.
    $ui.SaveSite = {
      $v = $ui.Field.Text.Trim()
      if (-not (Test-SiteUrl $v)) { & $ui.Say1 ('The address must look like ' + $sitePrefix + 'name'); return }
      try { $null = Save-SiteUrl (Get-BasePath) $v } catch { $null = $_ }
      foreach ($id in 'net-site', 'site-rights') { if ($script:checkResults.ContainsKey($id)) { $script:checkResults.Remove($id) } }
      & $ui.Checks $false }
    $ui.Checks = { param([bool]$Force)
      # The chosen application's checks that run on their own. A check with a result from this window is kept unless $Force
      # ("Run checks again"); a saved result (RADE\Config\rade-checks.json) is reused as before.
      $bp = Get-BasePath; $site = Get-SiteUrl $bp
      if ((& $ui.NeedSite) -and -not (Test-SiteUrl $site)) { & $ui.VSite; return }
      $ids = @($script:appChecks); $cache = Read-CheckCache; $script:savedWhy = @{}
      $ui.Cancel = $false
      & $ui.SetCard @{ View = 'checking'; Sentence = 'Checking this computer and your access.'; P = @('Read-only. Nothing is changed.'); Range = @{ P0 = @($ids | ForEach-Object { [string](Get-CheckDef $_).Name }) }; Buttons = @(@{ Text = 'Cancel'; Always = $true; Act = { & $ui.CancelChecks } }) }
      & $ui.SetBar 'all' 0 $true; $ui.Bars['all'].Fill = $ui.C.Blue; $ui.Busy = $true
      try {
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ids.Count; $i++) {
          if ($ui.Form.IsDisposed -or $script:closing) { return }
          if ($ui.Cancel) { break }
          $id = $ids[$i]; $d = Get-CheckDef $id; $have = $script:checkResults[$id]
          if ($d.Kind -ne 'auto') { if (-not $have) { $sv = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $false; if ($sv) { $script:checkResults[$id] = $sv } }; continue }   # a sign-in or look check: its saved result, else it asks later
          if ($have -and -not $Force) { continue }
          $sv = Get-CheckToRun $d $cache $bp $site $Force
          if ($sv) { $script:checkResults[$id] = $sv; & $ui.RecRefresh; continue }
          $ui.P[0].Text = [string]$d.Name; $ui.RightL.Text = 'Check ' + ($i + 1) + ' of ' + $ids.Count; & $ui.SetBar 'all' ($i / [math]::Max(1, $ids.Count)) $true
          [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents()
          $script:checkResults[$id] = Invoke-Check $d $bp $site { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents() }
          if ($ui.BaseRes.ContainsKey($id)) { $ui.BaseRes[$id] = $script:checkResults[$id] }   # Choose shows the newest result of a base check
          & $ui.RecRefresh   # an open Record shows the new result
        }
